   22 | def create_app():
   23 |     """
   24 |     Fábrica de inicialización de la aplicación Flask (Application Factory Pattern).
   25 |     Configura extensiones, directorios seguros y blueprints de presentación.
   26 |     """
   27 |     app = Flask(
   28 |         __name__, 
   29 |         static_folder=config.STATIC_DIR,

   31 |     )
   32 |     
   33 |     app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = config.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI
   34 |     app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = config.SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS
   35 |     app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = config.SECRET_KEY
   36 |

   40 |     
   41 |     db.init_app(app)
   42 |     
   43 |     with app.app_context():
   44 |         from sqlalchemy import event
   45 |         @event.listens_for(db.engine, "connect")
   46 |         def set_sqlite_pragma(dbapi_connection, connection_record):
   47 |             cursor = dbapi_connection.cursor()
   48 |             cursor.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
   49 |             cursor.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
   50 |             cursor.close()
   51 |

   53 |     app.register_blueprint(api_bp)

   62 |         )
   63 |     
   64 |     # Inicializar tablas, esquemas y Super Usuario por defecto

ARCHIVO   8/85: local_server/application/services/analytics_service.py (1766 líneas)

    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental
    2 | # Autores: Andrés Felipe Luna Camargo, Cristian David Peña Martínez
    3 | # Año: 2026.
    4 | 
    5 | import io
    6 | import csv
    7 | import calendar
    8 | import numpy as np
    9 | from datetime import datetime, timedelta
   10 | from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
   11 | from domain.models import CaptureSession, SensorReading, BiometricMetric
   12 | from infrastructure.database.connection import db
   13 | from infrastructure.database.repositories import (
   14 |     CaptureSessionRepository, 
   15 |     SensorRepository,
   16 |     ConfigRepository
   17 | )
   18 | from infrastructure.telemetry import TowerCsvImporter
   19 | 
   20 | class AnalyticsApplicationService:
   21 |     """
   22 |     Caso de uso: Cruce de fenotipado con telemetría ambiental,
   23 |     análisis por jornada diaria, cálculo de correlaciones agronómicas y remuestreo temporal.
   24 |     (SOLID: SRP, DIP)
   25 |     """
   26 |     
   27 |     def __init__(
   28 |         self,
   29 |         session_repo: Optional[CaptureSessionRepository] = None,
   30 |         sensor_repo: Optional[SensorRepository] = None,
   31 |         config_repo: Optional[ConfigRepository] = None,
   32 |         csv_importer: Optional[TowerCsvImporter] = None
   33 |     ):
   34 |         self.session_repo = session_repo or CaptureSessionRepository()
   35 |         self.sensor_repo = sensor_repo or SensorRepository()
   36 |         self.config_repo = config_repo or ConfigRepository()
   37 |         self.csv_importer = csv_importer or TowerCsvImporter(self.sensor_repo, self.session_repo)
   38 | 
   39 |     def import_tower_csv(self, file_stream_or_path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   40 |         return self.csv_importer.import_csv(file_stream_or_path)
   41 | 
   42 |     def get_available_dates(self, plant_id: int = 1) -> List[str]:
   43 |         """Obtiene todas las fechas con datos registrados para la canastilla indicada, incluyendo la fecha actual de hoy."""
   44 |         today = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
   45 |         dates_set = {today}
   46 | 
   47 |         session_dates = self.session_repo.get_available_dates(plant_id)
   48 |         if session_dates:
   49 |             dates_set.update(session_dates)
   50 | 
   51 |         cfg = self.config_repo.get() if self.config_repo else None
   52 |         shared_telemetry = getattr(cfg, 'shared_telemetry', True) if cfg else True
   53 |         if shared_telemetry:
   54 |             sensor_dates = self.sensor_repo.get_available_dates()
   55 |             if sensor_dates:
   56 |                 dates_set.update(sensor_dates)
   57 | 
   58 |         return sorted(list(dates_set), reverse=True)
   59 | 
   60 |     def get_daily_summary_data(self, target_date: Optional[str] = None, plant_id: int = 1) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   61 |         """
   62 |         Retorna el análisis consolidado exacto para un día específico y canastilla específica.
   63 |         Si no se indica fecha, por defecto muestra la fecha actual de hoy.
   64 |         """
   65 |         today_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
   66 |         available_dates = self.get_available_dates(plant_id)
   67 |         
   68 |         # Si no se indica fecha o es 'auto', predeterminar al día actual de hoy
   69 |         if not target_date or target_date in ["auto", "today", ""]:
   70 |             target_date = today_str
   71 | 
   72 |         cfg = self.config_repo.get() if self.config_repo else None
   73 |         shared_telemetry = getattr(cfg, 'shared_telemetry', True) if cfg else True
   74 | 
   75 |         # 1. Obtener sesiones de fenotipado de la canastilla
   76 |         sessions = self.session_repo.get_by_date_and_plant(target_date, plant_id)
   77 |         has_plant_data = len(sessions) > 0
   78 | 
   79 |         # Obtener lecturas de sensores de la fecha (telemetría compartida o aislada)
   80 |         if not shared_telemetry:
   81 |             session_readings = [s.sensor_reading for s in sessions if s.sensor_reading]
   82 |             readings = session_readings
   83 |         else:
   84 |             readings = self.sensor_repo.get_by_date(target_date)
   85 | 
   86 |         has_sensor_data = len(readings) > 0
   87 | 
   88 |         # 2. Si no hay datos de fenotipado ni lecturas de sensores para este día
   89 |         if not has_plant_data and not has_sensor_data:
   90 |             return {
   91 |                 "target_date": target_date,
   92 |                 "available_dates": available_dates,
   93 |                 "has_data": False,

  435 |     def get_cross_referenced_dataset(self, plant_id: int = 1) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
  436 |         """Retorna la matriz sincronizada de imágenes y telemetría por sesión y por foto."""
  437 |         sessions = self.session_repo.get_all_by_plant(plant_id=plant_id, order_asc=True)
  438 |         cross_data = []
  439 | 
  440 |         for s in sessions:
  441 |             sensor = s.sensor_reading
  442 |             if not sensor:
  443 |                 sensor = self.sensor_repo.find_nearest(s.timestamp)
  444 | 
  445 |             has_sensor = sensor is not None
  446 |             temp = round(sensor.temperature, 2) if (sensor and sensor.temperature is not None) else None
  447 |             hum = round(sensor.humidity, 1) if (sensor and sensor.humidity is not None) else None
  448 |             uv = round(sensor.uv_solar, 1) if (sensor and sensor.uv_solar is not None) else None
  449 |             curr = round(sensor.motor_current, 3) if (sensor and sensor.motor_current is not None) else None
  450 |             ec = round(sensor.ec_conductivity, 1) if (sensor and sensor.ec_conductivity is not None) else None
  451 |             ph = round(sensor.water_ph, 2) if (sensor and sensor.water_ph is not None) else None
  452 |             turb = round(sensor.turbidity_ntu, 2) if (sensor and sensor.turbidity_ntu is not None) else None
  453 |             do = round(sensor.dissolved_oxygen_mg_l, 2) if (sensor and sensor.dissolved_oxygen_mg_l is not None) else None
  454 |             water_temp = round(sensor.water_temp, 1) if (sensor and getattr(sensor, 'water_temp', None) is not None) else None
  455 |             motor_state = int(sensor.motor_state) if (sensor and getattr(sensor, 'motor_state', None) is not None) else (1 if (sensor and curr and curr > 0.1) else (0 if sensor else None))
  456 | 
  457 |             avg_metric = s.get_average_metric()
  458 |             avg_cenital = avg_metric.image_path_cenital_proc or "" if avg_metric else ""
  459 |             avg_lateral = avg_metric.image_path_lateral_proc or "" if avg_metric else ""
  460 |             session_cenital_url = "/static/" + avg_cenital.replace("static/", "").replace("local_server/static/", "").lstrip("/") if avg_cenital else ""
  461 |             session_lateral_url = "/static/" + avg_lateral.replace("static/", "").replace("local_server/static/", "").lstrip("/") if avg_lateral else ""
  462 | 
  463 |             raw_photos = s.get_individual_photos()
  464 |             individual_photos = []
  465 |             for idx, m in enumerate(raw_photos):
  466 |                 m_dict = m.to_dict()
  467 |                 m_dict["photo_num"] = idx + 1
  468 |                 m_dict["temperature_c"] = temp
  469 |                 m_dict["humidity_rh"] = hum
  470 |                 m_dict["water_temp_c"] = water_temp
  471 |                 m_dict["motor_state"] = motor_state
  472 |                 m_dict["uv_solar_lux"] = uv
  473 |                 m_dict["motor_current_a"] = curr
  474 |                 m_dict["ec_conductivity"] = ec
  475 |                 m_dict["water_ph"] = ph
  476 |                 m_dict["turbidity_ntu"] = turb
  477 |                 m_dict["dissolved_oxygen_mg_l"] = do

  479 | 
  480 |                 c_proc = m.image_path_cenital_proc or ""

  483 |                 m_dict["lateral_url"] = "/static/" + l_proc.replace("static/", "").replace("local_server/static/", "").lstrip("/") if l_proc else ""
  484 |                 m_dict["thumbnail_url"] = m_dict["cenital_url"] or m_dict["lateral_url"]
  485 | 
  486 |                 individual_photos.append(m_dict)
  487 | 
  488 |             # Normalización del período y fecha
  489 |             raw_p = s.period or ""
  490 |             if " - " in raw_p:
  491 |                 parts = raw_p.split(" - ")
  492 |                 date_clean = parts[0].strip()
  493 |                 period_clean = parts[1].strip()
  494 |             elif "_" in raw_p:
  495 |                 parts = raw_p.split("_")
  496 |                 date_clean = parts[0].strip()
  497 |                 period_clean = parts[1].strip()
  498 |             else:
  499 |                 date_clean = s.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  500 |                 period_clean = raw_p or "Muestreo"
  501 | 
  502 |             if avg_metric:
  503 |                 cross_data.append({
  504 |                     "session_id": s.id,
  505 |                     "has_sensor_data": has_sensor,
  506 |                     "period": period_clean.capitalize(),
  507 |                     "period_name": period_clean.lower(),
  508 |                     "date_str": date_clean,
  509 |                     "full_period_label": f"{date_clean} - {period_clean.capitalize()}",
  510 |                     "timestamp": s.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  511 |                     "exact_time": s.timestamp.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
  512 |                     "crop_type": s.crop_type,
  513 |                     "plant_id": s.plant_id,
  514 |                     "foliar_area_cm2": round(avg_metric.foliar_area_cm2, 2),
  515 |                     "plant_height_cm": round(avg_metric.plant_height_cm, 2),
  516 |                     "stem_diameter_mm": round(avg_metric.stem_diameter_mm, 2),
  517 |                     "health_index": round(avg_metric.health_index, 1),
  518 |                     "compacity_index": round(avg_metric.compacity_index, 3),
  519 |                     "temperature_c": temp,
  520 |                     "humidity_rh": hum,
  521 |                     "water_temp_c": water_temp,

  531 |                     "photos_count": len(individual_photos),

  537 |     def calculate_full_correlation_matrix(self, cross_data: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  538 |         """Calcula la matriz de correlación de Pearson y regresión entre sensores y fenotipado."""
  539 |         sensor_keys = [
  540 |             ("temperature_c", "Temperatura Ambiente", "°C", "#2563eb"),
  541 |             ("humidity_rh", "Humedad Relativa", "%", "#0284c7"),
  542 |             ("water_temp_c", "Temperatura del Agua", "°C", "#0ea5e9"),
  543 |             ("motor_state", "Estado Motor (1/0)", "pts", "#059669"),
  544 |             ("uv_solar_lux", "Radiación Solar", "lux", "#d97706"),
  545 |             ("motor_current_a", "Corriente Bomba", "A", "#10b981"),
  546 |             ("ec_conductivity", "Conductividad Eléctrica", "µS/cm", "#8b5cf6"),
  547 |             ("water_ph", "pH de la Solución", "pH", "#ec4899"),
  548 |             ("turbidity_ntu", "Turbidez del Agua", "NTU", "#f97316"),
  549 |             ("dissolved_oxygen_mg_l", "Oxígeno Disuelto", "mg/L", "#06b6d4")
  550 |         ]
  551 |         pheno_keys = [
  552 |             ("foliar_area_cm2", "Área Foliar", "cm²", "#059669"),
  553 |             ("plant_height_cm", "Altura Planta", "cm", "#16a34a"),
  554 |             ("stem_diameter_mm", "Diámetro Tallo", "mm", "#84cc16"),
  555 |             ("health_index", "Índice de Salud", "%", "#10b981"),
  556 |             ("compacity_index", "Compacidad", "pts", "#047857")
  557 |         ]
  558 | 
  559 |         matrix_rows = []
  560 |         strongest_r = 0.0
  561 |         strongest_pair = "Sin datos suficientes"
  562 | 
  563 |         if not cross_data or len(cross_data) < 2:
  564 |             for s_key, s_label, s_unit, s_color in sensor_keys:
  565 |                 cells = []
  566 |                 for p_key, p_label, p_unit, p_color in pheno_keys:
  567 |                     cells.append({
  568 |                         "sensor_key": s_key,
  569 |                         "pheno_key": p_key,
  570 |                         "r": 0.0,
  571 |                         "r2": 0.0,
  572 |                         "interpretation": "Muestras insuficientes (mín. 2 períodos)",
  573 |                         "color_class": "neutral",
  574 |                         "bg_color": "rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.6)",
  575 |                         "text_color": "#64748b"
  576 |                     })
  577 |                 matrix_rows.append({
  578 |                     "sensor_key": s_key,
  579 |                     "sensor_label": s_label,
  580 |                     "sensor_unit": s_unit,
  581 |                     "cells": cells
  582 |                 })
  583 |             return {
  584 |                 "sensors": [{"key": s[0], "label": s[1], "unit": s[2], "color": s[3]} for s in sensor_keys],
  585 |                 "phenotypes": [{"key": p[0], "label": p[1], "unit": p[2], "color": p[3]} for p in pheno_keys],
  586 |                 "matrix_rows": matrix_rows,
  587 |                 "strongest_pair": strongest_pair
  588 |             }
  589 | 
  590 |         for s_key, s_label, s_unit, s_color in sensor_keys:
  591 |             cells = []
  592 |             for p_key, p_label, p_unit, p_color in pheno_keys:
  593 |                 valid_pairs = [
  594 |                     (float(d[s_key]), float(d[p_key]))
  595 |                     for d in cross_data 
  596 |                     if d.get(s_key) is not None and d.get(p_key) is not None
  597 |                 ]
  598 | 
  599 |                 if len(valid_pairs) >= 2:
  600 |                     s_vals = np.array([p[0] for p in valid_pairs], dtype=float)
  601 |                     p_vals = np.array([p[1] for p in valid_pairs], dtype=float)
  602 |                     s_std = float(np.std(s_vals))
  603 |                     p_std = float(np.std(p_vals))
  604 | 
  605 |                     if s_std > 1e-6 and p_std > 1e-6:
  606 |                         r_val = float(np.corrcoef(s_vals, p_vals)[0, 1])
  607 |                         if np.isnan(r_val):
  608 |                             r_val = 0.0
  609 |                     else:
  610 |                         r_val = 0.0
  611 |                 else:
  612 |                     r_val = 0.0
  613 | 
  614 |                 r_val = round(r_val, 2)
  615 |                 r2_val = round(r_val ** 2, 3)
  616 | 
  617 |                 if len(valid_pairs) < 2:
  618 |                     interp = "Sin telemetría captada"
  619 |                     color_class = "neutral"
  620 |                     bg_color = "rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.6)"
  621 |                     text_color = "#94a3b8"
  622 |                 elif r_val >= 0.65:
  623 |                     interp = "Correlación Directa Fuerte"
  624 |                     color_class = "pos-strong"
  625 |                     bg_color = "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)"
  626 |                     text_color = "#065f46"
  627 |                 elif r_val >= 0.25:
  628 |                     interp = "Correlación Directa Moderada"
  629 |                     color_class = "pos-mod"
  630 |                     bg_color = "rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.18)"
  631 |                     text_color = "#047857"
  632 |                 elif r_val <= -0.65:
  633 |                     interp = "Correlación Inversa Fuerte"
  634 |                     color_class = "neg-strong"
  635 |                     bg_color = "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.24)"
  636 |                     text_color = "#991b1b"
  637 |                 elif r_val <= -0.25:
  638 |                     interp = "Correlación Inversa Moderada"
  639 |                     color_class = "neg-mod"
  640 |                     bg_color = "rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.16)"
  641 |                     text_color = "#b91c1c"
  642 |                 else:
  643 |                     interp = "Relación Débil o Independiente"
  644 |                     color_class = "neutral"
  645 |                     bg_color = "rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.7)"
  646 |                     text_color = "#475569"
  647 | 
  648 |                 if abs(r_val) > abs(strongest_r) and len(valid_pairs) >= 2:
  649 |                     strongest_r = r_val
  650 |                     strongest_pair = f"{s_label} vs {p_label} (r = {r_val:+0.2f}, R² = {r2_val})"
  651 | 
  652 |                 cells.append({
  653 |                     "sensor_key": s_key,
  654 |                     "pheno_key": p_key,
  655 |                     "r": r_val,
  656 |                     "r2": r2_val,
  657 |                     "interpretation": interp,
  658 |                     "color_class": color_class,
  659 |                     "bg_color": bg_color,
  660 |                     "text_color": text_color
  661 |                 })
  662 | 
  663 |             matrix_rows.append({
  664 |                 "sensor_key": s_key,
  665 |                 "sensor_label": s_label,
  666 |                 "sensor_unit": s_unit,
  667 |                 "cells": cells
  668 |             })
  669 | 
  670 |         return {
  671 |             "sensors": [{"key": s[0], "label": s[1], "unit": s[2], "color": s[3]} for s in sensor_keys],
  672 |             "phenotypes": [{"key": p[0], "label": p[1], "unit": p[2], "color": p[3]} for p in pheno_keys],
  673 |             "matrix_rows": matrix_rows,
  674 |             "strongest_pair": strongest_pair
  675 |         }

  677 |     def calculate_agronomic_correlations(self, cross_data: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  678 |         """Calcula estadísticas descriptivas e inferencias para investigación agronómica."""
  679 |         if not cross_data or len(cross_data) < 2:
  680 |             return {
  681 |                 "optimal_temp_range": "21.0 - 24.5 °C",
  682 |                 "optimal_humidity_range": "60.0 - 70.0 %",
  683 |                 "optimal_uv_range": "300.0 - 450.0 lux",
  684 |                 "growth_rate_cm2_day": 0.0,
  685 |                 "insights": [
  686 |                     "Se requieren al menos 2 sesiones de muestreo para calcular correlaciones dinámicas de crecimiento.",
  687 |                     "El sistema evaluará las condiciones de mayor tasa de expansión foliar conforme se registren más períodos."
  688 |                 ]
  689 |             }
  690 | 
  691 |         areas = [d["foliar_area_cm2"] for d in cross_data if d.get("foliar_area_cm2") is not None]
  692 |         if not areas:
  693 |             return {
  694 |                 "optimal_temp_range": "21.0 - 24.5 °C",
  695 |                 "optimal_humidity_range": "60.0 - 70.0 %",
  696 |                 "optimal_uv_range": "300.0 - 450.0 lux",
  697 |                 "growth_rate_cm2_day": 0.0,
  698 |                 "insights": ["Sin datos fenotípicos suficientes."]
  699 |             }
  700 | 
  701 |         delta_area = max(areas) - min(areas)
  702 |         growth_rate = round(delta_area / max(len(cross_data) - 1, 1), 2)
  703 | 
  704 |         median_area = float(np.median(areas))
  705 |         top_samples = [d for d in cross_data if (d.get("foliar_area_cm2") or 0.0) >= median_area]
  706 | 
  707 |         temps = [d["temperature_c"] for d in top_samples if d.get("temperature_c") is not None]
  708 |         hums = [d["humidity_rh"] for d in top_samples if d.get("humidity_rh") is not None]
  709 |         uvs = [d["uv_solar_lux"] for d in top_samples if d.get("uv_solar_lux") is not None]
  710 | 
  711 |         opt_temp_min = round(min(temps) - 0.5, 1) if temps else 21.0
  712 |         opt_temp_max = round(max(temps) + 0.5, 1) if temps else 24.5
  713 |         opt_hum_min = round(min(hums) - 2.0, 1) if hums else 60.0
  714 |         opt_hum_max = round(max(hums) + 2.0, 1) if hums else 70.0
  715 |         opt_uv_min = round(min(uvs) - 10.0, 1) if uvs else 300.0
  716 |         opt_uv_max = round(max(uvs) + 10.0, 1) if uvs else 450.0
  717 | 
  718 |         insights = [
  719 |             f"Tasa media de incremento foliar: +{growth_rate} cm² por sesión registrada.",
  720 |             f"El mayor vigor y salud foliar se observó con temperaturas en rango {opt_temp_min} a {opt_temp_max} °C y humedad en {opt_hum_min}% a {opt_hum_max}%.",
  721 |             f"La radiación solar útil óptima para esta especie oscila entre {opt_uv_min} y {opt_uv_max} lux.",
  722 |             "La estabilidad en la corriente de la bomba confirma flujo de solución nutritiva sin obstrucciones."
  723 |         ]
  724 | 
  725 |         return {
  726 |             "optimal_temp_range": f"{opt_temp_min} - {opt_temp_max} °C" if temps else "Sin telemetría captada",
  727 |             "optimal_humidity_range": f"{opt_hum_min} - {opt_hum_max} %" if hums else "Sin telemetría captada",
  728 |             "optimal_uv_range": f"{opt_uv_min} - {opt_uv_max} lux" if uvs else "Sin telemetría captada",
  729 |             "growth_rate_cm2_day": growth_rate,
  730 |             "insights": insights
  731 |         }

  733 |     def get_sensor_timeline_data(self, target_date: Optional[str] = None, plant_id: int = 1, limit_points: int = 120) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  734 |         """Obtiene datos temporales remuestreados y estadísticas resumidas con soporte de aislamiento por canastilla."""

   48 |             return {"status": "already_running", "file": self.current_csv_file}

   50 |         available = self.get_available_ports()

   61 |             return {
   62 |                 "status": "error",

   64 |             }

  119 |     def _telemetry_worker(self, app=None):

   64 |     def get_current_weather(self, lat: float = None, lon: float = None, city_name: str = None) -> dict:
   65 |         """
   66 |         Obtiene el clima actual para las coordenadas configuradas.
   67 |         Si falla la conexión a internet, retorna el último valor en caché o un estado offline seguro.
   68 |         """
   69 |         now = time.time()
   70 |         lat = lat if lat is not None else self.DEFAULT_LAT
   71 |         lon = lon if lon is not None else self.DEFAULT_LON
   72 |         city = city_name or self.DEFAULT_CITY
   73 | 
   74 |         if self._cached_data and (now - self._last_fetch_time < self._CACHE_TTL):
   75 |             return self._cached_data
   76 | 
   77 |         url = (
   78 |             f"https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?"
   79 |             f"latitude={lat}&longitude={lon}&"
   80 |             f"current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,apparent_temperature,weather_code,wind_speed_10m,surface_pressure&"
   81 |             f"timezone=auto"
   82 |         )
   83 | 
   84 |         try:
   85 |             req = urllib.request.Request(
   86 |                 url, 
   87 |                 headers={'User-Agent': 'SIFMA-Hydroponics-Monitor/1.0'}
   88 |             )
   89 |             with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3.0) as response:
   90 |                 if response.status == 200:
   91 |                     raw = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))
   92 |                     current = raw.get('current', {})
   93 |                     wmo_info = self._interpret_wmo_code(current.get('weather_code', 0))
   94 | 
   95 |                     data = {
   96 |                         "online": True,
   97 |                         "temperature_c": round(current.get('temperature_2m', 30.0), 1),
   98 |                         "apparent_temperature_c": round(current.get('apparent_temperature', 32.0), 1),
   99 |                         "humidity_rh": int(current.get('relative_humidity_2m', 70)),
  100 |                         "wind_speed_kmh": round(current.get('wind_speed_10m', 10.0), 1),
  101 |                         "weather_code": current.get('weather_code', 0),
  102 |                         "weather_description": wmo_info["description"],
  103 |                         "icon": wmo_info["icon"],
  104 |                         "badge_class": wmo_info["badge_class"],
  105 |                         "location_name": city,
  106 |                         "latitude": lat,
  107 |                         "longitude": lon,
  108 |                         "updated_at": datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M"),
  109 |                         "status_text": "En Línea (Open-Meteo)"
  110 |                     }
  111 |                     self._cached_data = data
  112 |                     self._last_fetch_time = now
  113 |                     return data
  114 |         except Exception:
  115 |             pass
  116 | 
  117 |         # Fallback offline si no hay conexión o expira el timeout
  118 |         if self._cached_data:
  119 |             cached_copy = dict(self._cached_data)
  120 |             cached_copy["status_text"] = "Caché Local (Sin conexión)"
  121 |             cached_copy["online"] = False
  122 |             return cached_copy
  123 | 
  124 |         return {
  125 |             "online": False,
  126 |             "temperature_c": 30.0,

  129 |             "wind_speed_kmh": 8.0,

  131 |             "weather_description": "Modo Local Autónomo",
  132 |             "icon": "cloud_off",
  133 |             "badge_class": "offline",
  134 |             "location_name": city,

   10 |     def load_dotenv(path):
   11 |         if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
   12 |             return
   13 |         try:
   14 |             with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
   15 |                 for line in f:
   16 |                     line = line.strip()
   17 |                     if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
   18 |                         continue
   19 |                     k, v = line.split("=", 1)
   20 |                     k = k.strip()
   21 |                     v = v.strip().strip("'\"")
   22 |                     if k not in os.environ:
   23 |                         os.environ[k] = v
   24 |         except Exception:
   25 |             pass
   26 |

   10 |     ("flask", "Flask==3.1.3"),
   11 |     ("flask_sqlalchemy", "Flask-SQLAlchemy==3.1.1"),
   12 |     ("sqlalchemy", "SQLAlchemy==2.0.52"),

   15 |     ("serial", "pyserial==3.5"),
   16 |     ("dotenv", "python-dotenv==1.2.4")
   17 | ]
   18 | 
   19 | def install_package(package_name: str) -> bool:
   20 |     """Instala automáticamente un paquete de Python utilizando pip."""
   21 |     print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Instalando paquete ausente: '{package_name}'...")
   22 |     base_cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", package_name]
   23 |     
   24 |     try:
   25 |         res = subprocess.run(base_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
   26 |         if res.returncode == 0:
   27 |             print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] '{package_name}' instalado exitosamente.")
   28 |             return True
   29 |         
   30 |         # En Linux con restricciones de entorno gestionado externamente (PEP 668)
   31 |         if "externally-managed-environment" in res.stderr.lower() or sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
   32 |             print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Reintentando con --break-system-packages...")
   33 |             res_break = subprocess.run(base_cmd + ["--break-system-packages"], capture_output=True, text=True)
   34 |             if res_break.returncode == 0:
   35 |                 print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] '{package_name}' instalado exitosamente.")
   36 |                 return True
   37 |             else:
   38 |                 print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR AVISO] No se pudo instalar '{package_name}': {res_break.stderr}")
   39 |                 return False
   40 |         else:
   41 |             print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR AVISO] No se pudo instalar '{package_name}': {res.stderr}")
   42 |             return False
   43 |     except Exception as e:
   44 |         print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR ERROR] Excepción al ejecutar pip: {e}")
   45 |         return False
   46 | 
   47 | def ensure_dependencies():
   48 |     """Verifica e instala automáticamente las librerías necesarias del servidor SIFMA."""
   49 |     missing = []
   50 |     for module_name, pip_name in SERVER_REQUIRED_PACKAGES:
   51 |         try:
   52 |             importlib.import_module(module_name)
   53 |         except ImportError:
   54 |             missing.append((module_name, pip_name))
   55 | 
   56 |     if missing:
   57 |         print("\n=======================================================")
   58 |         print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Detectadas {len(missing)} dependencias faltantes.")
   59 |         print("Instalando automáticamente mediante PIP...")
   60 |         print("=======================================================\n")
   61 |         
   62 |         for module_name, pip_name in missing:
   63 |             ok = install_package(pip_name)
   64 |             if ok:
   65 |                 try:
   66 |                     importlib.invalidate_caches()
   67 |                     importlib.import_module(module_name)
   68 |                 except Exception:
   69 |                     pass
   70 |         print("\n[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Dependencias listas para producción.\n")
   71 | 
   72 | if __name__ == "__main__":
   73 |     ensure_dependencies()

   11 | class SecurityService:
   12 |     """
   13 |     Servicio de seguridad para autenticación, verificación de contraseñas
   14 |     y sanitización contra Path Traversal e inyecciones.
   15 |     """
   16 |     
   17 |     @staticmethod
   18 |     def verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str) -> bool:
   19 |         """Verifica una contraseña en texto plano contra su hash."""
   20 |         if not plain_password or not password_hash:
   21 |             return False
   22 |         try:
   23 |             return check_password_hash(password_hash, plain_password)
   24 |         except Exception:
   25 |             return False
   26 | 
   27 |     @staticmethod
   28 |     def hash_password(plain_password: str) -> str:
   29 |         """Genera un hash seguro para almacenamiento de credenciales."""
   30 |         return generate_password_hash(plain_password)
   31 | 
   32 |     @staticmethod
   33 |     def sanitize_filename(filename: str) -> str:
   34 |         """Sanitiza el nombre de un archivo para evitar ataques de Path Traversal."""
   35 |         clean = secure_filename(filename)
   36 |         if not clean:
   37 |             clean = "archivo_anonimo.dat"
   38 |         return clean
   39 | 
   40 |     @staticmethod
   41 |     def is_safe_path(base_dir: str, target_path: str) -> bool:
   42 |         """Verifica que target_path se encuentre estrictamente contenido dentro de base_dir."""
   43 |         try:
   44 |             abs_base = os.path.abspath(base_dir)
   45 |             abs_target = os.path.abspath(target_path)
   46 |             return os.path.commonpath([abs_base, abs_target]) == abs_base
   47 |         except Exception:
   48 |             return False
   49 | 
   50 |     @staticmethod
   51 |     def sanitize_text(input_text: str, max_length: int = 500) -> str:
   52 |         """Limpia cadenas de texto removiendo caracteres de control peligrosos."""
   53 |         if not input_text:
   54 |             return ""
   55 |         clean = str(input_text).strip()[:max_length]
   56 |         # Remover etiquetas HTML directas para prevenir XSS
   57 |         clean = re.sub(r'<[^>]*>', '', clean)
   58 |         return clean

    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental

    5 | import cv2
    6 | import numpy as np
    7 | 
    8 | class FruitDetector:
    9 |     """
   10 |     Detector de frutos (ej. Tomate Cherry) basado en tonalidades rojo/naranja y circularidad.
   11 |     """
   12 |     
   13 |     @staticmethod
   14 |     def detect_fruits(img, overlay):
   15 |         """
   16 |         Detecta y contabiliza frutos circulares rojos/anaranjados.
   17 |         Retorna la cantidad detectada y dibuja marcadores sobre la imagen overlay.
   18 |         """
   19 |         if img is None:
   20 |             return 0
   21 |             
   22 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   23 |         
   24 |         # Rangos HSV para tonalidades rojas (wraparound de 0° y 180°)
   25 |         lower_red1 = np.array([0, 50, 45])
   26 |         upper_red1 = np.array([15, 255, 255])
   27 |         lower_red2 = np.array([165, 50, 45])
   28 |         upper_red2 = np.array([180, 255, 255])
   29 |         
   30 |         mask_red = cv2.bitwise_or(
   31 |             cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_red1, upper_red1),
   32 |             cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_red2, upper_red2)
   33 |         )
   34 |         
   35 |         kernel_close = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (5, 5))
   36 |         kernel_open = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (3, 3))
   37 |         mask_red = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_red, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel_close)
   38 |         mask_red = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_red, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel_open)
   39 |         
   40 |         fruit_contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask_red, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
   41 |         fruits_count = 0
   42 |         
   43 |         for c in fruit_contours:
   44 |             c_area = cv2.contourArea(c)
   45 |             if c_area > 40: # Área mínima para tomate individual
   46 |                 c_perimeter = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
   47 |                 if c_perimeter > 0:
   48 |                     circularity = (4 * np.pi * c_area) / (c_perimeter ** 2)
   49 |                     if circularity > 0.55: # Alta circularidad
   50 |                         fruits_count += 1
   51 |                         (x_f, y_f), r_f = cv2.minEnclosingCircle(c)
   52 |                         cv2.circle(overlay, (int(x_f), int(y_f)), int(r_f), (0, 255, 255), 2)
   53 |                         
   54 |         return fruits_count

    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental

    5 | import cv2
    6 | import numpy as np
    7 | 
    8 | class BiometricCalculator:
    9 |     """
   10 |     Calculadora de parámetros biométricos (Área Foliar, Salud, Altura y Tallo).
   11 |     """
   12 |     
   13 |     @staticmethod
   14 |     def calculate_cenital_metrics(img, mask, contours, profile):
   15 |         """
   16 |         Calcula el área foliar (cm²), índice de salud (%) e índice de compacidad.
   17 |         """
   18 |         plant_pixels = 0
   19 |         compacity = 0.0
   20 |         
   21 |         if contours:
   22 |             plant_pixels = sum(cv2.contourArea(c) for c in contours)
   23 |             largest_contour = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
   24 |             perimeter = cv2.arcLength(largest_contour, True)
   25 |             largest_area = cv2.contourArea(largest_contour)
   26 |             
   27 |             if perimeter > 0:
   28 |                 compacity = (4 * np.pi * largest_area) / (perimeter ** 2)
   29 |                 
   30 |         # 1. Área física en cm²
   31 |         area_cm2 = plant_pixels * (profile.pixel_to_cm_ratio ** 2)
   32 |         
   33 |         # 2. Índice de Salud Cromática (% de píxeles verde óptimo dentro de la planta)
   34 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   35 |         lower_green = np.array([38, 45, 45])
   36 |         upper_green = np.array([82, 255, 255])
   37 |         mask_healthy = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_green, upper_green)
   38 |         
   39 |         healthy_plant_pixels = cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(mask, mask_healthy))
   40 |         health_index = 100.0
   41 |         if plant_pixels > 0:
   42 |             health_index = (healthy_plant_pixels / plant_pixels) * 100.0
   43 |             health_index = min(100.0, max(0.0, health_index))
   44 |             
   45 |         return {
   46 |             "plant_pixels": plant_pixels,
   47 |             "area_cm2": round(area_cm2, 2),
   48 |             "health_index": round(health_index, 2),
   49 |             "compacity_index": round(compacity, 3)
   50 |         }
   51 | 
   52 |     @staticmethod
   53 |     def calculate_lateral_metrics(img, mask, contours, profile):
   54 |         """
   55 |         Calcula la altura estimada de la planta (cm) y el diámetro del tallo (mm).
   56 |         La altura se calcula con precisión entre el ápice más alto y la base del tallo detectado.
   57 |         """
   58 |         h, w, _ = img.shape
   59 |         height_cm = 0.0
   60 |         stem_diameter_mm = 0.0
   61 |         stem_draw_y = None
   62 |         stem_row_pixels = None
   63 |         y_min = None
   64 |         y_max = None
   65 |         x_points = None
   66 |         
   67 |         if contours:
   68 |             all_points = np.vstack([c for c in contours])
   69 |             y_points = all_points[:, 0, 1]
   70 |             x_points = all_points[:, 0, 0]
   71 |             
   72 |             y_min = int(np.min(y_points)) # Punto más alto de las hojas
   73 |             y_max = int(np.max(y_points)) # Base más baja del tallo segmentado
   74 |             
   75 |             if y_min < y_max:
   76 |                 height_pixels = y_max - y_min
   77 |                 height_cm = height_pixels * profile.pixel_to_cm_ratio
   78 |                 
   79 |                 # Cálculo de diámetro de tallo basal (si la especie tiene tallo)
   80 |                 has_stem = getattr(profile, 'has_stem', True)
   81 |                 if has_stem and height_cm >= 0.5:
   82 |                     widths = []
   83 |                     valid_y = []
   84 |                     # Evaluar los primeros píxeles de la base del tallo
   85 |                     for offset in range(2, 10):
   86 |                         test_y = y_max - offset
   87 |                         if 0 <= test_y < h:
   88 |                             row_pixels = np.where(mask[test_y, :] > 0)[0]
   89 |                             if len(row_pixels) > 0:
   90 |                                 w_px = np.max(row_pixels) - np.min(row_pixels)
   91 |                                 if 1 <= w_px < 60: # Descartar hojas anchas
   92 |                                     widths.append(w_px)
   93 |                                     valid_y.append(test_y)
   94 |                     
   95 |                     if widths:
   96 |                         stem_width_pixels = np.median(widths)
   97 |                         stem_diameter_mm = stem_width_pixels * profile.pixel_to_cm_ratio * 10
   98 |                         stem_draw_y = int(np.median(valid_y))
   99 |                         stem_row_pixels = np.where(mask[stem_draw_y, :] > 0)[0]
  100 |                         
  101 |         return {
  102 |             "height_cm": round(height_cm, 2),
  103 |             "stem_diameter_mm": round(stem_diameter_mm, 2),
  104 |             "y_min": y_min,
  105 |             "y_max": y_max,
  106 |             "x_points": x_points,
  107 |             "stem_draw_y": stem_draw_y,
  108 |             "stem_row_pixels": stem_row_pixels
  109 |         }

   12 | class VisionPipelineManager:
   13 |     """
   14 |     Orquestador principal del pipeline de visión computacional agronómica.
   15 |     Procesa imágenes cenitales y laterales, segmenta tejido foliar en ROJO y
   16 |     calcula área foliar, índice de salud, altura y diámetro de tallo.
   17 |     """
   18 |     
   19 |     @staticmethod
   20 |     def process_cenital_image(image_path, output_path, profile):
   21 |         os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
   22 |         img = cv2.imread(image_path)
   23 |         if img is None:
   24 |             return None
   25 |             
   26 |         mask = ImageSegmenter.create_foliage_mask(img, profile)
   27 |         contours = ImageSegmenter.extract_valid_contours(mask, min_area=30)
   28 |         
   29 |         metrics = BiometricCalculator.calculate_cenital_metrics(img, mask, contours, profile)
   30 |         
   31 |         overlay = img.copy()
   32 |         if contours:
   33 |             # 1. Dibujar todos los contornos del área foliar en ROJO PURO (0, 0, 255 en BGR)
   34 |             cv2.drawContours(overlay, contours, -1, (0, 0, 255), 2)
   35 |             
   36 |             # 2. Dibujar el cerco exterior / Envoltura convexa de la canopia en ROJO DESTACADO
   37 |             all_pts = np.vstack(contours)
   38 |             if len(all_pts) >= 3:
   39 |                 hull = cv2.convexHull(all_pts)
   40 |                 cv2.drawContours(overlay, [hull], -1, (0, 0, 255), 2)
   41 |             
   42 |         metrics["fruits_count"] = 0
   43 |         metrics["spots_count"] = 0
   44 |         
   45 |         # Superponer leyenda de métricas biométricas
   46 |         cv2.putText(overlay, f"Area Foliar: {metrics['area_cm2']:.1f} cm2", (20, 40), 
   47 |                     cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (0, 0, 255), 2)
   48 |         cv2.putText(overlay, f"Salud Foliar: {metrics['health_index']:.1f}%", (20, 75), 
   49 |                     cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (0, 255, 0), 2)
   50 |                         
   51 |         cv2.imwrite(output_path, overlay)
   52 |         return metrics
   53 | 
   54 |     @staticmethod
   55 |     def process_lateral_image(image_path, output_path, profile):
   56 |         os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
   57 |         img = cv2.imread(image_path)
   58 |         if img is None:
   59 |             return None
   60 |             
   61 |         mask = ImageSegmenter.create_foliage_mask(img, profile)
   62 |         contours = ImageSegmenter.extract_valid_contours(mask, min_area=30)
   63 |         
   64 |         metrics = BiometricCalculator.calculate_lateral_metrics(img, mask, contours, profile)
   65 |         
   66 |         overlay = img.copy()
   67 |         if contours:
   68 |             # Dibujar el perfil de la planta en ROJO (0, 0, 255)
   69 |             cv2.drawContours(overlay, contours, -1, (0, 0, 255), 2)
   70 |             
   71 |             y_min = metrics["y_min"]
   72 |             y_max = metrics["y_max"]
   73 |             x_points = metrics["x_points"]
   74 |             
   75 |             if y_min is not None and y_max is not None and y_min < y_max:
   76 |                 x_center = int((np.min(x_points) + np.max(x_points)) / 2)
   77 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (x_center - 15, y_min), (x_center + 15, y_min), (0, 255, 255), 2)
   78 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (x_center - 15, y_max), (x_center + 15, y_max), (0, 255, 255), 2)
   79 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (x_center, y_min), (x_center, y_max), (0, 255, 255), 2)
   80 |                 
   81 |                 cv2.putText(overlay, f"H: {metrics['height_cm']:.1f} cm", (x_center + 15, int((y_min + y_max)/2)),
   82 |                             cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (0, 255, 255), 2)
   83 |                 
   84 |             if metrics["stem_draw_y"] is not None and metrics["stem_row_pixels"] is not None:
   85 |                 draw_y = metrics["stem_draw_y"]
   86 |                 row_pixels = metrics["stem_row_pixels"]
   87 |                 if len(row_pixels) > 0:
   88 |                     cv2.line(overlay, (np.min(row_pixels), draw_y), (np.max(row_pixels), draw_y), (0, 0, 255), 3)
   89 |                     cv2.circle(overlay, (np.min(row_pixels), draw_y), 5, (0, 0, 255), -1)
   90 |                     cv2.circle(overlay, (np.max(row_pixels), draw_y), 5, (0, 0, 255), -1)
   91 |                     cv2.putText(overlay, f"D: {metrics['stem_diameter_mm']:.1f} mm", (np.max(row_pixels) + 15, draw_y + 5),
   92 |                                 cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.7, (0, 0, 255), 2)
   93 |                                 
   94 |         cv2.imwrite(output_path, overlay)
   95 |         return {
   96 |             "plant_height_cm": metrics["height_cm"],
   97 |             "stem_diameter_mm": metrics["stem_diameter_mm"]
   98 |         }
   99 | 
  100 |     @staticmethod
  101 |     def filter_and_average_metrics(cenital_results, lateral_results):
  102 |         """
  103 |         Elimina valores atípicos (+- 2 desviaciones estándar) y calcula promedios del lote.
  104 |         """
  105 |         final_metrics = {
  106 |             "foliar_area_cm2": 0.0,
  107 |             "health_index": 100.0,
  108 |             "compacity_index": 0.0,
  109 |             "spots_count": 0,
  110 |             "fruits_count": 0,
  111 |             "plant_height_cm": 0.0,
  112 |             "stem_diameter_mm": 0.0
  113 |         }
  114 |         
  115 |         def get_robust_mean(data_list):
  116 |             if not data_list: return 0.0
  117 |             if len(data_list) <= 2: return float(np.mean(data_list))
  118 |             mean = float(np.mean(data_list))
  119 |             std = float(np.std(data_list))
  120 |             if std == 0: return mean
  121 |             filtered = [x for x in data_list if abs(x - mean) <= 2 * std]
  122 |             return float(np.mean(filtered)) if filtered else mean
  123 | 
  124 |         if cenital_results:
  125 |             areas = [r["area_cm2"] for r in cenital_results]
  126 |             healths = [r["health_index"] for r in cenital_results]
  127 |             compacities = [r["compacity_index"] for r in cenital_results]
  128 |             
  129 |             final_metrics["foliar_area_cm2"] = round(get_robust_mean(areas), 2)
  130 |             final_metrics["health_index"] = round(get_robust_mean(healths), 2)
  131 |             final_metrics["compacity_index"] = round(get_robust_mean(compacities), 3)
  132 |             
  133 |         if lateral_results:
  134 |             heights = [r["plant_height_cm"] for r in lateral_results]
  135 |             diameters = [r["stem_diameter_mm"] for r in lateral_results]
  136 |             
  137 |             final_metrics["plant_height_cm"] = round(get_robust_mean(heights), 2)
  138 |             final_metrics["stem_diameter_mm"] = round(get_robust_mean(diameters), 2)
  139 |             
  140 |         return final_metrics
  141 |

================================================================================
    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental
    2 | # Autores: Andrés Felipe Luna Camargo, Cristian David Peña Martínez
    3 | # Año: 2026.
    4 | 
    5 | import cv2
    6 | import numpy as np
    7 | 
    8 | class ImageSegmenter:
    9 |     """
   10 |     Segmentador botánico avanzado basado en el Índice de Exceso de Verde (ExG),
   11 |     espacio de color HSV para clorofila, canal LAB y filtrado morfológico.
   12 |     Diseñado para aislar exclusivamente tejido vegetal en entornos reales (suelo, maceta, manos).
   13 |     """
   14 |     
   15 |     @staticmethod
   16 |     def create_foliage_mask(img, profile):
   17 |         """
   18 |         Crea una máscara binaria de alta precisión aislando el follaje y tallos verdes.
   19 |         Combina:
   20 |         1. Índice ExG (Excess Green Index: 2*G - R - B) para eliminar piel, tierra y plástico blanco.
   21 |         2. Umbralizado HSV calibrado para clorofila.
   22 |         3. Umbralizado LAB para confirmación cromática.
   23 |         """
   24 |         if img is None:
   25 |             return None
   26 |             
   27 |         # 1. Separación de canales BGR flotantes para calcular ExG
   28 |         b, g, r = cv2.split(img.astype(np.float32))
   29 |         exg = 2.0 * g - r - b
   30 |         
   31 |         # Umbral ExG: el tejido vegetal verde vivo tiene ExG marcadamente positivo (> 10)
   32 |         # La piel (R>G), tierra (R>G) y macetas blancas/grises (R~G~B) dan valores <= 0.
   33 |         exg_threshold = 10.0
   34 |         exg_mask = (exg > exg_threshold).astype(np.uint8) * 255
   35 |         
   36 |         # 2. Umbralizado en espacio HSV (Clorofila / Follaje)
   37 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   38 |         h_min = max(24, int(getattr(profile, 'h_min', 28)))
   39 |         h_max = min(96, int(getattr(profile, 'h_max', 90)))
   40 |         s_min = max(30, int(getattr(profile, 's_min', 35)))
   41 |         s_max = int(getattr(profile, 's_max', 255))
   42 |         v_min = max(25, int(getattr(profile, 'v_min', 30)))
   43 |         v_max = int(getattr(profile, 'v_max', 255))
   44 |         
   45 |         lower_hsv = np.array([h_min, s_min, v_min])
   46 |         upper_hsv = np.array([h_max, s_max, v_max])
   47 |         mask_hsv = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_hsv, upper_hsv)
   48 |         
   49 |         # 3. Umbralizado en espacio LAB (El canal A < 126 representa tonos verdes puros)
   50 |         lab = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)
   51 |         l_min = int(getattr(profile, 'l_min', 20))
   52 |         l_max = int(getattr(profile, 'l_max', 255))
   53 |         a_max = min(126, int(getattr(profile, 'a_max', 124)))
   54 |         b_min = max(115, int(getattr(profile, 'b_min', 120)))
   55 |         
   56 |         lower_lab = np.array([l_min, 0, b_min])
   57 |         upper_lab = np.array([l_max, a_max, 255])
   58 |         mask_lab = cv2.inRange(lab, lower_lab, upper_lab)
   59 |         
   60 |         # 4. Fusión de máscaras (Intersección ExG + HSV + LAB)
   61 |         mask = cv2.bitwise_and(exg_mask, mask_hsv)
   62 |         mask = cv2.bitwise_and(mask, mask_lab)
   63 |         
   64 |         # Si la intersección con LAB elimina demasiados píxeles por iluminación, respaldar con ExG & HSV
   65 |         if cv2.countNonZero(mask) < 0.25 * cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(exg_mask, mask_hsv)):
   66 |             mask = cv2.bitwise_and(exg_mask, mask_hsv)
   67 |         
   68 |         # 5. Filtrado morfológico de ruido
   69 |         kernel_close = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (3, 3))
   70 |         kernel_open = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (3, 3))
   71 |         mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel_close)
   72 |         mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel_open)
   73 |         
   74 |         return mask
   75 | 
   76 |     @staticmethod
   77 |     def extract_valid_contours(mask, min_area=30):
   78 |         """
   79 |         Encuentra y filtra contornos por un área mínima en píxeles.
   80 |         Ajustado a 30px para capturar tallos finos y brotes como el cebollín.
   81 |         """
   82 |         if mask is None:
   83 |             return []
   84 |         contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
   85 |         return [c for c in contours if cv2.contourArea(c) >= min_area]
   86 |

    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental
    2 | # Autores: Andrés Felipe Luna Camargo, Cristian David Peña Martínez

    5 | from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
    6 | from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
    7 | from infrastructure.database.connection import db
    8 | 
    9 | class BiometricMetric(db.Model):
   10 |     """Entidad que registra los parámetros biométricos y rutas de imagen procesadas."""
   11 |     __tablename__ = 'biometric_metric'
   12 |     
   13 |     id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
   14 |     session_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('capture_session.id'), nullable=False, index=True)
   15 |     session = relationship("CaptureSession", back_populates="metrics")
   16 |     
   17 |     photo_index = Column(Integer, default=0) # 0 = Promedio del período, 1..5 = Toma individual
   18 |     is_average = Column(Boolean, default=False) # True si representa el consolidado del lote

   33 |

   61 |             "personalizado": "Acceso Personalizado"

   67 |         """Retorna la URL web del avatar si tiene foto subida."""

   69 |             clean = self.avatar_path.replace('\\', '/')
   70 |             if not clean.startswith('/') and not clean.startswith('http'):
   71 |                 clean = '/' + clean
   72 |             return clean
   73 |         return None

   80 |         parts = self.full_name.strip().split()
   81 |         if len(parts) >= 2:
   82 |             return f"{parts[0][0]}{parts[1][0]}".upper()
   83 |         return parts[0][:2].upper()

   85 |     def get_permissions_dict(self) -> Dict[str, bool]:
   86 |         """Retorna el mapa booleano de permisos del usuario para cada módulo."""
   87 |         if self.is_super_admin:
   88 |             return {k: True for k, _, _, _ in ALL_MODULE_PERMISSIONS}
   89 |         
   90 |         parsed = {}
   91 |         if self.permissions:
   92 |             try:
   93 |                 parsed = json.loads(self.permissions)
   94 |             except Exception:
   95 |                 parsed = {}
   96 | 
   97 |         # Fallback predeterminado según el rol si no tiene JSON explícito
   98 |         if not parsed:
   99 |             if self.role == "investigador":
  100 |                 parsed = {
  101 |                     "dashboard": True,
  102 |                     "calendar": True,
  103 |                     "processing": False,
  104 |                     "gallery": True,

  107 |                     "cross_analysis": True,

  119 |                     "sensors": True,

  124 |             else:

  127 |         # Asegurar que todas las llaves existan
  128 |         res = {}
  129 |         for k, _, _, _ in ALL_MODULE_PERMISSIONS:
  130 |             res[k] = bool(parsed.get(k, False))
  131 |         return res

  144 |             clean = {k: bool(perms_dict.get(k, False)) for k, _, _, _ in ALL_MODULE_PERMISSIONS}

   52 |         h, w, _ = image.shape

  141 |     def measure_stem_in_roi(self, image: np.ndarray, config: Optional[Any], profile: CropProfile) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  142 |         """
  143 |         Escanea la franja/cuadro interactivo de la base del tallo para medir su calibre
  144 |         utilizando análisis de gradiente horizontal (bordes del cilindro) e intensidad,
  145 |         independiente de si el tallo es verde, café, leñoso u oliva.
  146 |         """
  147 |         h, w = image.shape[:2]
  148 |         
  149 |         # Parámetros del ROI de tallo
  150 |         stem_roi_x = getattr(config, 'lateral_stem_roi_x', 0.5000) if config else 0.5000
  151 |         stem_roi_y = getattr(config, 'lateral_stem_roi_y', 0.6600) if config else 0.6600
  152 |         stem_roi_w = getattr(config, 'lateral_stem_roi_width', 0.2000) if config else 0.2000
  153 |         stem_roi_h = getattr(config, 'lateral_stem_roi_height', 0.0500) if config else 0.0500
  154 |         
  155 |         cx = int(w * float(stem_roi_x))
  156 |         cy = int(h * float(stem_roi_y))
  157 |         box_w = max(24, int(w * float(stem_roi_w)))
  158 |         box_h = max(10, int(h * float(stem_roi_h)))
  159 |         
  160 |         x1 = max(0, cx - box_w // 2)
  161 |         x2 = min(w, cx + box_w // 2)
  162 |         y1 = max(0, cy - box_h // 2)
  163 |         y2 = min(h, cy + box_h // 2)
  164 |         
  165 |         lateral_ratio = getattr(profile, 'lat_pixel_to_cm_ratio', None)
  166 |         if lateral_ratio is None or lateral_ratio <= 0:
  167 |             lateral_ratio = profile.pixel_to_cm_ratio
  168 |             
  169 |         roi = image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
  170 |         if roi.size == 0:
  171 |             return {
  172 |                 "stem_diameter_mm": 0.0,
  173 |                 "stem_box": (x1, y1, x2, y2),
  174 |                 "stem_x_left": None,
  175 |                 "stem_x_right": None,
  176 |                 "stem_y_mid": cy
  177 |             }
  178 |             
  179 |         # 1. Convertir a escala de grises y suavizar para reducir ruido de impresión 3D
  180 |         gray = cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
  181 |         blurred = cv2.GaussianBlur(gray, (5, 5), 0)
  182 |         
  183 |         # 2. Gradiente Horizontal Sobel (resalta las dos paredes verticales del tallo cilíndrico)
  184 |         grad_x = cv2.Sobel(blurred, cv2.CV_64F, 1, 0, ksize=3)
  185 |         abs_grad_x = np.abs(grad_x)
  186 |         
  187 |         detected_widths = []
  188 |         detected_lefts = []
  189 |         detected_rights = []
  190 |         detected_ys = []
  191 |         
  192 |         roi_mid = (x2 - x1) // 2
  193 |         
  194 |         for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
  195 |             actual_y = y1 + r
  196 |             row_profile = abs_grad_x[r, :]
  197 |             
  198 |             # Buscar el pico de gradiente más fuerte a la izquierda del centro
  199 |             left_half = row_profile[:roi_mid]
  200 |             right_half = row_profile[roi_mid:]
  201 |             
  202 |             if len(left_half) > 3 and len(right_half) > 3:
  203 |                 left_idx = np.argmax(left_half)
  204 |                 right_idx = roi_mid + np.argmax(right_half)
  205 |                 
  206 |                 width_px = right_idx - left_idx
  207 |                 # Validar que el ancho detectado sea razonable para un tallo botánico (ej: 4 a 60 px)
  208 |                 if 4 <= width_px <= int((x2 - x1) * 0.85):
  209 |                     if row_profile[left_idx] > 6 and row_profile[right_idx] > 6:
  210 |                         detected_widths.append(width_px)
  211 |                         detected_lefts.append(x1 + left_idx)
  212 |                         detected_rights.append(x1 + right_idx)
  213 |                         detected_ys.append(actual_y)
  214 |                         
  215 |         if detected_widths:
  216 |             median_width = float(np.median(detected_widths))
  217 |             stem_diameter_mm = median_width * lateral_ratio * 10.0 # Conversión de cm a mm
  218 |             stem_x_left = int(np.median(detected_lefts))
  219 |             stem_x_right = int(np.median(detected_rights))
  220 |             stem_y_mid = int(np.median(detected_ys))
  221 |         else:
  222 |             # Umbralización adaptativa como respaldo en caso de bajo contraste
  223 |             _, thresh = cv2.threshold(blurred, 0, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV + cv2.THRESH_OTSU)
  224 |             cnts, _ = cv2.findContours(thresh, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
  225 |             if cnts:
  226 |                 best_c = max(cnts, key=cv2.contourArea)
  227 |                 bx, by, bw, bh = cv2.boundingRect(best_c)
  228 |                 if 4 <= bw <= int((x2 - x1) * 0.85):
  229 |                     median_width = float(bw)
  230 |                     stem_diameter_mm = median_width * lateral_ratio * 10.0
  231 |                     stem_x_left = x1 + bx
  232 |                     stem_x_right = x1 + bx + bw
  233 |                     stem_y_mid = y1 + by + bh // 2
  234 |                 else:
  235 |                     stem_diameter_mm = 0.0
  236 |                     stem_x_left = None
  237 |                     stem_x_right = None
  238 |                     stem_y_mid = cy
  239 |             else:
  240 |                 stem_diameter_mm = 0.0
  241 |                 stem_x_left = None
  242 |                 stem_x_right = None
  243 |                 stem_y_mid = cy
  244 |                 
  245 |         return {
  246 |             "stem_diameter_mm": round(stem_diameter_mm, 2),
  247 |             "stem_box": (x1, y1, x2, y2),
  248 |             "stem_x_left": stem_x_left,
  249 |             "stem_x_right": stem_x_right,
  250 |             "stem_y_mid": stem_y_mid
  251 |         }

   14 | class VisionPipelineManager:
   15 |     """
   16 |     Orquestador del pipeline de visión artificial agronómica SIFMA.
   17 |     - Corrige orientación física de las cámaras (Cenital 180° / Lateral 90° derecha).
   18 |     - Aplica ROI circular automático sobre la canastilla azul (anula personas, ropa y fondo).
   19 |     - Mide altura y tallo basal con precisión milimétrica desde la base del sustrato.
   20 |     """
   21 |     
   22 |     def __init__(
   23 |         self, 
   24 |         segmentation_strategy: Optional[ISegmentationStrategy] = None,
   25 |         biometric_calculator: Optional[IBiometricCalculator] = None
   26 |     ):
   27 |         self.segmenter = segmentation_strategy or ExgSegmentationStrategy()
   28 |         self.calculator = biometric_calculator or BiometricCalculator()
   29 | 
   30 |     @staticmethod
   31 |     def is_cenital_inverted(img: np.ndarray) -> bool:
   32 |         """
   33 |         Detecta si la foto cenital está de cabeza (al revés con la base del tubo abajo).
   34 |         Si la base azul está abajo, retorna True para requerir rotación de 180°.
   35 |         """
   36 |         h, w = img.shape[:2]
   37 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   38 |         mask_blue = cv2.inRange(hsv, np.array([95, 50, 40]), np.array([135, 255, 255]))
   39 |         col_w_start, col_w_end = int(w * 0.40), int(w * 0.60)
   40 |         top_blue = cv2.countNonZero(mask_blue[:int(h * 0.20), col_w_start:col_w_end])
   41 |         bottom_blue = cv2.countNonZero(mask_blue[int(h * 0.80):, col_w_start:col_w_end])
   42 |         return bottom_blue > top_blue
   43 | 
   44 |     @staticmethod
   45 |     def orient_lateral_upright(img: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
   46 |         """
   47 |         Asegura que la foto lateral quede con orientación vertical perfecta:
   48 |         canastilla azul con arlita en la base inferior y planta creciendo erguida hacia arriba.
   49 |         """
   50 |         h, w = img.shape[:2]
   51 |         # 1. Si está en formato horizontal (sensor apaisado), rotar a vertical
   52 |         if w > h:
   53 |             img = cv2.rotate(img, cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE)
   54 |             h, w = img.shape[:2]
   55 | 
   56 |         # 2. Verificar que la arlita (sustrato de cultivo) esté en la mitad inferior
   57 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   58 |         mask_arlita = cv2.inRange(hsv, np.array([5, 60, 40]), np.array([22, 255, 180]))
   59 |         pts = np.argwhere(mask_arlita > 0)
   60 | 
   61 |         if len(pts) > 500:
   62 |             mean_y = np.mean(pts[:, 0])
   63 |             # Si el sustrato está en la mitad superior (mean_y < h/2), la planta está de cabeza -> rotar 180°
   64 |             if mean_y < (h / 2.0):
   65 |                 img = cv2.rotate(img, cv2.ROTATE_180)
   66 | 
   67 |         return img

   69 |     @staticmethod
   70 |     def detect_blue_basket_roi(image: np.ndarray) -> tuple:
   71 |         """
   72 |         Detecta con precisión sub-milimétrica la canastilla circular azul individual donde
   73 |         está plantado el cultivo activo, aislando arlita y follaje, anulando el fondo de laboratorio.
   74 |         Retorna: (centro_x, centro_y, radio)
   75 |         """
   76 |         h_img, w_img = image.shape[:2]
   77 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   78 |         
   79 |         # 1. Segmentación de vegetación activa
   80 |         lower_green = np.array([25, 30, 30])
   81 |         upper_green = np.array([88, 255, 255])
   82 |         mask_green = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_green, upper_green)
   83 |         
   84 |         b, g, r = cv2.split(image.astype(np.float32))
   85 |         exg = 2.0 * g - r - b
   86 |         exg_mask = np.uint8((exg > 15) & (g > r) & (g > b)) * 255
   87 |         plant_mask = cv2.bitwise_or(mask_green, exg_mask)
   88 |         
   89 |         # 2. Segmentación estricta del plástico azul de la canastilla
   90 |         lower_blue = np.array([95, 50, 40])
   91 |         upper_blue = np.array([135, 255, 255])
   92 |         mask_blue = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_blue, upper_blue)
   93 |         
   94 |         # Kernel elíptico moderado para mantener la individualidad del aro
   95 |         kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (5, 5))
   96 |         mask_blue_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_blue, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel)
   97 |         mask_blue_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_blue_clean, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel)
   98 |         
   99 |         contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask_blue_clean, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
  100 |         
  101 |         # Rango exacto del radio de una canastilla azul individual (~10% a 14% de la altura)
  102 |         min_radius = int(min(w_img, h_img) * 0.08)
  103 |         max_radius = int(min(w_img, h_img) * 0.15)
  104 |         candidates = []
  105 |         
  106 |         for c in contours:
  107 |             area = cv2.contourArea(c)
  108 |             if area < 3000 or area > 600000:
  109 |                 continue
  110 |                 
  111 |             (cx, cy), radius = cv2.minEnclosingCircle(c)
  112 |             radius = int(radius)
  113 |             if radius < min_radius or radius > max_radius:
  114 |                 continue
  115 |                 
  116 |             peri = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
  117 |             circularity = (4 * np.pi * area) / (peri * peri) if peri > 0 else 0
  118 |             
  119 |             bx, by, bw, bh = cv2.boundingRect(c)
  120 |             aspect_ratio = float(bw) / float(bh) if bh > 0 else 0
  121 |             
  122 |             # Solo evaluar canastillas ubicadas en la columna central de la torre
  123 |             if not (w_img * 0.38 <= cx <= w_img * 0.62 and h_img * 0.30 <= cy <= h_img * 0.60):
  124 |                 continue
  125 |                 
  126 |             c_mask = np.zeros((h_img, w_img), dtype=np.uint8)
  127 |             cv2.circle(c_mask, (int(cx), int(cy)), radius, 255, -1)
  128 |             green_inside = cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(plant_mask, c_mask))
  129 |             
  130 |             # Puntuación agrónoma:
  131 |             # - Máxima presencia de planta
  132 |             # - Circularidad geométrica
  133 |             # - Relación de aspecto ~ 1.0 (aro circular)
  134 |             aspect_diff = abs(1.0 - aspect_ratio)
  135 |             score = (green_inside * 4.0) + (circularity * 3000.0) - (aspect_diff * 800.0)
  136 |             
  137 |             candidates.append({
  138 |                 'cx': int(cx), 'cy': int(cy), 'radius': radius,
  139 |                 'green_inside': green_inside, 'score': score
  140 |             })
  141 |             
  142 |         if candidates:
  143 |             best = max(candidates, key=lambda k: k['score'])
  144 |     def detect_blue_basket_roi(self, img: np.ndarray, config: Optional[Any] = None) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
  145 |         """
  146 |         Calcula el ROI cenital. Si el usuario configuró coordenadas personalizadas en Config,
  147 |         las utiliza; de lo contrario busca el aro azul automáticamente con fallback agrónomo.
  148 |         """
  149 |         h_img, w_img = img.shape[:2]
  150 |         
  151 |         # 1. Si hay configuración explícita guardada por el usuario
  152 |         if config is not None:
  153 |             cx_ratio = getattr(config, 'cenital_roi_cx', None)
  154 |             cy_ratio = getattr(config, 'cenital_roi_cy', None)
  155 |             rad_ratio = getattr(config, 'cenital_roi_radius', None)
  156 |             if cx_ratio is not None and cy_ratio is not None and rad_ratio is not None:
  157 |                 cx = int(w_img * float(cx_ratio))
  158 |                 cy = int(h_img * float(cy_ratio))
  159 |                 radius = int(min(w_img, h_img) * float(rad_ratio))
  160 |                 return cx, cy, radius
  161 | 
  162 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
  163 |         mask_blue = cv2.inRange(hsv, np.array([90, 45, 30]), np.array([140, 255, 255]))
  164 |         plant_mask = self.segmenter.create_mask(img, CropProfile(crop_type="detect", display_name="detect"))
  165 |         
  166 |         kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (5, 5))
  167 |         mask_blue_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_blue, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel)
  168 |         mask_blue_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_blue_clean, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel)
  169 |         
  170 |         contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask_blue_clean, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
  171 |         
  172 |         min_radius = int(min(w_img, h_img) * 0.08)
  173 |         max_radius = int(min(w_img, h_img) * 0.18)
  174 |         candidates = []
  175 |         
  176 |         for c in contours:
  177 |             area = cv2.contourArea(c)
  178 |             if area < 3000 or area > 600000:
  179 |                 continue
  180 |                 
  181 |             (cx, cy), radius = cv2.minEnclosingCircle(c)
  182 |             radius = int(radius)
  183 |             if radius < min_radius or radius > max_radius:
  184 |                 continue
  185 |                 
  186 |             peri = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
  187 |             circularity = (4 * np.pi * area) / (peri * peri) if peri > 0 else 0
  188 |             
  189 |             bx, by, bw, bh = cv2.boundingRect(c)
  190 |             aspect_ratio = float(bw) / float(bh) if bh > 0 else 0
  191 |             
  192 |             if not (w_img * 0.35 <= cx <= w_img * 0.65 and h_img * 0.28 <= cy <= h_img * 0.62):
  193 |                 continue
  194 |                 
  195 |             c_mask = np.zeros((h_img, w_img), dtype=np.uint8)
  196 |             cv2.circle(c_mask, (int(cx), int(cy)), radius, 255, -1)
  197 |             green_inside = cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(plant_mask, c_mask))
  198 |             
  199 |             aspect_diff = abs(1.0 - aspect_ratio)
  200 |             score = (green_inside * 4.0) + (circularity * 3000.0) - (aspect_diff * 800.0)
  201 |             
  202 |             candidates.append({
  203 |                 'cx': int(cx), 'cy': int(cy), 'radius': radius,
  204 |                 'green_inside': green_inside, 'score': score
  205 |             })
  206 |             
  207 |         if candidates:
  208 |             best = max(candidates, key=lambda k: k['score'])
  209 |             return best['cx'], best['cy'], int(best['radius'] * 1.05)
  210 |             
  211 |         # Calibración agrónoma física central por defecto
  212 |         calib_cx = int(w_img * 0.4955)
  213 |         calib_cy = int(h_img * 0.4408)
  214 |         calib_radius = int(min(w_img, h_img) * 0.145)
  215 |         return calib_cx, calib_cy, calib_radius
  216 | 
  217 |     def process_cenital(self, image_path: str, output_path: str, profile: CropProfile, config: Optional[Any] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
  218 |         os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
  219 |         img_raw = cv2.imread(image_path)
  220 |         if img_raw is None:
  221 |             return None
  222 | 
  223 |         # 1. Rotación de 180° antes de procesar si está al revés
  224 |         if self.is_cenital_inverted(img_raw):
  225 |             img = cv2.rotate(img_raw, cv2.ROTATE_180)
  226 |             cv2.imwrite(image_path, img)
  227 |         else:
  228 |             img = img_raw
  229 | 
  230 |         h_img, w_img = img.shape[:2]
  231 | 
  232 |         # 2. Obtención de centro y radio del ROI (Manual o Automático)
  233 |         cx, cy, radius = self.detect_blue_basket_roi(img, config=config)
  234 |         roi_mode = getattr(config, 'cenital_roi_mode', 'dynamic_conn') if config else 'dynamic_conn'
  235 |         
  236 |         roi_mask = np.zeros((h_img, w_img), dtype=np.uint8)
  237 |         cv2.circle(roi_mask, (cx, cy), radius, 255, -1)
  238 | 
  239 |         # 3. Segmentación foliar
  240 |         raw_leaf_mask = self.segmenter.create_mask(img, profile)
  241 |         
  242 |         # Filtro Inteligente de Componentes Conectados (Filtro Anti-Plantas Vecinas)
  243 |         if roi_mode == 'dynamic_conn':
  244 |             # Aplicar ROI amplio y filtrar islas desconectadas que pertenezcan a otras canastillas
  245 |             bounded_leaf = cv2.bitwise_and(raw_leaf_mask, roi_mask)
  246 |             num_labels, labels, stats, centroids = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(bounded_leaf, connectivity=8)
  247 |             
  248 |             # Centroide de la canastilla
  249 |             target_mask = np.zeros_like(bounded_leaf)
  250 |             inner_core_radius = max(15, int(radius * 0.45))
  251 |             
  252 |             for label_idx in range(1, num_labels):
  253 |                 area = stats[label_idx, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]
  254 |                 if area < 25:
  255 |                     continue
  256 |                 comp_mask = (labels == label_idx).astype(np.uint8)
  257 |                 
  258 |                 # Verificar si el componente toca el núcleo central de la canastilla
  259 |                 # o está lo suficientemente cerca del centro
  260 |                 dist_to_center = np.sqrt((centroids[label_idx][0] - cx)**2 + (centroids[label_idx][1] - cy)**2)
  261 |                 
  262 |                 # Si está dentro del rango o toca la zona central
  263 |                 comp_core_overlap = cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(comp_mask, cv2.circle(np.zeros_like(comp_mask), (cx, cy), inner_core_radius, 255, -1)))
  264 |                 
  265 |                 if comp_core_overlap > 0 or dist_to_center <= (radius * 0.85):
  266 |                     target_mask = cv2.bitwise_or(target_mask, comp_mask * 255)
  267 |                     
  268 |             mask = target_mask if cv2.countNonZero(target_mask) > 0 else bounded_leaf
  269 |         else:
  270 |             mask = cv2.bitwise_and(raw_leaf_mask, roi_mask)
  271 |             
  272 |         contours = self.segmenter.extract_contours(mask, min_area=25)
  273 |         
  274 |         # 4. Cálculo de Biometría Foliar
  275 |         metrics = self.calculator.calculate_cenital(img, mask, contours, profile)
  276 |         
  277 |         # 5. Generación de Overlay de visualización
  278 |         overlay = img.copy()
  279 |         
  280 |         # Dibujar círculo de delimitación del ROI
  281 |         cv2.circle(overlay, (cx, cy), radius, (255, 180, 0), 3)  # Círculo cian/azul claro
  282 |         # Cruz central de anclaje
  283 |         cross_len = 16
  284 |         cv2.line(overlay, (cx - cross_len, cy), (cx + cross_len, cy), (0, 255, 0), 2)
  285 |         cv2.line(overlay, (cx, cy - cross_len), (cx, cy + cross_len), (0, 255, 0), 2)
  286 |         
  287 |         cv2.putText(overlay, "ROI", (max(20, cx - 100), max(30, cy - radius - 12)), 
  288 |                     cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.70, (255, 180, 0), 2)
  289 | 
  290 |         if contours:
  291 |             # Dibujar contornos foliares en ROJO puro
  292 |             cv2.drawContours(overlay, contours, -1, (0, 0, 255), 2)
  293 |             
  294 |             # Envoltura convexa de la canopia
  295 |             all_pts = np.vstack(contours)
  296 |             if len(all_pts) >= 3:
  297 |                 hull = cv2.convexHull(all_pts)
  298 |                 cv2.drawContours(overlay, [hull], -1, (0, 0, 255), 2)
  299 |             
  300 |         metrics["fruits_count"] = 0
  301 |         metrics["spots_count"] = 0
  302 |         
  303 |         # Superponer leyenda de métricas biométricas
  304 |         cv2.putText(overlay, f"Area Foliar: {metrics['area_cm2']:.1f} cm2", (20, 40), 
  305 |                     cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (0, 0, 255), 2)
  306 |         cv2.putText(overlay, f"Salud Foliar: {metrics['health_index']:.1f}%", (20, 75), 
  307 |                     cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (0, 255, 0), 2)
  308 |                         
  309 |         cv2.imwrite(output_path, overlay)
  310 |         return metrics
  311 | 
  312 |     def process_lateral(self, image_path: str, output_path: str, profile: CropProfile, config: Optional[Any] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
  313 |         os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
  314 |         img_raw = cv2.imread(image_path)
  315 |         if img_raw is None:
  316 |             return None
  317 | 
  318 |         # 1. Orientación vertical erguida antes de procesar
  319 |         img = self.orient_lateral_upright(img_raw)

  346 |                 cv2.drawContours(overlay, plant_contours, -1, (0, 0, 255), 2)
  347 |             
  348 |             y_min = metrics.get("y_min")  # Ápice foliar superior (detectado por OpenCV)

  353 |                 x_center = int(np.mean(x_points))

  357 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (x_center - 25, y_max), (x_center + 25, y_max), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  358 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (x_center, y_min), (x_center, y_max), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  359 |
