  362 |                             cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.75, (0, 255, 255), 2)
  363 |                 
  364 |             # 4. Dibujar Cuadro ROI de Tallo y Medición de Diámetro
  365 |             stem_box = metrics.get("stem_box")
  366 |             stem_x_left = metrics.get("stem_x_left")
  367 |             stem_x_right = metrics.get("stem_x_right")
  368 |             stem_y_mid = metrics.get("stem_y_mid")
  369 |             stem_d = metrics.get("stem_diameter_mm", 0.0)
  370 | 
  371 |             if stem_box:
  372 |                 bx1, by1, bx2, by2 = stem_box
  373 |                 # Dibujar recuadro de la zona de escaneo en naranja/ámbar
  374 |                 cv2.rectangle(overlay, (bx1, by1), (bx2, by2), (255, 165, 0), 1)
  375 |                 cv2.putText(overlay, "SCAN TALLO", (bx1, max(18, by1 - 5)),
  376 |                             cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.42, (255, 165, 0), 1)
  377 |                 
  378 |             if stem_x_left is not None and stem_x_right is not None and stem_d > 0 and stem_y_mid is not None:
  379 |                 # Línea de medición de calibre del tallo con topes verticales
  380 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (stem_x_left, stem_y_mid), (stem_x_right, stem_y_mid), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  381 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (stem_x_left, stem_y_mid - 4), (stem_x_left, stem_y_mid + 4), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  382 |                 cv2.line(overlay, (stem_x_right, stem_y_mid - 4), (stem_x_right, stem_y_mid + 4), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  383 |                 cv2.putText(overlay, f"D: {stem_d:.1f} mm", (bx2 + 8 if stem_box else stem_x_right + 12, stem_y_mid + 5),
  384 |                             cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.65, (0, 255, 255), 2)
  385 |                                 
  386 |         cv2.imwrite(output_path, overlay)
  387 |         return {
  388 |             "plant_height_cm": metrics.get("height_cm", 0.0),
  389 |             "stem_diameter_mm": metrics.get("stem_diameter_mm", 0.0)
  390 |         }

  392 |     @staticmethod
  393 |     def filter_and_average(cenital_results: List[Dict[str, Any]], lateral_results: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  394 |         """Elimina valores atípicos (+- 2 desviaciones estándar) y calcula medias robustas del lote."""
  395 |         final_metrics = {
  396 |             "foliar_area_cm2": 0.0,
  397 |             "health_index": 100.0,
  398 |             "compacity_index": 0.0,
  399 |             "spots_count": 0,
  400 |             "fruits_count": 0,
  401 |             "plant_height_cm": 0.0,
  402 |             "stem_diameter_mm": 0.0
  403 |         }
  404 |         
  405 |         def get_robust_mean(data_list):
  406 |             if not data_list: return 0.0
  407 |             if len(data_list) <= 2: return float(np.mean(data_list))
  408 |             mean = float(np.mean(data_list))
  409 |             std = float(np.std(data_list))
  410 |             if std == 0: return mean
  411 |             filtered = [x for x in data_list if abs(x - mean) <= 2 * std]
  412 |             return float(np.mean(filtered)) if filtered else mean
  413 | 
  414 |         if cenital_results:
  415 |             areas = [r.get("area_cm2", 0.0) for r in cenital_results]
  416 |             healths = [r.get("health_index", 100.0) for r in cenital_results]
  417 |             compacities = [r.get("compacity_index", 0.0) for r in cenital_results]
  418 |             
  419 |             final_metrics["foliar_area_cm2"] = round(get_robust_mean(areas), 2)
  420 |             final_metrics["health_index"] = round(get_robust_mean(healths), 2)
  421 |             final_metrics["compacity_index"] = round(get_robust_mean(compacities), 3)
  422 |             
  423 |         if lateral_results:
  424 |             heights = [r.get("plant_height_cm", 0.0) for r in lateral_results]
  425 |             diameters = [r.get("stem_diameter_mm", 0.0) for r in lateral_results]
  426 |             
  427 |             final_metrics["plant_height_cm"] = round(get_robust_mean(heights), 2)
  428 |             final_metrics["stem_diameter_mm"] = round(get_robust_mean(diameters), 2)
  429 |             
  430 |         return final_metrics

    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental
    2 | # Autores: Andrés Felipe Luna Camargo, Cristian David Peña Martínez

    6 | import cv2
    7 | import numpy as np

    9 | 
   10 | class ExgSegmentationStrategy:
   11 |     """
   12 |     Estrategia de segmentación botánica avanzada basada en el Índice de Exceso de Verde (ExG),
   13 |     combinado con filtrado HSV de clorofila y canal LAB.
   14 |     (Pattern: Strategy)
   15 |     """
   16 |     
   17 |     def create_mask(self, image: np.ndarray, profile: CropProfile, is_lateral: bool = False) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
   18 |         """
   19 |         Genera la máscara binaria aislando exclusivamente tejido vegetal.
   20 |         Descarta piel humana, tierra, sustratos y plástico blanco.
   21 |         Soporta calibración independiente para vista cenital y vista lateral.
   22 |         """
   23 |         if image is None:
   24 |             return None
   25 |             
   26 |         # 1. Índice de Exceso de Verde (ExG = 2*G - R - B)
   27 |         b, g, r = cv2.split(image.astype(np.float32))
   28 |         exg = 2.0 * g - r - b
   29 |         
   30 |         # En vista lateral se usa un umbral ExG más sensible para captar tallos finos basales
   31 |         exg_thresh = 6.0 if is_lateral else 10.0
   32 |         exg_mask = (exg > exg_thresh).astype(np.uint8) * 255
   33 |         
   34 |         # 2. Umbralizado en espacio HSV para clorofila
   35 |         hsv = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
   36 |         if is_lateral:
   37 |             h_min = max(20, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_h_min', None) or 22))
   38 |             h_max = min(96, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_h_max', None) or 92))
   39 |             s_min = max(20, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_s_min', None) or 25))
   40 |             s_max = int(getattr(profile, 'lat_s_max', None) or 255)
   41 |             v_min = max(20, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_v_min', None) or 25))
   42 |             v_max = int(getattr(profile, 'lat_v_max', None) or 255)
   43 |             
   44 |             l_min = max(10, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_l_min', None) or 15))
   45 |             l_max = int(getattr(profile, 'lat_l_max', None) or 255)
   46 |             # Canal A < 122 discrimina el fondo blanco sin cortar tallos
   47 |             a_max = min(124, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_a_max', None) or 122))
   48 |             b_min = max(115, int(getattr(profile, 'lat_b_min', None) or 118))
   49 |         else:
   50 |             h_min = max(24, int(getattr(profile, 'h_min', None) or 28))
   51 |             h_max = min(96, int(getattr(profile, 'h_max', None) or 90))
   52 |             s_min = max(30, int(getattr(profile, 's_min', None) or 35))
   53 |             s_max = int(getattr(profile, 's_max', None) or 255)
   54 |             v_min = max(25, int(getattr(profile, 'v_min', None) or 30))
   55 |             v_max = int(getattr(profile, 'v_max', None) or 255)
   56 |             
   57 |             l_min = int(getattr(profile, 'l_min', None) or 20)
   58 |             l_max = int(getattr(profile, 'l_max', None) or 255)
   59 |             a_max = min(126, int(getattr(profile, 'a_max', None) or 124))
   60 |             b_min = max(115, int(getattr(profile, 'b_min', None) or 120))
   61 |         
   62 |         lower_hsv = np.array([h_min, s_min, v_min])
   63 |         upper_hsv = np.array([h_max, s_max, v_max])
   64 |         mask_hsv = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_hsv, upper_hsv)
   65 |         
   66 |         # 3. Umbralizado en espacio LAB
   67 |         lab = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)
   68 |         lower_lab = np.array([l_min, 0, b_min])
   69 |         upper_lab = np.array([l_max, a_max, 255])
   70 |         mask_lab = cv2.inRange(lab, lower_lab, upper_lab)
   71 |         
   72 |         # 4. Fusión de máscaras por intersección
   73 |         mask = cv2.bitwise_and(exg_mask, mask_hsv)
   74 |         mask = cv2.bitwise_and(mask, mask_lab)
   75 |         
   76 |         # Fallback de respaldo SOLO para vista cenital (en lateral LAB es fundamental para anular bordes)
   77 |         if not is_lateral:
   78 |             if cv2.countNonZero(mask) < 0.25 * cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(exg_mask, mask_hsv)):
   79 |                 mask = cv2.bitwise_and(exg_mask, mask_hsv)
   80 |             
   81 |         # 5. Filtrado morfológico de ruido
   82 |         k_size = (5, 5) if is_lateral else (3, 3)
   83 |         kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, k_size)
   84 |         mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel)
   85 |         mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel)
   86 |         
   87 |         return mask
   88 | 
   89 |     def extract_contours(self, mask: np.ndarray, min_area: int = 30) -> List[np.ndarray]:
   90 |         """Extrae y filtra contornos por tamaño mínimo en píxeles."""
   91 |         if mask is None:
   92 |             return []
   93 |         contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
   94 |         return [c for c in contours if cv2.contourArea(c) >= min_area]

   92 | def role_required(*allowed_roles):
   93 |     """Decorador para proteger rutas según el rol del usuario."""
   94 |     def decorator(f):
   95 |         @wraps(f)
   96 |         def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
   97 |             if not session.get('logged_in'):
   98 |                 return redirect(url_for('dashboard.login'))
   99 |             user_role = session.get('user_role', 'investigador')
  100 |             if user_role not in allowed_roles and user_role != 'admin' and session.get('username', '').lower() != 'admin':
  101 |                 return render_template('error.html', 
  102 |                                        error_title="Acceso Restringido", 
  103 |                                        error_message="Esta sección es exclusiva del Super Usuario / Administrador Principal."), 403
  104 |             return f(*args, **kwargs)
  105 |         return decorated_function
  106 |     return decorator

  108 | def permission_required(permission_key: str, module_name: str = "este módulo"):
  109 |     """Decorador para proteger rutas según los permisos granulares asignados por el Super Usuario."""
  110 |     def decorator(f):
  111 |         @wraps(f)
  112 |         def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
  113 |             if not session.get('logged_in'):
  114 |                 return redirect(url_for('dashboard.login'))
  115 |             
  116 |             if session.get('user_role') == 'admin' or session.get('username', '').lower() == 'admin':
  117 |                 return f(*args, **kwargs)
  118 | 
  119 |             perms = session.get('user_permissions')
  120 |             if not perms or not isinstance(perms, dict):
  121 |                 u_id = session.get("user_id")
  122 |                 if u_id:
  123 |                     u_obj = user_service.get_user_by_id(u_id)
  124 |                     if u_obj:
  125 |                         perms = u_obj.get_permissions_dict()
  126 |                         session['user_permissions'] = perms
  127 |             
  128 |             perms = perms or {}
  129 |             if not perms.get(permission_key, False):
  130 |                 # Si el usuario intenta entrar al index('/') pero no tiene dashboard, redirigir a su primer módulo habilitado
  131 |                 if request.endpoint == 'dashboard.index':
  132 |                     for alt_key, alt_endpoint in [
  133 |                         ('calendar', 'dashboard.calendar_view'),
  134 |                         ('sensors', 'dashboard.detailed_sensors'),
  135 |                         ('cross_analysis', 'dashboard.cross_analysis'),
  136 |                         ('gallery', 'dashboard.gallery'),
  137 |                         ('timelapse', 'dashboard.timelapse_viewer'),
  138 |                         ('processing', 'dashboard.processing_panel'),
  139 |                         ('config', 'dashboard.configuration_panel')
  140 |                     ]:
  141 |                         if perms.get(alt_key):
  142 |                             return redirect(url_for(alt_endpoint))
  143 | 
  144 |                 return render_template('error.html', 
  145 |                                        error_title="Acceso Restringido", 
  146 |                                        error_message=f"Tu cuenta no posee permisos para acceder a '{module_name}'. Solicita al Administrador Principal que te habilite esta función."), 403
  147 |             return f(*args, **kwargs)
  148 |         return decorated_function
  149 |     return decorator

  254 | {% block scripts %}
  255 | <script>
  256 | async function handleDeleteSingleLog(logId) {
  257 |     if (!confirm(`¿Estás seguro de que deseas eliminar este registro de auditoría (#${logId})?`)) return;
  258 | 
  259 |     try {
  260 |         const res = await fetch(`/api/audit-logs/${logId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
  261 |         const data = await res.json();
  262 |         if (data.status === 'success') {
  263 |             const row = document.getElementById(`log-row-${logId}`);
  264 |             if (row) {
  265 |                 row.style.opacity = '0';
  266 |                 row.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
  267 |                 setTimeout(() => {
  268 |                     row.remove();
  269 |                     const tbody = document.getElementById('audit-logs-tbody');
  270 |                     if (tbody && tbody.querySelectorAll('tr[id^="log-row-"]').length === 0) {
  271 |                         window.location.reload();
  272 |                     }
  273 |                 }, 200);
  274 |             }
  275 |             if (window.showToast) {
  276 |                 window.showToast({
  277 |                     type: 'info',
  278 |                     title: 'Registro Eliminado',
  279 |                     message: data.message
  280 |                 });
  281 |             }
  282 |         } else {
  283 |             alert('Error: ' + data.message);
  284 |         }
  285 |     } catch (err) {
  286 |         alert('Error al eliminar registro de log.');
  287 |     }
  288 | }
  289 | 
  290 | async function handleClearAllLogs() {
  291 |     if (!confirm('¿Está seguro de que desea VACIAR TODO EL HISTORIAL de auditoría?\n\nEsta acción eliminará de forma irreversible todos los registros de movimientos almacenados.')) {
  292 |         return;
  293 |     }
  294 | 
  295 |     try {
  296 |         const res = await fetch('/api/audit-logs/clear', { method: 'POST' });
  297 |         const data = await res.json();
  298 |         if (data.status === 'success') {
  299 |             if (window.showToast) {
  300 |                 window.showToast({
  301 |                     type: 'warning',
  302 |                     title: 'Historial Vaciado',
  303 |                     message: data.message
  304 |                 });
  305 |             } else {
  306 |                 alert(data.message);
  307 |             }
  308 |             setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 700);
  309 |         } else {
  310 |             alert('Error: ' + data.message);
  311 |         }
  312 |     } catch (err) {
  313 |         alert('Error al vaciar los logs de auditoría.');
  314 |     }
  315 | }
  316 | </script>
  317 | {% endblock %}

  388 |         // Toast Notification System Global
  389 |         window.showToast = function({ type = 'success', title = '', message = '', duration = 4000 }) {
  390 |             let container = document.getElementById('sifma-toast-container');
  391 |             if (!container) {
  392 |                 container = document.createElement('div');
  393 |                 container.id = 'sifma-toast-container';
  394 |                 container.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; top: 20px; right: 24px; z-index: 999999; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; pointer-events: none;';
  395 |                 document.body.appendChild(container);
  396 |             }
  397 | 
  398 |             const toast = document.createElement('div');
  399 |             toast.className = 'sifma-toast';
  400 |             
  401 |             let iconName = 'check_circle';
  402 |             if (type === 'error') iconName = 'error';
  403 |             else if (type === 'warning') iconName = 'warning';
  404 |             else if (type === 'info') iconName = 'info';
  405 | 
  406 |             toast.innerHTML = `
  407 |                 <div class="sifma-toast-body">
  408 |                     <div class="sifma-toast-icon ${type}">
  409 |                         <span class="material-icons-round" style="font-size: 20px;">${iconName}</span>
  410 |                     </div>
  411 |                     <div style="flex: 1; padding-right: 6px;">
  412 |                         <div class="sifma-toast-title">${title}</div>
  413 |                         <div class="sifma-toast-msg">${message}</div>
  414 |                     </div>
  415 |                     <button type="button" class="sifma-toast-close" title="Cerrar">
  416 |                         <span class="material-icons-round" style="font-size: 16px;">close</span>
  417 |                     </button>
  418 |                 </div>
  419 |                 <div class="sifma-toast-progress-bar">
  420 |                     <div class="sifma-toast-progress-fill ${type}" style="transition: width ${duration}ms linear; width: 100%;"></div>
  421 |                 </div>
  422 |             `;
  423 | 
  424 |             container.appendChild(toast);
  425 | 
  426 |             const fill = toast.querySelector('.sifma-toast-progress-fill');
  427 |             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
  428 |                 setTimeout(() => {
  429 |                     if (fill) fill.style.width = '0%';
  430 |                 }, 50);
  431 |             });
  432 | 
  433 |             const closeToast = () => {
  434 |                 if (toast.classList.contains('closing')) return;
  435 |                 toast.classList.add('closing');
  436 |                 setTimeout(() => {
  437 |                     if (toast.parentElement) toast.parentElement.removeChild(toast);
  438 |                 }, 300);
  439 |             };
  440 | 
  441 |             toast.querySelector('.sifma-toast-close').addEventListener('click', closeToast);
  442 |             setTimeout(closeToast, duration);
  443 |         };
  444 | 
  445 |         // Monitor Global en segundo plano para procesamientos activos
  446 |         let globalPollInterval = null;
  447 |         window.startGlobalProcessingMonitor = function() {
  448 |             if (globalPollInterval) return;
  449 |             globalPollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
  450 |                 const isLocallyActive = localStorage.getItem('sifma_processing_active') === 'true';
  451 |                 if (!isLocallyActive) {
  452 |                     clearInterval(globalPollInterval);
  453 |                     globalPollInterval = null;
  454 |                     return;
  455 |                 }
  456 | 
  457 |                 try {
  458 |                     const res = await fetch('/api/processing/progress');
  459 |                     if (res.ok) {
  460 |                         const prog = await res.json();
  461 |                         if (prog && prog.percent === 100 && !prog.is_processing) {
  462 |                             localStorage.removeItem('sifma_processing_active');
  463 |                             clearInterval(globalPollInterval);
  464 |                             globalPollInterval = null;
  465 |                             window.showToast({
  466 |                                 type: 'success',
  467 |                                 title: '¡Lote Fenotípico Finalizado!',
  468 |                                 message: prog.message || 'El procesamiento de fotos ha concluido exitosamente.',
  469 |                                 duration: 5000
  470 |                             });
  471 |                         } else if (prog && !prog.is_processing && prog.percent === 0 && prog.message && prog.message.startsWith('Error')) {
  472 |                             localStorage.removeItem('sifma_processing_active');
  473 |                             clearInterval(globalPollInterval);
  474 |                             globalPollInterval = null;
  475 |                             window.showToast({
  476 |                                 type: 'error',
  477 |                                 title: 'Error en Procesamiento',
  478 |                                 message: prog.message,
  479 |                                 duration: 6000
  480 |                             });
  481 |                         }
  482 |                     }
  483 |                 } catch (e) {}
  484 |             }, 2000);
  485 |         };
  486 | 
  487 |         document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  488 |             if (window.innerWidth > 992) {
  489 |                 const saved = localStorage.getItem('sifma_sidebar_collapsed');
  490 |                 if (saved === 'true') {
  491 |                     document.getElementById('sidebar')?.classList.add('collapsed');
  492 |                     document.getElementById('main-content')?.classList.add('expanded');
  493 |                 }
  494 |             }
  495 | 
  496 |             // Onboarding inicial automático para nuevos accesos
  497 |             const hasSeenOnboarding = localStorage.getItem('sifma_onboarding_shown');
  498 |             if (!hasSeenOnboarding) {
  499 |                 setTimeout(() => {
  500 |                     openOnboardingModal();
  501 |                 }, 400);
  502 |             }
  503 | 
  504 |             // Iniciar monitoreo si hay un proceso en segundo plano lanzado desde otra pestaña
  505 |             if (localStorage.getItem('sifma_processing_active') === 'true') {
  506 |                 window.startGlobalProcessingMonitor();
  507 |             }
  508 |         });

  262 | {% block scripts %}
  263 | <script>
  264 |     const chartLabels = {{ benchmark_data.chart_labels | tojson | safe }};
  265 |     const chartsData = {{ benchmark_data.charts | tojson | safe }};
  266 |     let activeMetric = 'area';
  267 |     let comparisonChartInstance = null;
  268 | 
  269 |     Chart.defaults.font.family = "'Inter', sans-serif";
  270 |     Chart.defaults.color = '#64748b';
  271 | 
  272 |     function initBenchmarkChart() {
  273 |         const ctx = document.getElementById('benchmarkComparisonChart').getContext('2d');
  274 |         
  275 |         const datasets = getDatasetsForMetric(activeMetric);
  276 | 
  277 |         comparisonChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
  278 |             type: 'line',
  279 |             data: {
  280 |                 labels: chartLabels.length ? chartLabels : ['Sin registros'],
  281 |                 datasets: datasets
  282 |             },
  283 |             options: {
  284 |                 responsive: true,
  285 |                 maintainAspectRatio: false,
  286 |                 interaction: {
  287 |                     mode: 'index',
  288 |                     intersect: false
  289 |                 },
  290 |                 plugins: {
  291 |                     legend: {
  292 |                         position: 'top',
  293 |                         labels: {
  294 |                             usePointStyle: true,
  295 |                             boxWidth: 8,
  296 |                             padding: 14,
  297 |                             font: { size: 12, weight: '600' }
  298 |                         }
  299 |                     },
  300 |                     tooltip: {
  301 |                         backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
  302 |                         titleFont: { size: 12, weight: '700' },
  303 |                         bodyFont: { size: 11.5 },
  304 |                         padding: 10,
  305 |                         cornerRadius: 8
  306 |                     }
  307 |                 },
  308 |                 scales: {
  309 |                     x: {
  310 |                         grid: { color: 'rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.6)' },
  311 |                         title: { display: true, text: 'Fecha de Muestreo', font: { size: 11, weight: '600' } }
  312 |                     },
  313 |                     y: {
  314 |                         grid: { color: 'rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.6)' },
  315 |                         title: { display: true, text: getYAxisTitle(activeMetric), font: { size: 11, weight: '600' } },
  316 |                         beginAtZero: true
  317 |                     }
  318 |                 }
  319 |             }
  320 |         });
  321 |     }
  322 | 
  323 |     function getYAxisTitle(metric) {
  324 |         if (metric === 'area') return 'Área Foliar Promedio (cm²)';
  325 |         if (metric === 'height') return 'Altura de Planta (cm)';
  326 |         if (metric === 'health') return 'Índice de Salud Foliar (%)';
  327 |         return '';
  328 |     }
  329 | 
  330 |     function getDatasetsForMetric(metric) {
  331 |         return chartsData[metric] || [];
  332 |     }
  333 | 
  334 |     function switchBenchmarkMetric(metric) {
  335 |         activeMetric = metric;
  336 |         document.querySelectorAll('.filter-group .filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  337 |         const activeBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-metric-${metric}`);
  338 |         if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
  339 | 
  340 |         if (comparisonChartInstance) {
  341 |             comparisonChartInstance.data.datasets = getDatasetsForMetric(metric);
  342 |             comparisonChartInstance.options.scales.y.title.text = getYAxisTitle(metric);
  343 |             
  344 |             // Sincronizar visibilidad de checkboxes
  345 |             for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  346 |                 const cb = document.getElementById(`toggle-plant-${i + 1}`);
  347 |                 if (cb && comparisonChartInstance.data.datasets[i]) {
  348 |                     comparisonChartInstance.data.datasets[i].hidden = !cb.checked;
  349 |                 }
  350 |             }
  351 |             comparisonChartInstance.update();
  352 |         }
  353 |     }
  354 | 
  355 |     function toggleDatasetVisibility(datasetIndex) {
  356 |         if (comparisonChartInstance && comparisonChartInstance.data.datasets[datasetIndex]) {
  357 |             const cb = document.getElementById(`toggle-plant-${datasetIndex + 1}`);
  358 |             comparisonChartInstance.data.datasets[datasetIndex].hidden = !cb.checked;
  359 |             comparisonChartInstance.update();
  360 |         }
  361 |     }
  362 | 
  363 |     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  364 |         initBenchmarkChart();
  365 |     });
  366 | </script>
  367 | {% endblock %}

  534 |     async function openDayDetail(dateStr) {
  535 |         const modal = document.getElementById('day-detail-modal');
  536 |         const loading = document.getElementById('modal-loading-state');
  537 |         const content = document.getElementById('modal-content-state');

  552 |             const data = await resp.json();
  553 |

  555 |             content.style.display = 'block';
  556 |

  628 |     async function syncTowerTelemetry() {
  629 |         const btn = document.getElementById('btn-sync-telemetry');
  630 |         const box = document.getElementById('sync-result-box');
  631 |         if (!btn || !box) return;
  632 | 
  633 |         btn.disabled = true;
  634 |         btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-round spinner">sync</span> <span>Sincronizando...</span>';
  635 | 
  636 |         try {
  637 |             const resp = await fetch('/api/telemetry/sync_tower', {
  638 |                 method: 'POST',
  639 |                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
  640 |             });
  641 |             const data = await resp.json();
  642 | 
  643 |             box.style.display = 'block';
  644 |             if (data.status === 'success') {
  645 |                 box.style.background = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
  646 |                 box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)';
  647 |                 box.style.color = '#065f46';
  648 |                 box.innerHTML = `<span class="material-icons-round" style="vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 6px;">check_circle</span> ${data.message}`;
  649 |             } else {
  650 |                 box.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
  651 |                 box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)';
  652 |                 box.style.color = '#991b1b';
  653 |                 box.innerHTML = `<span class="material-icons-round" style="vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 6px;">error</span> ${data.message || 'Error al sincronizar telemetría'}`;
  654 |             }
  655 |         } catch (err) {
  656 |             box.style.display = 'block';
  657 |             box.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
  658 |             box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)';
  659 |             box.style.color = '#991b1b';
  660 |             box.innerHTML = `<span class="material-icons-round" style="vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 6px;">error</span> Error de conexión al servidor: ${err.message}`;
  661 |         } finally {
  662 |             btn.disabled = false;
  663 |             btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-round">sync</span> <span>Sincronizar Telemetría con Canastillas</span>';
  664 |         }
  665 |     }

  667 |     // ==========================================
  668 |     // CALIBRADOR INTERACTIVO DE ROI CENITAL
  669 |     // ==========================================
  670 |     let roiState = {
  671 |         cx: parseFloat("{{ config.cenital_roi_cx or 0.4955 }}"),
  672 |         cy: parseFloat("{{ config.cenital_roi_cy or 0.4408 }}"),
  673 |         radius: parseFloat("{{ config.cenital_roi_radius or 0.1450 }}"),
  674 |         mode: "{{ config.cenital_roi_mode or 'dynamic_conn' }}",
  675 |         isDragging: false
  676 |     };
  677 | 
  678 |     const canvas = document.getElementById('roi-canvas');
  679 |     const ctx = canvas ? canvas.getContext('2d') : null;
  680 |     const bgImage = new Image();
  681 |     const latestCenitalUrl = "{{ url_for('static', filename=latest_cenital_img) if latest_cenital_img else '' }}";
  682 | 
  683 |     function initRoiCanvas() {
  684 |         if (!canvas || !ctx) return;
  685 | 
  686 |         if (latestCenitalUrl) {
  687 |             bgImage.src = latestCenitalUrl;
  688 |             bgImage.onload = () => {
  689 |                 canvas.width = bgImage.naturalWidth || 640;
  690 |                 canvas.height = bgImage.naturalHeight || 480;
  691 |                 drawRoi();
  692 |             };
  693 |             bgImage.onerror = () => {
  694 |                 drawFallbackCanvas();
  695 |             };
  696 |         } else {
  697 |             drawFallbackCanvas();
  698 |         }
  699 | 
  700 |         // Eventos de Mouse sobre el Canvas
  701 |         canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  702 |             roiState.isDragging = true;
  703 |             updateRoiCenterFromEvent(e);
  704 |         });
  705 | 
  706 |         window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  707 |             if (roiState.isDragging) {
  708 |                 updateRoiCenterFromEvent(e);
  709 |             }
  710 |         });
  711 | 
  712 |         window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  713 |             roiState.isDragging = false;
  714 |         });
  715 | 
  716 |         // Touch para pantallas táctiles
  717 |         canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  718 |             roiState.isDragging = true;
  719 |             if (e.touches.length > 0) updateRoiCenterFromEvent(e.touches[0]);
  720 |             e.preventDefault();
  721 |         }, { passive: false });
  722 | 
  723 |         canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  724 |             if (roiState.isDragging && e.touches.length > 0) {
  725 |                 updateRoiCenterFromEvent(e.touches[0]);
  726 |             }
  727 |             e.preventDefault();
  728 |         }, { passive: false });
  729 | 
  730 |         canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
  731 |             roiState.isDragging = false;
  732 |         });
  733 |     }
  734 | 
  735 |     function drawFallbackCanvas() {
  736 |         canvas.width = 640;
  737 |         canvas.height = 480;
  738 |         drawRoi();
  739 |     }
  740 | 
  741 |     function updateRoiCenterFromEvent(e) {
  742 |         if (!canvas) return;
  743 |         const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  744 |         const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
  745 |         const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
  746 | 
  747 |         const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
  748 |         const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
  749 | 
  750 |         roiState.cx = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, x / canvas.width));
  751 |         roiState.cy = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, y / canvas.height));
  752 | 
  753 |         drawRoi();
  754 |         updateRoiLabels();
  755 |     }
  756 | 
  757 |     function drawRoi() {
  758 |         if (!ctx || !canvas) return;
  759 |         const w = canvas.width;
  760 |         const h = canvas.height;
  761 | 
  762 |         ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  763 | 
  764 |         if (bgImage.complete && bgImage.naturalWidth > 0) {
  765 |             ctx.drawImage(bgImage, 0, 0, w, h);
  766 |         } else {
  767 |             // Fondo simulado de la torre
  768 |             ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
  769 |             ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  770 |             ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
  771 |             ctx.font = '14px Inter, sans-serif';
  772 |             ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  773 |             ctx.fillText('No hay fotos cenitales capturadas aún. Usa el patrón de referencia:', w / 2, h / 2 - 40);
  774 |         }
  775 | 
  776 |         const px = roiState.cx * w;
  777 |         const py = roiState.cy * h;
  778 |         const minDim = Math.min(w, h);
  779 |         const r = roiState.radius * minDim;
  780 | 
  781 |         // 1. Zona oscurecida fuera del ROI (Máscara translúcida)
  782 |         ctx.save();
  783 |         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)';
  784 |         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  785 | 
  786 |         // Recortar círculo transparente
  787 |         ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
  788 |         ctx.beginPath();
  789 |         ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
  790 |         ctx.fill();
  791 |         ctx.restore();
  792 | 
  793 |         // 2. Anillo del ROI (Verde / Cian Neón)
  794 |         ctx.save();
  795 |         ctx.beginPath();
  796 |         ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
  797 |         ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  798 |         ctx.strokeStyle = '#10b981';
  799 |         ctx.shadowColor = '#10b981';
  800 |         ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  801 |         ctx.stroke();
  802 | 
  803 |         // Núcleo central mínimo (~45% del radio)
  804 |         ctx.beginPath();
  805 |         ctx.arc(px, py, r * 0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
  806 |         ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  807 |         ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
  808 |         ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
  809 |         ctx.stroke();
  810 | 
  811 |         // Cruz Central
  812 |         ctx.setLineDash([]);
  813 |         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  814 |         ctx.strokeStyle = '#22c55e';
  815 |         const cl = 16;
  816 |         ctx.beginPath();
  817 |         ctx.moveTo(px - cl, py); ctx.lineTo(px + cl, py);
  818 |         ctx.moveTo(px, py - cl); ctx.lineTo(px, py + cl);
  819 |         ctx.stroke();
  820 | 
  821 |         // Etiqueta
  822 |         ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
  823 |         ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter, sans-serif';
  824 |         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  825 |         ctx.shadowColor = '#000000';
  826 |         ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
  827 |         ctx.fillText('ROI (CANASTILLA)', px, Math.max(20, py - r - 8));
  828 |         ctx.restore();
  829 |     }
  830 |

  835 |         drawRoi();

  865 |     async function saveRoiCalibration() {
  866 |         const btn = document.getElementById('btn-save-roi');
  867 |         const status = document.getElementById('roi-save-status');
  868 |         if (!btn) return;
  869 |

  872 |

  875 |         formData.append('cenital_roi_cx', roiState.cx.toFixed(4));
  876 |         formData.append('cenital_roi_cy', roiState.cy.toFixed(4));
  877 |         formData.append('cenital_roi_radius', roiState.radius.toFixed(4));
  878 |         formData.append('cenital_roi_mode', roiState.mode);
  879 | 
  880 |         try {

  882 |                 method: 'POST',

  885 | 
  886 |             if (resp.ok) {
  887 |                 if (status) {
  888 |                     status.style.display = 'block';
  889 |                     status.style.background = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
  890 |                     status.style.color = '#065f46';
  891 |                     status.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-round" style="vertical-align: middle; font-size: 16px;">check_circle</span> ¡ROI Cenital guardado y calibrado con éxito!';
  892 |                     setTimeout(() => { status.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
  893 |                 }
  894 |             } else {
  895 |                 throw new Error('Error al guardar en el servidor');
  896 |             }
  897 |         } catch (err) {
  898 |             if (status) {
  899 |                 status.style.display = 'block';
  900 |                 status.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
  901 |                 status.style.color = '#991b1b';
  902 |                 status.innerHTML = `<span class="material-icons-round" style="vertical-align: middle; font-size: 16px;">error</span> Error: ${err.message}`;
  903 |             }
  904 |         } finally {
  905 |             btn.disabled = false;
  906 |             btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-round" style="font-size: 16px;">save</span> <span>Guardar ROI</span>';
  907 |         }
  908 |     }

  913 |     let lateralState = {

  915 |         mode: "{{ config.lateral_baseline_mode or 'manual_baseline' }}",
  916 |         stemRoiX: parseFloat("{{ config.lateral_stem_roi_x or 0.5000 }}"),

  920 |         stemMode: "{{ config.lateral_stem_mode or 'auto_edge' }}",

  932 |     function initLateralCanvas() {
  933 |         if (!lateralCanvas || !lateralCtx) return;
  934 | 
  935 |         if (latestLateralUrl) {
  936 |             bgLateralImage.src = latestLateralUrl;
  937 |             bgLateralImage.onload = () => {
  938 |                 lateralCanvas.width = bgLateralImage.naturalWidth || 480;
  939 |                 lateralCanvas.height = bgLateralImage.naturalHeight || 640;
  940 |                 drawLateral();
  941 |             };
  942 |             bgLateralImage.onerror = () => {
  943 |                 drawFallbackLateralCanvas();
  944 |             };
  945 |         } else {
  946 |             drawFallbackLateralCanvas();
  947 |         }
  948 | 
  949 |         // Eventos Mouse
  950 |         lateralCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  951 |             handleLateralMouseDown(e);
  952 |         });
  953 | 
  954 |         window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  955 |             if (lateralState.isDragging) {
  956 |                 handleLateralMouseMove(e);
  957 |             }
  958 |         });
  959 | 
  960 |         window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  961 |             lateralState.isDragging = false;
  962 |             lateralState.dragTarget = null;
  963 |         });
  964 | 
  965 |         // Eventos Touch
  966 |         lateralCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
  967 |             if (e.touches.length > 0) handleLateralMouseDown(e.touches[0]);
  968 |             e.preventDefault();
  969 |         }, { passive: false });
  970 | 
  971 |         lateralCanvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  972 |             if (lateralState.isDragging && e.touches.length > 0) {
  973 |                 handleLateralMouseMove(e.touches[0]);
  974 |             }
  975 |             e.preventDefault();
  976 |         }, { passive: false });
  977 | 
  978 |         lateralCanvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
  979 |             lateralState.isDragging = false;
  980 |             lateralState.dragTarget = null;
  981 |         });
  982 |     }

  984 |     function drawFallbackLateralCanvas() {
  985 |         if (!lateralCanvas) return;

  991 |     function getLateralCanvasCoords(e) {
  992 |         const rect = lateralCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  993 |         const scaleX = lateralCanvas.width / rect.width;
  994 |         const scaleY = lateralCanvas.height / rect.height;
  995 |         return {
  996 |             x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX,
  997 |             y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY
  998 |         };
  999 |     }
 1000 | 
 1001 |     function handleLateralMouseDown(e) {
 1002 |         if (!lateralCanvas) return;
 1003 |         const pos = getLateralCanvasCoords(e);
 1004 |         const w = lateralCanvas.width;
 1005 |         const h = lateralCanvas.height;
 1006 | 
 1007 |         const basePy = lateralState.baselineY * h;
 1008 |         const stemBx = (lateralState.stemRoiX - lateralState.stemRoiW / 2) * w;
 1009 |         const stemBy = (lateralState.stemRoiY - lateralState.stemRoiH / 2) * h;
 1010 |         const stemBw = lateralState.stemRoiW * w;
 1011 |         const stemBh = lateralState.stemRoiH * h;
 1012 | 
 1013 |         // Comprobar si se hizo clic dentro del cuadro de tallo
 1014 |         if (pos.x >= stemBx && pos.x <= stemBx + stemBw && pos.y >= stemBy && pos.y <= stemBy + stemBh) {
 1015 |             lateralState.isDragging = true;
 1016 |             lateralState.dragTarget = 'stem_box';
 1017 |             lateralState.dragOffsetX = pos.x / w - lateralState.stemRoiX;
 1018 |             lateralState.dragOffsetY = pos.y / h - lateralState.stemRoiY;
 1019 |         } else if (Math.abs(pos.y - basePy) < 25) {
 1020 |             // Clic cerca de la línea base
 1021 |             lateralState.isDragging = true;
 1022 |             lateralState.dragTarget = 'baseline';
 1023 |         } else {
 1024 |             // Clic en cualquier otra parte mueve la línea base o el tallo según proximidad
 1025 |             if (pos.y > basePy - 40) {
 1026 |                 lateralState.isDragging = true;
 1027 |                 lateralState.dragTarget = 'baseline';
 1028 |                 lateralState.baselineY = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(0.98, pos.y / h));
 1029 |                 updateLateralSliders();
 1030 |                 drawLateral();
 1031 |             } else {
 1032 |                 lateralState.isDragging = true;
 1033 |                 lateralState.dragTarget = 'stem_box';
 1034 |                 lateralState.stemRoiX = Math.max(0.10, Math.min(0.90, pos.x / w));
 1035 |                 lateralState.stemRoiY = Math.max(0.10, Math.min(0.90, pos.y / h));
 1036 |                 lateralState.dragOffsetX = 0;
 1037 |                 lateralState.dragOffsetY = 0;
 1038 |                 updateLateralSliders();
 1039 |                 drawLateral();
 1040 |             }
 1041 |         }
 1042 |     }
 1043 | 
 1044 |     function handleLateralMouseMove(e) {
 1045 |         if (!lateralCanvas || !lateralState.isDragging) return;
 1046 |         const pos = getLateralCanvasCoords(e);
 1047 |         const w = lateralCanvas.width;
 1048 |         const h = lateralCanvas.height;
 1049 | 
 1050 |         if (lateralState.dragTarget === 'baseline') {
 1051 |             lateralState.baselineY = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(0.98, pos.y / h));
 1052 |             updateLateralSliders();
 1053 |             drawLateral();
 1054 |         } else if (lateralState.dragTarget === 'stem_box') {
 1055 |             const newX = pos.x / w - lateralState.dragOffsetX;
 1056 |             const newY = pos.y / h - lateralState.dragOffsetY;
 1057 |             lateralState.stemRoiX = Math.max(0.10, Math.min(0.90, newX));
 1058 |             lateralState.stemRoiY = Math.max(0.10, Math.min(0.95, newY));
 1059 |             updateLateralSliders();
 1060 |             drawLateral();
 1061 |         }
 1062 |     }

 1144 |     function drawLateral() {
 1145 |         if (!lateralCtx || !lateralCanvas) return;
 1146 |         const w = lateralCanvas.width;
 1147 |         const h = lateralCanvas.height;
 1148 | 
 1149 |         lateralCtx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
 1150 | 
 1151 |         if (bgLateralImage.complete && bgLateralImage.naturalWidth > 0) {
 1152 |             lateralCtx.drawImage(bgLateralImage, 0, 0, w, h);
 1153 |         } else {
 1154 |             lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
 1155 |             lateralCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
 1156 |             lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
 1157 |             lateralCtx.font = '14px Inter, sans-serif';
 1158 |             lateralCtx.textAlign = 'center';
 1159 |             lateralCtx.fillText('No hay fotos laterales capturadas aún.', w / 2, h / 2);
 1160 |         }
 1161 | 
 1162 |         const py = lateralState.baselineY * h;
 1163 | 
 1164 |         // 1. Sombra bajo la línea de la maceta (Sustrato / Tubo de soporte)
 1165 |         lateralCtx.save();
 1166 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)';
 1167 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(0, py, w, h - py);
 1168 |         lateralCtx.restore();
 1169 | 
 1170 |         // 2. Línea Base Horizontal Roja (Estilo guía agrónoma)
 1171 |         lateralCtx.save();
 1172 |         lateralCtx.beginPath();
 1173 |         lateralCtx.moveTo(0, py);
 1174 |         lateralCtx.lineTo(w, py);
 1175 |         lateralCtx.lineWidth = 3.5;
 1176 |         lateralCtx.strokeStyle = '#ef4444';
 1177 |         lateralCtx.shadowColor = '#ef4444';
 1178 |         lateralCtx.shadowBlur = 12;
 1179 |         lateralCtx.stroke();
 1180 | 
 1181 |         // Pequeñas flechas indicadoras en los extremos
 1182 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
 1183 |         lateralCtx.beginPath();
 1184 |         lateralCtx.moveTo(10, py - 6); lateralCtx.lineTo(22, py); lateralCtx.lineTo(10, py + 6); lateralCtx.fill();
 1185 |         lateralCtx.beginPath();
 1186 |         lateralCtx.moveTo(w - 10, py - 6); lateralCtx.lineTo(w - 22, py); lateralCtx.lineTo(w - 10, py + 6); lateralCtx.fill();
 1187 | 
 1188 |         // Cartela indicadora
 1189 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
 1190 |         lateralCtx.font = 'bold 12px Inter, sans-serif';
 1191 |         lateralCtx.textAlign = 'left';
 1192 |         lateralCtx.shadowColor = '#000000';
 1193 |         lateralCtx.shadowBlur = 6;
 1194 |         lateralCtx.fillText('LÍNEA BASE (MACETA / INICIO ALTURA)', 30, Math.max(20, py - 8));
 1195 |         lateralCtx.restore();
 1196 | 
 1197 |         // 3. Cuadro / Franja de Medición de Tallo (Scanline de Bordes)
 1198 |         const bx = (lateralState.stemRoiX - lateralState.stemRoiW / 2) * w;
 1199 |         const by = (lateralState.stemRoiY - lateralState.stemRoiH / 2) * h;
 1200 |         const bw = lateralState.stemRoiW * w;
 1201 |         const bh = lateralState.stemRoiH * h;
 1202 | 
 1203 |         lateralCtx.save();
 1204 |         // Relleno suave translúcido
 1205 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
 1206 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
 1207 | 
 1208 |         // Borde exterior
 1209 |         lateralCtx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
 1210 |         lateralCtx.lineWidth = 2;
 1211 |         lateralCtx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
 1212 |         lateralCtx.strokeRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
 1213 |         lateralCtx.setLineDash([]);
 1214 | 
 1215 |         // Línea central de escaneo horizontal
 1216 |         const midY = by + bh / 2;
 1217 |         lateralCtx.beginPath();
 1218 |         lateralCtx.moveTo(bx, midY);
 1219 |         lateralCtx.lineTo(bx + bw, midY);
 1220 |         lateralCtx.lineWidth = 2;
 1221 |         lateralCtx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
 1222 |         lateralCtx.stroke();
 1223 | 
 1224 |         // Marcas de límite de escaneo
 1225 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
 1226 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx, midY - 6, 3, 12);
 1227 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx + bw - 3, midY - 6, 3, 12);
 1228 | 
 1229 |         // Esquinas de anclaje
 1230 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
 1231 |         const handleSize = 6;
 1232 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx - handleSize/2, by - handleSize/2, handleSize, handleSize);
 1233 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx + bw - handleSize/2, by - handleSize/2, handleSize, handleSize);
 1234 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx - handleSize/2, by + bh - handleSize/2, handleSize, handleSize);
 1235 |         lateralCtx.fillRect(bx + bw - handleSize/2, by + bh - handleSize/2, handleSize, handleSize);
 1236 | 
 1237 |         // Etiqueta de la zona de tallo
 1238 |         lateralCtx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
 1239 |         lateralCtx.font = 'bold 11px Inter, sans-serif';
 1240 |         lateralCtx.textAlign = 'left';
 1241 |         lateralCtx.shadowColor = '#000000';
 1242 |         lateralCtx.shadowBlur = 5;
 1243 |         lateralCtx.fillText('ZONA DE MEDICIÓN DE TALLO (SCANLINE)', bx, Math.max(16, by - 6));
 1244 | 
 1245 |         lateralCtx.restore();
 1246 |     }

 1248 |     async function saveLateralBaselineCalibration() {
 1249 |         const btn = document.getElementById('btn-save-lateral-baseline');
 1250 |         const status = document.getElementById('lateral-save-status');
 1251 |         if (!btn) return;
 1252 |

 1254 |         btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-round spinner">sync</span> <span>Guardando...</span>';
 1255 | 
 1256 |         const formData = new FormData();
 1257 |         formData.append('action', 'update_lateral_baseline');
 1258 |         formData.append('lateral_baseline_y', lateralState.baselineY.toFixed(4));
 1259 |         formData.append('lateral_baseline_mode', lateralState.mode);
 1260 |         formData.append('lateral_stem_roi_x', lateralState.stemRoiX.toFixed(4));
 1261 |         formData.append('lateral_stem_roi_y', lateralState.stemRoiY.toFixed(4));
 1262 |         formData.append('lateral_stem_roi_width', lateralState.stemRoiW.toFixed(4));

 1265 | 
 1266 |         try {

 1268 |                 method: 'POST',

 1271 |

 1273 |                 if (status) {
 1274 |                     status.style.display = 'block';

 1276 |                     status.style.color = '#1e40af';

 1278 |                     setTimeout(() => { status.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
 1279 |                 }
 1280 |             } else {

 1287 |                 status.style.color = '#991b1b';
 1288 |                 status.innerHTML = `<span class="material-icons-round" style="vertical-align: middle; font-size: 16px;">error</span> Error: ${err.message}`;
 1289 |             }
 1290 |         } finally {
 1291 |             btn.disabled = false;
 1292 |             btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons-round" style="font-size: 16px;">save</span> <span>Guardar Calibración Lateral</span>';
 1293 |         }
 1294 |     }

  875 |     function renderCustomComparatorChart() {
  876 |         const data = getFilteredCrossData();
  877 |         const phenoKey = document.getElementById('select-pheno-var').value;
  878 |         const sensorKey = document.getElementById('select-sensor-var').value;
  879 | 
  880 |         const pMeta = varMeta[phenoKey];
  881 |         const sMeta = varMeta[sensorKey];
  882 | 
  883 |         const ctx = document.getElementById('customComparatorChart');
  884 |         if (!ctx) return;
  885 |         if (customComparatorChart) customComparatorChart.destroy();
  886 | 
  887 |         if (!data || data.length === 0) {
  888 |             document.getElementById('custom-math-summary').innerText = 'Sin datos disponibles para el filtro actual.';
  889 |             return;
  890 |         }
  891 | 
  892 |         const labels = data.map(d => d.full_period_label || d.period);
  893 |         const phenoVals = data.map(d => d[phenoKey]);
  894 |         const sensorVals = data.map(d => d[sensorKey]);
  895 | 
  896 |         // Cálculo de Regresión y Pearson
  897 |         let r = 0, r2 = 0, slope = 0, intercept = 0;
  898 |         let hasVariance = false;
  899 | 
  900 |         if (data.length >= 2) {
  901 |             const n = data.length;
  902 |             const sumX = sensorVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  903 |             const sumY = phenoVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  904 |             const sumXY = sensorVals.reduce((acc, x, i) => acc + x * phenoVals[i], 0);
  905 |             const sumX2 = sensorVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b * b, 0);
  906 |             const sumY2 = phenoVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b * b, 0);
  907 | 
  908 |             const denom = (n * sumX2 - sumX * sumX) * (n * sumY2 - sumY * sumY);
  909 |             if (denom > 1e-6) {
  910 |                 r = (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / Math.sqrt(denom);
  911 |                 hasVariance = true;
  912 |             }
  913 |             r2 = r * r;
  914 | 
  915 |             const slopeDenom = (n * sumX2 - sumX * sumX);
  916 |             if (Math.abs(slopeDenom) > 1e-6) {
  917 |                 slope = (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / slopeDenom;
  918 |                 intercept = (sumY - slope * sumX) / n;
  919 |             } else {
  920 |                 slope = 0;
  921 |                 intercept = sumY / n;
  922 |             }
  923 |         }
  924 | 
  925 |         const signStr = r >= 0 ? '+' : '';
  926 |         if (hasVariance) {
  927 |             document.getElementById('custom-math-summary').innerHTML = `
  928 |                 Pearson: <strong style="color: ${r >= 0 ? '#059669' : '#dc2626'};">${signStr}${r.toFixed(2)}</strong> | 
  929 |                 R²: <strong>${r2.toFixed(3)}</strong> | 
  930 |                 Tendencia: <em>y = ${slope.toFixed(2)}x ${intercept >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${intercept.toFixed(2)}</em>
  931 |             `;
  932 |         } else {
  933 |             document.getElementById('custom-math-summary').innerHTML = `
  934 |                 <span>Valores constantes en la muestra (${sensorVals[0]} ${sMeta.unit}, ${phenoVals[0]} ${pMeta.unit})</span>
  935 |             `;
  936 |         }
  937 | 
  938 |         if (currentChartType === 'scatter') {
  939 |             const scatterPoints = data.map(d => ({
  940 |                 x: d[sensorKey],
  941 |                 y: d[phenoKey],
  942 |                 label: d.full_period_label
  943 |             }));
  944 | 
  945 |             let minX = Math.min(...sensorVals);
  946 |             let maxX = Math.max(...sensorVals);
  947 |             if (minX === maxX) {
  948 |                 minX = minX * 0.9 - 1;
  949 |                 maxX = maxX * 1.1 + 1;
  950 |             }
  951 | 
  952 |             const trendLine = [
  953 |                 { x: minX, y: slope * minX + intercept },
  954 |                 { x: maxX, y: slope * maxX + intercept }
  955 |             ];
  956 | 
  957 |             customComparatorChart = new Chart(ctx, {
  958 |                 type: 'scatter',
  959 |                 data: {
  960 |                     datasets: [
  961 |                         {
  962 |                             label: `${pMeta.label} vs ${sMeta.label}`,
  963 |                             data: scatterPoints,
  964 |                             backgroundColor: pMeta.color,
  965 |                             borderColor: pMeta.color,
  966 |                             pointRadius: 6,
  967 |                             pointHoverRadius: 9
  968 |                         },
  969 |                         {
  970 |                             label: 'Línea de Tendencia',
  971 |                             data: trendLine,
  972 |                             type: 'line',
  973 |                             borderColor: '#ef4444',
  974 |                             borderWidth: 2,
  975 |                             borderDash: [5, 5],
  976 |                             fill: false,
  977 |                             pointRadius: 0
  978 |                         }
  979 |                     ]
  980 |                 },
  981 |                 options: {
  982 |                     responsive: true,
  983 |                     maintainAspectRatio: false,
  984 |                     plugins: {
  985 |                         tooltip: {
  986 |                             callbacks: {
  987 |                                 label: (c) => ` ${c.raw.label || ''} -> ${sMeta.label}: ${c.raw.x} ${sMeta.unit}, ${pMeta.label}: ${c.raw.y} ${pMeta.unit}`
  988 |                             }
  989 |                         }
  990 |                     },
  991 |                     scales: {
  992 |                         x: {
  993 |                             title: { display: true, text: `${sMeta.label} (${sMeta.unit})` },
  994 |                             grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' }
  995 |                         },
  996 |                         y: {
  997 |                             title: { display: true, text: `${pMeta.label} (${pMeta.unit})` },
  998 |                             grid: { color: '#f1f5f9' }
  999 |                         }
 1000 |                     }
 1001 |                 }
 1002 |             });
 1003 | 
 1004 |         } else if (currentChartType === 'dual') {
 1005 |             customComparatorChart = new Chart(ctx, {
 1006 |                 type: 'line',
 1007 |                 data: {
 1008 |                     labels: labels,
 1009 |                     datasets: [
 1010 |                         {
 1011 |                             label: `${sMeta.label} (${sMeta.unit})`,
 1012 |                             data: sensorVals,

 1440 |     function applyCrossFilters() {
 1441 |         const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#cross-table-body .cross-row');
 1442 |         let visibleCount = 0;
 1443 | 
 1444 |         rows.forEach(r => {
 1445 |             const rPeriod = r.getAttribute('data-period') || '';
 1446 |             const rDate = r.getAttribute('data-date') || '';
 1447 | 
 1448 |             const matchPeriod = (currentPeriodFilter === 'todos') || rPeriod.includes(currentPeriodFilter);
 1449 |             const matchDate = (currentDateFilter === 'todos') || (rDate === currentDateFilter);
 1450 | 
 1451 |             if (matchPeriod && matchDate) {
 1452 |                 r.style.display = '';
 1453 |                 visibleCount++;
 1454 |             } else {
 1455 |                 r.style.display = 'none';
 1456 |             }
 1457 |         });
 1458 |

 1460 |         document.querySelectorAll('.session-accordion-card').forEach(card => {
 1461 |             const rPeriod = card.getAttribute('data-period') || '';
 1462 |             const rDate = card.getAttribute('data-date') || '';
 1463 |             const matchPeriod = (currentPeriodFilter === 'todos') || rPeriod.includes(currentPeriodFilter);
 1464 |             const matchDate = (currentDateFilter === 'todos') || (rDate === currentDateFilter);
 1465 |             card.style.display = (matchPeriod && matchDate) ? '' : 'none';

 1545 |     async function saveAgronomicConclusion(e) {
 1546 |         e.preventDefault();
 1547 |         const pType = document.getElementById('conclusion-period-type').value;
 1548 |         const dStr = document.getElementById('conclusion-date').value;
 1549 |         const auth = document.getElementById('conclusion-author').value;
 1550 |         const gObs = document.getElementById('conclusion-growth').value;
 1551 |         const cObs = document.getElementById('conclusion-climate').value;
 1552 |         const gen = document.getElementById('conclusion-general').value;
 1553 | 
 1554 |         const fb = document.getElementById('conclusion-feedback');
 1555 |         fb.style.display = 'block';
 1556 |         fb.style.background = 'rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.1)';
 1557 |         fb.style.color = '#047857';
 1558 |         fb.innerText = 'Guardando conclusión...';
 1559 | 
 1560 |         try {
 1561 |             const res = await fetch('/api/conclusions', {
 1562 |                 method: 'POST',
 1563 |                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 1564 |                 body: JSON.stringify({
 1565 |                     plant_id: activePlantId,
 1566 |                     period_type: pType,
 1567 |                     date_str: dStr,
 1568 |                     author: auth,
 1569 |                     growth_obs: gObs,
 1570 |                     climate_obs: cObs,
 1571 |                     general_conclusion: gen
 1572 |                 })
 1573 |             });
 1574 |             const data = await res.json();
 1575 |             if (data.status === 'success') {
 1576 |                 fb.innerText = 'Conclusión registrada exitosamente.';
 1577 |                 setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1000);
 1578 |             } else {
 1579 |                 fb.style.background = 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1)';
 1580 |                 fb.style.color = '#b91c1c';
 1581 |                 fb.innerText = 'Error al registrar: ' + data.message;
 1582 |             }
 1583 |         } catch (err) {
 1584 |             fb.style.background = 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1)';
 1585 |             fb.style.color = '#b91c1c';
 1586 |             fb.innerText = 'Error de conexión al servidor.';
 1587 |         }
 1588 |     }

 1590 |     async function deleteConclusion(noteId) {
 1591 |         if (!confirm('¿Deseas eliminar esta conclusión de investigación?')) return;
 1592 |         try {

 1599 |                 alert('Error al eliminar: ' + data.message);

 1603 |         }
 1604 |     }

  413 | {% block scripts %}
  414 | <script>
  415 |     const dailyData = {{ daily | tojson | safe }};
  416 |     const availableDates = {{ available_dates | tojson | safe }};
  417 |     const activePlantId = {{ active_plant_id }};
  418 | 
  419 |     function navigateDate(selectedDate) {
  420 |         if (!selectedDate) return;
  421 |         window.location.href = `/?date=${selectedDate}&plant_id=${activePlantId}`;
  422 |     }
  423 | 
  424 |     document.getElementById('btn-prev-day').addEventListener('click', () => {
  425 |         const currentDateStr = document.getElementById('dashboard-date-picker').value;
  426 |         const d = new Date(currentDateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  427 |         d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1);
  428 |         const prevStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  429 |         navigateDate(prevStr);
  430 |     });
  431 | 
  432 |     document.getElementById('btn-next-day').addEventListener('click', () => {
  433 |         const currentDateStr = document.getElementById('dashboard-date-picker').value;
  434 |         const d = new Date(currentDateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  435 |         d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
  436 |         const nextStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  437 |         navigateDate(nextStr);
  438 |     });
  439 |     // Sincronización inteligente de ubicación GPS para el Clima Exterior
  440 |     function syncBrowserLocation() {
  441 |         if (!navigator.geolocation) {
  442 |             console.log("Geolocalización no soportada por el navegador");
  443 |             return;
  444 |         }
  445 | 
  446 |         const cityLabel = document.getElementById('weather-city-label');
  447 |         if (cityLabel) cityLabel.innerText = "Sincronizando GPS...";
  448 | 
  449 |         navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
  450 |             async (position) => {
  451 |                 const lat = position.coords.latitude;
  452 |                 const lon = position.coords.longitude;
  453 |                 localStorage.setItem('sifma_location_synced', 'true');
  454 | 
  455 |                 try {
  456 |                     let cityName = "Santa Marta, Magdalena";
  457 |                     try {
  458 |                         // Geocodificación inversa ligera
  459 |                         const geoResp = await fetch(`https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=json&lat=${lat}&lon=${lon}&zoom=10`);
  460 |                         if (geoResp.ok) {
  461 |                             const geoData = await geoResp.json();
  462 |                             cityName = geoData.address.city || geoData.address.town || geoData.address.state || cityName;
  463 |                         }
  464 |                     } catch (e) {}
  465 | 
  466 |                     const resp = await fetch('/api/config/location', {
  467 |                         method: 'POST',
  468 |                         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  469 |                         body: JSON.stringify({ latitude: lat, longitude: lon, city_name: cityName })
  470 |                     });
  471 | 
  472 |                     const resData = await resp.json();
  473 |                     if (resData.status === 'success' && resData.weather) {
  474 |                         const w = resData.weather;
  475 |                         if (cityLabel) cityLabel.innerText = w.location_name;
  476 |                         const tempVal = document.getElementById('weather-temp-val');
  477 |                         if (tempVal) tempVal.innerText = w.temperature_c;
  478 |                         const descVal = document.getElementById('weather-desc-val');
  479 |                         if (descVal) descVal.innerText = w.weather_description;
  480 |                         const windVal = document.getElementById('weather-wind-val');
  481 |                         if (windVal) windVal.innerText = `Viento: ${w.wind_speed_kmh} km/h`;
  482 |                         const statusText = document.getElementById('weather-status-text');
  483 |                         if (statusText) statusText.innerHTML = `${w.status_text} &bull; HR: ${w.humidity_rh}%`;
  484 |                         const iconEl = document.getElementById('weather-main-icon');
  485 |                         if (iconEl) iconEl.innerText = w.icon;
  486 |                     }
  487 |                 } catch (err) {
  488 |                     console.warn("Error actualizando coordenadas de la torre:", err);
  489 |                     if (cityLabel) cityLabel.innerText = "Santa Marta, Magdalena";
  490 |                 }
  491 |             },
  492 |             (error) => {
  493 |                 console.log("Ubicación rechazada o no disponible, usando Santa Marta por defecto:", error.message);
  494 |                 if (cityLabel) cityLabel.innerText = "Santa Marta, Magdalena";
  495 |             },
  496 |             { timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 86400000 }
  497 |         );
  498 |     }
  499 | 
  500 |     // Solicitar permiso de ubicación automáticamente la primera vez
  501 |     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  502 |         if (!localStorage.getItem('sifma_location_synced') && navigator.geolocation) {
  503 |             syncBrowserLocation();
  504 |         }
  505 |     });
  506 | </script>
  507 | <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='js/dashboard.js') }}"></script>
  508 | {% endblock %}

  317 |     function filterPeriod(period, btnElement) {
  318 |         document.querySelectorAll('.filter-group .filter-pill').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  319 |         if (btnElement) btnElement.classList.add('active');

  330 |                 card.style.display = 'none';

  341 |

  347 |

  352 |     function switchSessionPhoto(sessionId, photoIndex, btnElement) {
  353 |         const card = document.getElementById('comparator-' + sessionId);
  354 |         if (!card) return;
  355 | 
  356 |         const group = document.getElementById('photo-pills-' + sessionId);
  357 |         if (group) {
  358 |             group.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => {
  359 |                 b.className = 'btn btn-outline btn-sm';
  360 |             });
  361 |             if (btnElement) btnElement.className = 'btn btn-primary btn-sm';
  362 |         }
  363 |

  365 |         let selected = null;
  366 |         if (photoIndex === 0) {
  367 |             selected = allMetrics.find(m => m.is_average) || allMetrics[0];
  368 |         } else {

  374 |             document.getElementById(`img-cenital-proc-${sessionId}`).src = '/static/' + selected.image_path_cenital_proc;
  375 |             document.getElementById(`img-lateral-orig-${sessionId}`).src = '/static/' + selected.image_path_lateral_orig;
  376 |             document.getElementById(`img-lateral-proc-${sessionId}`).src = '/static/' + selected.image_path_lateral_proc;
  377 | 
  378 |             document.getElementById(`metric-area-${sessionId}`).innerText = `${selected.foliar_area_cm2} cm²`;
  379 |             document.getElementById(`metric-height-${sessionId}`).innerText = `${selected.plant_height_cm} cm`;
  380 |             document.getElementById(`metric-diameter-${sessionId}`).innerText = `${selected.stem_diameter_mm} mm`;

  385 |     async function deleteSession(sessionId) {
  386 |         if (!confirm('¿Estás seguro de que deseas eliminar permanentemente este período de fotos?')) return;
  387 |         try {
  388 |             const res = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${sessionId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
  389 |             const data = await res.json();
  390 |             if (data.status === 'success') {
  391 |                 window.location.reload();
  392 |             } else {
  393 |                 alert('Error: ' + data.message);
  394 |             }
  395 |         } catch (e) {
  396 |             alert('Error al eliminar período.');
  397 |         }
  398 |     }

  403 |     let lightboxState = {
  404 |         zoom: 1.0,
  405 |         panX: 0,
  406 |         panY: 0,
  407 |         isPanning: false,
  408 |         startX: 0,
  409 |         startY: 0,
  410 |         isLoupeActive: false,
