  414 |     function openImageLightbox(src, title) {
  415 |         if (!src) return;
  416 |         const modal = document.getElementById('image-lightbox-modal');
  417 |         const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  418 |         const titleEl = document.getElementById('lightbox-title');
  419 |         const downloadLink = document.getElementById('lightbox-download-link');
  420 |         
  421 |         if (modal && img) {
  422 |             img.src = src;
  423 |             if (downloadLink) {
  424 |                 downloadLink.href = src;
  425 |                 downloadLink.download = (title ? title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') : 'captura_sifma') + '.jpg';
  426 |             }
  427 |             if (titleEl && title) titleEl.innerText = title;
  428 |             modal.style.display = 'flex';
  429 |             document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  430 |             resetLightboxZoom();
  431 |         }
  432 |     }
  433 | 
  434 |     function closeImageLightbox(e) {
  435 |         const modal = document.getElementById('image-lightbox-modal');
  436 |         if (modal) {
  437 |             modal.style.display = 'none';
  438 |             document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
  439 |             if (lightboxState.isLoupeActive) toggleLoupeMode();
  440 |         }
  441 |     }
  442 | 
  443 |     function adjustLightboxZoom(delta, originClientX, originClientY) {
  444 |         const oldZoom = lightboxState.zoom;
  445 |         const newZoom = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(12.0, oldZoom + delta));
  446 |         if (newZoom === oldZoom) return;
  447 | 
  448 |         const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  449 |         const viewport = document.getElementById('lightbox-viewport');
  450 | 
  451 |         if (originClientX !== undefined && originClientY !== undefined && img && viewport) {
  452 |             const vpRect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
  453 |             const mouseX = originClientX - vpRect.left;
  454 |             const mouseY = originClientY - vpRect.top;
  455 | 
  456 |             // Zoom centrado hacia el cursor
  457 |             const zoomRatio = newZoom / oldZoom;
  458 |             lightboxState.panX = mouseX - (mouseX - lightboxState.panX) * zoomRatio;
  459 |             lightboxState.panY = mouseY - (mouseY - lightboxState.panY) * zoomRatio;
  460 |         } else if (viewport) {
  461 |             // Zoom centrado en el medio del viewport
  462 |             const vpW = viewport.clientWidth / 2;
  463 |             const vpH = viewport.clientHeight / 2;
  464 |             const zoomRatio = newZoom / oldZoom;
  465 |             lightboxState.panX = vpW - (vpW - lightboxState.panX) * zoomRatio;
  466 |             lightboxState.panY = vpH - (vpH - lightboxState.panY) * zoomRatio;
  467 |         }
  468 | 
  469 |         lightboxState.zoom = newZoom;
  470 |         applyLightboxTransform();
  471 |     }
  472 | 
  473 |     function resetLightboxZoom() {
  474 |         lightboxState.zoom = 1.0;
  475 |         const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  476 |         const viewport = document.getElementById('lightbox-viewport');
  477 |         if (img && viewport) {
  478 |             lightboxState.panX = (viewport.clientWidth - img.offsetWidth) / 2;
  479 |             lightboxState.panY = (viewport.clientHeight - img.offsetHeight) / 2;
  480 |         } else {
  481 |             lightboxState.panX = 0;
  482 |             lightboxState.panY = 0;
  483 |         }
  484 |         applyLightboxTransform();
  485 |     }
  486 | 
  487 |     function applyLightboxTransform() {
  488 |         const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  489 |         const level = document.getElementById('lightbox-zoom-level');
  490 |         if (img) {
  491 |             img.style.transform = `translate(${lightboxState.panX}px, ${lightboxState.panY}px) scale(${lightboxState.zoom})`;
  492 |         }
  493 |         if (level) {
  494 |             level.innerText = `${Math.round(lightboxState.zoom * 100)}%`;
  495 |         }
  496 |     }
  497 | 
  498 |     function setLoupePower(power, btnElement) {
  499 |         lightboxState.loupePower = power;
  500 |         document.querySelectorAll('.btn-loupe-power').forEach(b => {
  501 |             b.style.background = 'transparent';
  502 |             b.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
  503 |             b.style.color = '#cbd5e1';
  504 |         });
  505 |         if (btnElement) {
  506 |             btnElement.style.background = '#38bdf8';
  507 |             btnElement.style.borderColor = '#38bdf8';
  508 |             btnElement.style.color = '#090d16';
  509 |         }
  510 |         const badge = document.getElementById('loupe-power-badge');
  511 |         if (badge) badge.innerText = `${power.toFixed(1)}x LOUPE`;
  512 | 
  513 |         // Si la lupa no está activa, activarla automáticamente
  514 |         if (!lightboxState.isLoupeActive) {
  515 |             toggleLoupeMode();
  516 |         }
  517 |     }
  518 | 
  519 |     function toggleLoupeMode() {
  520 |         lightboxState.isLoupeActive = !lightboxState.isLoupeActive;
  521 |         const loupe = document.getElementById('lightbox-loupe');
  522 |         const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-loupe');
  523 |         const viewport = document.getElementById('lightbox-viewport');
  524 |         const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  525 | 
  526 |         if (lightboxState.isLoupeActive) {
  527 |             if (loupe && img) {
  528 |                 loupe.style.display = 'block';
  529 |                 loupe.style.backgroundImage = `url('${img.src}')`;
  530 |             }
  531 |             if (btn) {
  532 |                 btn.className = 'btn btn-primary btn-sm';
  533 |                 btn.style.background = '#38bdf8';
  534 |                 btn.style.color = '#090d16';
  535 |             }
  536 |             if (viewport) viewport.style.cursor = 'crosshair';
  537 |         } else {
  538 |             if (loupe) loupe.style.display = 'none';
  539 |             if (btn) {
  540 |                 btn.className = 'btn btn-outline btn-sm';
  541 |                 btn.style.background = 'transparent';
  542 |                 btn.style.color = '#fff';
  543 |             }
  544 |             if (viewport) viewport.style.cursor = 'grab';
  545 |         }
  546 |     }
  547 | 
  548 |     // Inicialización de eventos interactivos del Lightbox
  549 |     const lbViewport = document.getElementById('lightbox-viewport');
  550 |     if (lbViewport) {
  551 |         // Zoom con rueda del ratón
  552 |         lbViewport.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
  553 |             e.preventDefault();
  554 |             if (lightboxState.isLoupeActive) {
  555 |                 // Si la lupa está activa, ajustar aumento de la lupa con la rueda
  556 |                 const deltaPower = e.deltaY < 0 ? 0.5 : -0.5;
  557 |                 lightboxState.loupePower = Math.max(1.5, Math.min(12.0, lightboxState.loupePower + deltaPower));
  558 |                 const badge = document.getElementById('loupe-power-badge');
  559 |                 if (badge) badge.innerText = `${lightboxState.loupePower.toFixed(1)}x LOUPE`;
  560 |             } else {
  561 |                 // Si no, hacer zoom al viewport hacia la posición del mouse
  562 |                 const delta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 0.35 : -0.35;
  563 |                 adjustLightboxZoom(delta, e.clientX, e.clientY);
  564 |             }
  565 |         }, { passive: false });
  566 | 
  567 |         // Doble Clic para Zoom Rápido hacia el punto
  568 |         lbViewport.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
  569 |             if (lightboxState.isLoupeActive) return;
  570 |             if (lightboxState.zoom > 1.2) {
  571 |                 resetLightboxZoom();
  572 |             } else {
  573 |                 lightboxState.zoom = 3.0;
  574 |                 const vpRect = lbViewport.getBoundingClientRect();
  575 |                 const mouseX = e.clientX - vpRect.left;
  576 |                 const mouseY = e.clientY - vpRect.top;
  577 |                 lightboxState.panX = mouseX - mouseX * 3.0;
  578 |                 lightboxState.panY = mouseY - mouseY * 3.0;
  579 |                 applyLightboxTransform();
  580 |             }
  581 |         });
  582 | 
  583 |         // Arrastrar y Mover Imagen (Pan)
  584 |         lbViewport.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
  585 |             if (lightboxState.isLoupeActive) return;
  586 |             lightboxState.isPanning = true;
  587 |             lightboxState.startX = e.clientX - lightboxState.panX;
  588 |             lightboxState.startY = e.clientY - lightboxState.panY;
  589 |             lbViewport.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
  590 |         });
  591 | 
  592 |         window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
  593 |             const loupe = document.getElementById('lightbox-loupe');
  594 |             const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  595 | 
  596 |             // 1. Manejo del Modo Lupa Circular
  597 |             if (lightboxState.isLoupeActive && loupe && img && img.complete) {
  598 |                 const rect = lbViewport.getBoundingClientRect();
  599 |                 const imgRect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
  600 |                 const mouseX = e.clientX;
  601 |                 const mouseY = e.clientY;
  602 | 
  603 |                 if (mouseX >= rect.left && mouseX <= rect.right && mouseY >= rect.top && mouseY <= rect.bottom) {
  604 |                     loupe.style.display = 'block';
  605 |                     const loupeSize = 240;
  606 |                     loupe.style.left = `${mouseX - rect.left - loupeSize / 2}px`;
  607 |                     loupe.style.top = `${mouseY - rect.top - loupeSize / 2}px`;
  608 | 
  609 |                     // Calcular coordenadas relativas dentro de la imagen renderizada
  610 |                     const relX = (mouseX - imgRect.left) / imgRect.width;
  611 |                     const relY = (mouseY - imgRect.top) / imgRect.height;
  612 | 
  613 |                     const zoomFactor = lightboxState.loupePower;
  614 |                     const bgW = imgRect.width * zoomFactor;
  615 |                     const bgH = imgRect.height * zoomFactor;
  616 | 
  617 |                     loupe.style.backgroundSize = `${bgW}px ${bgH}px`;
  618 |                     loupe.style.backgroundPosition = `-${relX * bgW - loupeSize / 2}px -${relY * bgH - loupeSize / 2}px`;
  619 |                 } else {
  620 |                     loupe.style.display = 'none';
  621 |                 }
  622 |             }
  623 | 
  624 |             // 2. Manejo de Pan / Arrastre
  625 |             if (lightboxState.isPanning) {
  626 |                 lightboxState.panX = e.clientX - lightboxState.startX;
  627 |                 lightboxState.panY = e.clientY - lightboxState.startY;
  628 |                 applyLightboxTransform();
  629 |             }
  630 |         });
  631 | 
  632 |         window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  633 |             if (lightboxState.isPanning) {
  634 |                 lightboxState.isPanning = false;
  635 |                 if (!lightboxState.isLoupeActive) lbViewport.style.cursor = 'grab';
  636 |             }
  637 |         });
  638 |     }
  639 | 
  640 |     document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  641 |         if (e.key === 'Escape') {
  642 |             closeImageLightbox();
  643 |         } else if (e.key === '+' || e.key === '=') {
  644 |             adjustLightboxZoom(0.5);
  645 |         } else if (e.key === '-' || e.key === '_') {
  646 |             adjustLightboxZoom(-0.5);
  647 |         } else if (e.key === '0') {
  648 |             resetLightboxZoom();
  649 |         } else if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'l') {
  650 |             toggleLoupeMode();
  651 |         } else if (e.key === '1') {
  652 |             setLoupePower(2.5, document.querySelectorAll('.btn-loupe-power')[0]);
  653 |         } else if (e.key === '2') {
  654 |             setLoupePower(4.0, document.querySelectorAll('.btn-loupe-power')[1]);
  655 |         } else if (e.key === '3') {
  656 |             setLoupePower(8.0, document.querySelectorAll('.btn-loupe-power')[2]);
  657 |         }
  658 |     });
  659 | 
  660 |     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  661 |         const firstThumb = document.querySelector('.capture-thumb-card');
  662 |         if (firstThumb) {
  663 |             const firstId = firstThumb.getAttribute('data-session-id');
  664 |             selectSession(firstId);
  665 |         }
  666 |     });
  667 | </script>

  606 |     function createProgressTracker(initialText) {
  607 |         const pBar = document.getElementById('processing-status-bar');
  608 |         const pFill = document.getElementById('progress-bar-fill');
  609 |         const pText = document.getElementById('status-message');
  610 |         const pPct = document.getElementById('status-percent');
  611 | 
  612 |         pBar.style.display = 'block';
  613 |         pFill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #34d399)';
  614 |         pFill.style.width = '5%';
  615 |         pPct.innerText = '5%';
  616 |         pText.innerText = initialText || 'Iniciando procesamiento...';
  617 | 
  618 |         localStorage.setItem('sifma_processing_active', 'true');
  619 |         if (window.startGlobalProcessingMonitor) {
  620 |             window.startGlobalProcessingMonitor();
  621 |         }
  622 | 
  623 |         let isPolling = true;
  624 | 
  625 |         const pollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
  626 |             if (!isPolling) return;
  627 |             try {
  628 |                 const res = await fetch('/api/processing/progress');
  629 |                 if (res.ok) {
  630 |                     const prog = await res.json();
  631 |                     if (prog && typeof prog.percent === 'number') {
  632 |                         const targetPct = Math.max(5, Math.min(99, prog.percent));
  633 |                         pFill.style.width = `${targetPct}%`;
  634 |                         pPct.innerText = `${targetPct}%`;
  635 |                         if (prog.message) {
  636 |                             pText.innerText = prog.message;
  637 |                         }
  638 |                     }
  639 |                 }
  640 |             } catch (e) {}
  641 |         }, 350);
  642 | 
  643 |         return {
  644 |             finish: (successMsg) => {
  645 |                 isPolling = false;
  646 |                 clearInterval(pollInterval);
  647 |                 localStorage.removeItem('sifma_processing_active');
  648 |                 pFill.style.width = '100%';
  649 |                 pPct.innerText = '100%';
  650 |                 pText.innerText = successMsg || '¡Procesamiento fenotípico completado con éxito!';
  651 | 
  652 |                 if (window.showToast) {
  653 |                     window.showToast({
  654 |                         type: 'success',
  655 |                         title: '¡Procesamiento Fenotípico Finalizado!',
  656 |                         message: successMsg || 'Lote procesado exitosamente para Canastilla #' + activePlantId,
  657 |                         duration: 4500
  658 |                     });
  659 |                 }
  660 |             },
  661 |             fail: (errorMsg) => {
  662 |                 isPolling = false;
  663 |                 clearInterval(pollInterval);
  664 |                 localStorage.removeItem('sifma_processing_active');
  665 |                 pFill.style.background = '#ef4444';
  666 |                 pText.innerText = 'Error: ' + errorMsg;
  667 | 
  668 |                 if (window.showToast) {
  669 |                     window.showToast({
  670 |                         type: 'error',
  671 |                         title: 'Error de Procesamiento',
  672 |                         message: errorMsg,
  673 |                         duration: 5000
  674 |                     });
  675 |                 }
  676 |             }
  677 |         };
  678 |     }

  680 |     async function processSingleBatch(folderPath, periodStr) {
  681 |         const lotsBody = document.getElementById('section-lots-body');
  682 |         if (lotsBody && (lotsBody.style.display === 'none' || lotsBody.style.display === '')) {
  683 |             toggleCollapsibleSection('section-lots-body', 'icon-lots-toggle', 'btn-lots-text');
  684 |         }
  685 | 
  686 |         const calDate = document.getElementById('calendar-date-picker').value;
  687 |         const tracker = createProgressTracker(`Iniciando procesamiento de ${periodStr}...`);
  688 | 
  689 |         try {
  690 |             const finalPeriod = calDate ? `${calDate} - ${periodStr}` : periodStr;
  691 |             const res = await fetch('/api/process_usb_path', {
  692 |                 method: 'POST',
  693 |                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  694 |                 body: JSON.stringify({ folder_path: folderPath, period: finalPeriod, plant_id: activePlantId })
  695 |             });
  696 |             const data = await res.json();
  697 | 
  698 |             if (res.ok && data.status === 'success') {
  699 |                 tracker.finish(data.message || '¡Procesamiento fenotípico finalizado con éxito!');
  700 |                 setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1400);
  701 |             } else {
  702 |                 tracker.fail(data.message || 'Fallo en procesamiento');
  703 |             }
  704 |         } catch (e) {
  705 |             tracker.fail('Error de comunicación con el servidor.');
  706 |         }
  707 |     }

  709 |     async function processSelectedUSBBatches() {
  710 |         const checked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.usb-batch-check:checked'));
  711 |         if (checked.length === 0) {
  712 |             alert('Por favor selecciona al menos una carpeta para procesar.');
  713 |             return;
  714 |         }
  715 | 
  716 |         const selectedPaths = checked.map(chk => chk.value);
  717 |         const lotsBody = document.getElementById('section-lots-body');
  718 |         if (lotsBody && (lotsBody.style.display === 'none' || lotsBody.style.display === '')) {
  719 |             toggleCollapsibleSection('section-lots-body', 'icon-lots-toggle', 'btn-lots-text');
  720 |         }
  721 | 
  722 |         const calDate = document.getElementById('calendar-date-picker').value;
  723 |         const tracker = createProgressTracker(`Iniciando procesamiento de ${selectedPaths.length} lote(s) seleccionados...`);
  724 | 
  725 |         try {
  726 |             const res = await fetch('/api/process_usb_path', {
  727 |                 method: 'POST',

  729 |                 body: JSON.stringify({

  731 |                     period: calDate || 'Día 1',
  732 |                     plant_id: activePlantId

  738 |                 tracker.finish(data.message || 'Lotes seleccionados procesados exitosamente.');

  740 |             } else {
  741 |                 tracker.fail(data.message || 'Fallo en procesamiento de lotes.');
  742 |             }
  743 |         } catch (e) {
  744 |             tracker.fail('Error de comunicación con el servidor.');
  745 |         }
  746 |     }

  776 |     async function submitManualBatch() {
  777 |         const lotsBody = document.getElementById('section-lots-body');
  778 |         if (lotsBody && (lotsBody.style.display === 'none' || lotsBody.style.display === '')) {
  779 |             toggleCollapsibleSection('section-lots-body', 'icon-lots-toggle', 'btn-lots-text');
  780 |         }
  781 | 
  782 |         const fileInput = document.getElementById('file-input');
  783 |         const calDate = document.getElementById('calendar-date-picker').value;
  784 |         if (!fileInput.files || fileInput.files.length === 0) {
  785 |             alert('Por favor selecciona un archivo .ZIP o imágenes para procesar.');
  786 |             return;
  787 |         }
  788 | 
  789 |         const tracker = createProgressTracker('Subiendo y procesando archivos...');
  790 | 
  791 |         const formData = new FormData();
  792 |         for (let i = 0; i < fileInput.files.length; i++) {
  793 |             formData.append('images', fileInput.files[i]);
  794 |         }
  795 |         formData.append('period', calDate || 'Día 1');
  796 |         formData.append('plant_id', activePlantId);
  797 | 
  798 |         try {
  799 |             const res = await fetch('/api/upload_manual_batch', {
  800 |                 method: 'POST',
  801 |                 body: formData
  802 |             });
  803 |             const data = await res.json();
  804 | 
  805 |             if (res.ok && data.status === 'success') {
  806 |                 tracker.finish(data.message || 'Archivos procesados con éxito.');
  807 |                 setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1400);
  808 |             } else {
  809 |                 tracker.fail(data.message || 'Error al procesar lote.');
  810 |             }
  811 |         } catch (e) {
  812 |             tracker.fail('Error de conexión durante la subida.');
  813 |         }
  814 |     }
  815 | </script>
  816 | {% endblock %}

 1611 |         function applyPhotoDisplayFilter(filterType) {
 1612 |             const container = document.getElementById('sec-photos');
 1613 |             const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.photo-comp-card');
 1614 |             
 1615 |             if (filterType === 'none') {
 1616 |                 if (container) container.style.display = 'none';
 1617 |                 return;
 1618 |             } else {
 1619 |                 if (container) container.style.display = 'block';
 1620 |             }
 1621 | 
 1622 |             cards.forEach(card => {
 1623 |                 const isLast = card.dataset.isLast === 'true';
 1624 |                 const timeStr = card.dataset.time || '';
 1625 |                 const hour = parseInt(timeStr.split(':')[0] || '0', 10);
 1626 | 
 1627 |                 if (filterType === 'all') {
 1628 |                     card.style.display = 'block';
 1629 |                 } else if (filterType === 'last') {
 1630 |                     card.style.display = isLast ? 'block' : 'none';
 1631 |                 } else if (filterType === 'morning') {
 1632 |                     card.style.display = (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) ? 'block' : 'none';
 1633 |                 } else if (filterType === 'afternoon') {
 1634 |                     card.style.display = (hour >= 12 && hour <= 18) ? 'block' : 'none';
 1635 |                 }
 1636 |             });
 1637 |         }

 1785 |         function initSignatureCanvas() {
 1786 |             canvas = document.getElementById('signature-pad');
 1787 |             if (!canvas) return;
 1788 |             ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
 1789 | 
 1790 |             function resizeCanvas() {
 1791 |                 const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 1792 |                 canvas.width = rect.width * 2;
 1793 |                 canvas.height = rect.height * 2;
 1794 |                 ctx.scale(2, 2);
 1795 |                 ctx.lineCap = 'round';
 1796 |                 ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
 1797 |                 ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
 1798 |                 ctx.strokeStyle = penColor;
 1799 |             }
 1800 |             resizeCanvas();
 1801 | 
 1802 |             function getPos(e) {
 1803 |                 const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 1804 |                 const clientX = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;
 1805 |                 const clientY = e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;
 1806 |                 return { x: clientX - rect.left, y: clientY - rect.top };
 1807 |             }
 1808 | 
 1809 |             function startDraw(e) {
 1810 |                 isDrawing = true;
 1811 |                 const pos = getPos(e);
 1812 |                 ctx.beginPath();
 1813 |                 ctx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y);
 1814 |                 e.preventDefault();
 1815 |             }
 1816 | 
 1817 |             function draw(e) {
 1818 |                 if (!isDrawing) return;
 1819 |                 const pos = getPos(e);
 1820 |                 ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y);
 1821 |                 ctx.stroke();
 1822 |                 e.preventDefault();
 1823 |             }
 1824 | 
 1825 |             function stopDraw() {
 1826 |                 if (isDrawing) {
 1827 |                     isDrawing = false;
 1828 |                     stagedSignatureDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
 1829 |                 }
 1830 |             }
 1831 | 
 1832 |             canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', startDraw);
 1833 |             canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', draw);
 1834 |             window.addEventListener('mouseup', stopDraw);
 1835 |             canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', startDraw, { passive: false });
 1836 |             canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', draw, { passive: false });
 1837 |             canvas.addEventListener('touchend', stopDraw);
 1838 |         }

 1876 |         function handleSignatureFile(e) {
 1877 |             const file = e.target.files[0];
 1878 |             if (!file) return;
 1879 | 
 1880 |             const reader = new FileReader();
 1881 |             reader.onload = (event) => {
 1882 |                 const img = new Image();
 1883 |                 img.onload = () => {
 1884 |                     const removeWhite = document.getElementById('chk-remove-white-bg').checked;
 1885 |                     if (removeWhite) {
 1886 |                         const tempCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
 1887 |                         tempCanvas.width = img.width;
 1888 |                         tempCanvas.height = img.height;
 1889 |                         const tempCtx = tempCanvas.getContext('2d');
 1890 |                         tempCtx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
 1891 |                         const imgData = tempCtx.getImageData(0, 0, tempCanvas.width, tempCanvas.height);
 1892 |                         const data = imgData.data;
 1893 | 
 1894 |                         for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
 1895 |                             const r = data[i];
 1896 |                             const g = data[i+1];
 1897 |                             const b = data[i+2];
 1898 |                             if (r > 215 && g > 215 && b > 215) {
 1899 |                                 data[i+3] = 0;
 1900 |                             }
 1901 |                         }
 1902 |                         tempCtx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
 1903 |                         stagedSignatureDataUrl = tempCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
 1904 |                     } else {
 1905 |                         stagedSignatureDataUrl = event.target.result;
 1906 |                     }
 1907 | 
 1908 |                     const pImg = document.getElementById('sig-modal-preview-img');
 1909 |                     pImg.src = stagedSignatureDataUrl;
 1910 |                     document.getElementById('sig-crop-preview-box').style.display = 'block';
 1911 |                 };
 1912 |                 img.src = event.target.result;
 1913 |             };
 1914 |             reader.readAsDataURL(file);
 1915 |         }
 1916 | 
 1917 |         function applySignatureFromModal() {
 1918 |             const targetId = document.getElementById('modal-target-signee').value;
 1919 |             let finalDataUrl = stagedSignatureDataUrl;
 1920 | 
 1921 |             if (activeTab === 'draw' && (!finalDataUrl || finalDataUrl.length < 100)) {
 1922 |                 finalDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
 1923 |             }
 1924 | 
 1925 |             if (!finalDataUrl) {
 1926 |                 alert('Por favor dibuja o sube una imagen de tu firma antes de estampar.');
 1927 |                 return;
 1928 |             }
 1929 | 
 1930 |             renderSignatureSlot(targetId, finalDataUrl);
 1931 | 
 1932 |             if (document.getElementById('chk-remember-sig').checked) {
 1933 |                 localStorage.setItem(`sifma_saved_signature_${targetId}`, finalDataUrl);
 1934 |             }
 1935 | 
 1936 |             closeSignatureModal();
 1937 |         }
 1938 | 
 1939 |         function renderSignatureSlot(targetId, dataUrl) {
 1940 |             const emptySlot = document.getElementById(`sig-slot-empty-${targetId}`);
 1941 |             const filledSlot = document.getElementById(`sig-slot-filled-${targetId}`);
 1942 |             const previewImg = document.getElementById(`sig-img-preview-${targetId}`);
 1943 | 
 1944 |             if (emptySlot && filledSlot && previewImg) {
 1945 |                 previewImg.src = dataUrl;
 1946 |                 emptySlot.style.display = 'none';
 1947 |                 filledSlot.style.display = 'block';
 1948 |             }
 1949 |         }
 1950 | 
 1951 |         function removeSignature(targetId) {
 1952 |             const emptySlot = document.getElementById(`sig-slot-empty-${targetId}`);
 1953 |             const filledSlot = document.getElementById(`sig-slot-filled-${targetId}`);
 1954 |             const previewImg = document.getElementById(`sig-img-preview-${targetId}`);
 1955 | 
 1956 |             if (emptySlot && filledSlot && previewImg) {
 1957 |                 previewImg.src = '';
 1958 |                 filledSlot.style.display = 'none';
 1959 |                 emptySlot.style.display = 'flex';
 1960 |                 localStorage.removeItem(`sifma_saved_signature_${targetId}`);
 1961 |             }
 1962 |         }
 1963 | 
 1964 |         function loadSavedSignatures() {
 1965 |             const sig1 = localStorage.getItem('sifma_saved_signature_1');
 1966 |             const sig2 = localStorage.getItem('sifma_saved_signature_2');
 1967 |             if (sig1) renderSignatureSlot(1, sig1);
 1968 |             if (sig2) renderSignatureSlot(2, sig2);
 1969 |         }

  552 |     let rawTimelineData = {{ sensor_data.timeline | tojson | safe }};

  554 |     let activeWindowSize = 30; // Por defecto: ventana deslizante de 30 puntos

  557 |

  561 |     function getSlicedData(dataArray) {
  562 |         if (!dataArray || !dataArray.length) return [];
  563 |         if (activeWindowSize === 'all') return dataArray;
  564 |         return dataArray.slice(-activeWindowSize);
  565 |     }
  566 | 
  567 |     function toggleKpiCategory(cat, btn) {
  568 |         document.querySelectorAll('#btn-kpi-all, #btn-kpi-ambient, #btn-kpi-water').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  569 |         if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  570 | 
  571 |         const ambientCards = document.querySelectorAll('.kpi-card-ambient');
  572 |         const waterCards = document.querySelectorAll('.kpi-card-water');
  573 | 
  574 |         if (cat === 'all') {
  575 |             ambientCards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'block');
  576 |             waterCards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'block');
  577 |         } else if (cat === 'ambient') {
  578 |             ambientCards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'block');
  579 |             waterCards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'none');
  580 |         } else if (cat === 'water') {
  581 |             ambientCards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'none');
  582 |             waterCards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'block');
  583 |         }
  584 |     }
  585 | 
  586 |     function setChartGroup(group, btn) {
  587 |         currentChartGroup = group;
  588 |         document.querySelectorAll('#btn-group-ambient, #btn-group-water, #btn-group-all').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  589 |         if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  590 | 
  591 |         const waterCharts = document.querySelectorAll('.chart-card-water');
  592 |         const ambientCharts = document.querySelectorAll('.chart-card-ambient');
  593 | 
  594 |         if (group === 'all') {
  595 |             waterCharts.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'block');
  596 |             ambientCharts.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'block');

  630 |         function createChart(ctxId, label, data, color, yUnit, isStep = false) {
  631 |             const ctx = document.getElementById(ctxId);
  632 |             if (!ctx) return;

  648 |                         pointRadius: 0,

  650 |                         pointHitRadius: 8
  651 |                     }]

  677 |                 }
  678 |             });
  679 |         }

  862 |     async function checkLiveTelemetry() {
  863 |         try {
  864 |             const sRes = await fetch('/api/telemetry/status');
  865 |             const sData = await sRes.json();
  866 |             
  867 |             if (sData.status === 'success' && sData.telemetry) {
  868 |                 const tel = sData.telemetry;
  869 |                 const r = tel.latest_reading;
  870 |                 
  871 |                 const btnStart = document.getElementById('btn-start-telemetry');
  872 |                 const btnStop = document.getElementById('btn-stop-telemetry');
  873 |                 const statusDot = document.querySelector('.status-dot');
  874 |                 const statusText = document.getElementById('antenna-live-status-text');
  875 | 
  876 |                 if (tel.is_recording) {
  877 |                     if (btnStart) btnStart.style.display = 'none';
  878 |                     if (btnStop) btnStop.style.display = 'inline-flex';
  879 |                     if (statusDot) { statusDot.classList.remove('inactive'); statusDot.classList.add('active'); }
  880 |                     if (statusText) { statusText.innerText = `Transmitiendo en Vivo (${tel.readings_count} lecturas)`; statusText.style.color = 'var(--accent-success)'; }
  881 | 
  882 |                     if (r && tel.readings_count > 0) {
  883 |                         const nowLabel = (r.timestamp && r.timestamp.includes(' ')) ? r.timestamp.split(' ')[1] : new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  884 |                         
  885 |                         const newPoint = {
  886 |                             time: nowLabel,
  887 |                             timestamp: r.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
  888 |                             water_ph: r.water_ph !== undefined && r.water_ph !== null ? r.water_ph : 0.0,
  889 |                             ec_conductivity: r.ec_conductivity !== undefined && r.ec_conductivity !== null ? r.ec_conductivity : 0.0,
  890 |                             turbidity_ntu: r.turbidity_ntu !== undefined && r.turbidity_ntu !== null ? r.turbidity_ntu : 0.0,
  891 |                             dissolved_oxygen_mg_l: r.dissolved_oxygen_mg_l !== undefined && r.dissolved_oxygen_mg_l !== null ? r.dissolved_oxygen_mg_l : 0.0,
  892 |                             water_temp: r.water_temp !== undefined && r.water_temp !== null ? r.water_temp : 0.0,
  893 |                             motor_state: r.motor_state !== undefined && r.motor_state !== null ? r.motor_state : 0,
  894 |                             temperature: r.temperature !== undefined && r.temperature !== null ? r.temperature : 0.0,
  895 |                             humidity: r.humidity !== undefined && r.humidity !== null ? r.humidity : 0.0
  896 |                         };
  897 | 
  898 |                         if (!rawTimelineData.length || rawTimelineData[rawTimelineData.length - 1].time !== newPoint.time) {
  899 |                             rawTimelineData.push(newPoint);
  900 |                             if (rawTimelineData.length > 200) rawTimelineData.shift();
  901 |                             updateChartsWithNewData(rawTimelineData);
  902 |                         }
  903 |                     }
  904 |                 } else {
  905 |                     // Si ya se detuvo la captación, detener el sondeo en segundo plano
  906 |                     stopLivePolling();
  907 |                     if (btnStart) btnStart.style.display = 'inline-flex';
  908 |                     if (btnStop) btnStop.style.display = 'none';
  909 |                     if (statusDot) { statusDot.classList.remove('active'); statusDot.classList.add('inactive'); }
  910 |                     if (statusText) { statusText.innerText = 'Antena Inactiva'; statusText.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)'; }
  911 |                 }
  912 |             }
  913 |         } catch (e) {
  914 |             console.warn('Error en ciclo de actualización de telemetría:', e);
  915 |         }
  916 |     }

  918 |     async function toggleTelemetry(start) {
  919 |         const select = document.getElementById('antenna-port-select');
  920 |         const port = select ? select.value : '';
  921 |         
  922 |         if (start && (!port || port.trim() === '')) {
  923 |             alert('Atención: No se detecta ninguna antena receptora conectada por USB.\nConecte la antena a la computadora e intente nuevamente.');
  924 |             return;
  925 |         }
  926 | 
  927 |         const endpoint = start ? '/api/start_telemetry_recording' : '/api/stop_telemetry_recording';
  928 |         try {
  929 |             const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
  930 |                 method: 'POST',
  931 |                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  932 |                 body: JSON.stringify({ port: port })
  933 |             });
  934 |             const data = await res.json();
  935 |             if (res.ok && data.status === 'success') {
  936 |                 const btnStart = document.getElementById('btn-start-telemetry');
  937 |                 const btnStop = document.getElementById('btn-stop-telemetry');
  938 |                 const statusDot = document.querySelector('.status-dot');
  939 |                 const statusText = document.getElementById('antenna-live-status-text');
  940 | 
  941 |                 if (start) {
  942 |                     if (btnStart) btnStart.style.display = 'none';
  943 |                     if (btnStop) btnStop.style.display = 'inline-flex';
  944 |                     if (statusDot) { statusDot.classList.remove('inactive'); statusDot.classList.add('active'); }
  945 |                     if (statusText) { statusText.innerText = 'Transmitiendo en Vivo'; statusText.style.color = 'var(--accent-success)'; }
  946 |                     startLivePolling();
  947 |                 } else {
  948 |                     stopLivePolling();
  949 |                     if (btnStart) btnStart.style.display = 'inline-flex';
  950 |                     if (btnStop) btnStop.style.display = 'none';
  951 |                     if (statusDot) { statusDot.classList.remove('active'); statusDot.classList.add('inactive'); }
  952 |                     if (statusText) { statusText.innerText = 'Antena Inactiva'; statusText.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)'; }
  953 |                     setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 600);
  954 |                 }
  955 |             } else {
  956 |                 stopLivePolling();
  957 |                 alert('No se pudo iniciar la captación:\n' + (data.message || 'No se detectó antena o hubo un error al conectar.'));
  958 |             }
  959 |         } catch (e) {
  960 |             stopLivePolling();
  961 |             alert('Error de comunicación con el servidor.');
  962 |         }
  963 |     }

  414 | <script>
  415 |     const framesData = {{ timelapse_data.frames | tojson | safe }};
  416 |     const totalFrames = framesData ? framesData.length : 0;
  417 |     let currentFrameIndex = 0;
  418 |     let isPlaying = false;
  419 |     let playInterval = null;
  420 |     let playSpeed = 1.0;
  421 |     let isLooping = true;
  422 |     let activeCameraView = 'cenital';
  423 | 
  424 |     function initTimelapsePlayer() {
  425 |         if (!totalFrames) return;
  426 |         renderFrame(0);
  427 |     }
  428 | 
  429 |     function renderFrame(index) {
  430 |         if (!framesData || index < 0 || index >= totalFrames) return;
  431 |         currentFrameIndex = index;
  432 |         const frame = framesData[index];
  433 | 
  434 |         // 1. Actualizar Imágenes
  435 |         const imgCenital = document.getElementById('tl-img-cenital');
  436 |         const imgLateral = document.getElementById('tl-img-lateral');
  437 |         if (imgCenital) imgCenital.src = frame.cenital_url || frame.lateral_url;
  438 |         if (imgLateral) imgLateral.src = frame.lateral_url || frame.cenital_url;
  439 | 
  440 |         // 2. Actualizar HUD
  441 |         document.getElementById('hud-date-text').innerText = frame.date_str;
  442 |         document.getElementById('hud-period-text').innerText = frame.period;
  443 |         document.getElementById('hud-time-text').innerText = frame.time_str;
  444 |         document.getElementById('player-frame-counter').innerText = `Fotograma ${index + 1} / ${totalFrames}`;
  445 | 
  446 |         // 3. Sincronizar Slider
  447 |         const slider = document.getElementById('timeline-slider');
  448 |         if (slider) slider.value = index;
  449 | 
  450 |         // 4. Actualizar Gauges Biométricos
  451 |         document.getElementById('gauge-foliar-area').innerText = `${frame.foliar_area_cm2} cm²`;
  452 |         document.getElementById('gauge-plant-height').innerText = `${frame.plant_height_cm} cm`;
  453 |         document.getElementById('gauge-stem-dia').innerText = `${frame.stem_diameter_mm} mm`;
  454 |         document.getElementById('gauge-health-index').innerText = `${frame.health_index}%`;
  455 | 
  456 |         // Barras porcentuales relativas
  457 |         const maxAreaExpected = 150.0;
  458 |         const maxHeightExpected = 40.0;
  459 |         const areaPct = Math.min((frame.foliar_area_cm2 / maxAreaExpected) * 100, 100);
  460 |         const heightPct = Math.min((frame.plant_height_cm / maxHeightExpected) * 100, 100);
  461 |         document.getElementById('gauge-bar-area-fill').style.width = `${areaPct}%`;
  462 |         document.getElementById('gauge-bar-height-fill').style.width = `${heightPct}%`;
  463 | 
  464 |         // 5. Actualizar Gauges Ambientales
  465 |         document.getElementById('gauge-env-temp').innerText = `${frame.temperature} °C`;
  466 |         document.getElementById('gauge-env-hum').innerText = `${frame.humidity} %`;
  467 |         document.getElementById('gauge-env-uv').innerText = `${frame.uv_solar} lux`;
  468 |         document.getElementById('gauge-env-curr').innerText = `${frame.motor_current} A`;
  469 | 
  470 |         // 6. Resaltar Filmstrip Card activa
  471 |         document.querySelectorAll('.filmstrip-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  472 |         const activeCard = document.getElementById(`filmstrip-item-${index}`);
  473 |         if (activeCard) {
  474 |             activeCard.classList.add('active');
  475 |             activeCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
  476 |         }
  477 |     }
  478 | 
  479 |     function togglePlayPause() {
  480 |         if (isPlaying) {
  481 |             pauseTimelapse();
  482 |         } else {
  483 |             playTimelapse();
  484 |         }
  485 |     }
  486 | 
  487 |     function playTimelapse() {
  488 |         if (totalFrames <= 1) return;
  489 |         isPlaying = true;
  490 |         document.getElementById('play-pause-icon').innerText = 'pause';
  491 |         document.getElementById('play-pause-text').innerText = 'Pausar';
  492 | 
  493 |         const baseIntervalMs = 1000;
  494 |         const intervalMs = baseIntervalMs / playSpeed;
  495 | 
  496 |         clearInterval(playInterval);
  497 |         playInterval = setInterval(() => {
  498 |             if (currentFrameIndex >= totalFrames - 1) {
  499 |                 if (isLooping) {
  500 |                     renderFrame(0);
  501 |                 } else {
  502 |                     pauseTimelapse();
  503 |                 }
  504 |             } else {
  505 |                 renderFrame(currentFrameIndex + 1);
  506 |             }
  507 |         }, intervalMs);
  508 |     }
  509 | 
  510 |     function pauseTimelapse() {
  511 |         isPlaying = false;
  512 |         clearInterval(playInterval);
  513 |         document.getElementById('play-pause-icon').innerText = 'play_arrow';
  514 |         document.getElementById('play-pause-text').innerText = 'Reproducir';
  515 |     }
  516 | 
  517 |     function stepFrame(delta) {
  518 |         pauseTimelapse();
  519 |         let nextIdx = currentFrameIndex + delta;
  520 |         if (nextIdx < 0) nextIdx = 0;
  521 |         if (nextIdx >= totalFrames) nextIdx = totalFrames - 1;
  522 |         renderFrame(nextIdx);
  523 |     }
  524 | 
  525 |     function onSliderSeek(val) {
  526 |         pauseTimelapse();
  527 |         renderFrame(parseInt(val));
  528 |     }
  529 | 
  530 |     function jumpToFrame(index) {
  531 |         pauseTimelapse();
  532 |         renderFrame(index);
  533 |     }
  534 | 
  535 |     function setPlaySpeed(speed, btnElement) {
  536 |         playSpeed = speed;
  537 |         document.querySelectorAll('.speed-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  538 |         if (btnElement) btnElement.classList.add('active');
  539 |         if (isPlaying) {
  540 |             playTimelapse();
  541 |         }
  542 |     }
  543 | 
  544 |     function toggleLoop() {
  545 |         isLooping = !isLooping;
  546 |         const icon = document.getElementById('loop-icon');
  547 |         if (isLooping) {
  548 |             icon.style.color = 'var(--accent-success)';
  549 |         } else {
  550 |             icon.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
  551 |         }
  552 |     }
  553 | 
  554 |     function switchCameraView(view) {
  555 |         activeCameraView = view;
  556 |         document.querySelectorAll('.filter-group .filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  557 |         const activeBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-view-${view}`);
  558 |         if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
  559 | 
  560 |         const stage = document.getElementById('timelapse-stage');
  561 |         const wrapCenital = document.getElementById('wrapper-cenital');
  562 |         const wrapLateral = document.getElementById('wrapper-lateral');
  563 | 
  564 |         if (view === 'cenital') {
  565 |             stage.style.display = 'flex';
  566 |             wrapCenital.style.display = 'flex';
  567 |             wrapLateral.style.display = 'none';
  568 |         } else if (view === 'lateral') {
  569 |             stage.style.display = 'flex';
  570 |             wrapCenital.style.display = 'none';
  571 |             wrapLateral.style.display = 'flex';
  572 |         } else if (view === 'dual') {
  573 |             stage.style.display = 'grid';
  574 |             stage.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr';
  575 |             wrapCenital.style.display = 'flex';
  576 |             wrapLateral.style.display = 'flex';
  577 |         }
  578 |     }

  582 |         if (e.code === 'Space' && e.target.tagName !== 'INPUT') {
  583 |             e.preventDefault();

  585 |         }

  599 | async function handleEditUser(e) {
  600 |     e.preventDefault();
  601 |     const userId = document.getElementById('edit-user-id').value;
  602 |     const perms = getCheckedPermissions('edit');
  603 |     const roleSelect = document.getElementById('edit-role');
  604 | 
  605 |     const payload = {
  606 |         full_name: document.getElementById('edit-fullname').value.trim(),
  607 |         email: document.getElementById('edit-email').value.trim(),
  608 |         role: roleSelect.disabled ? 'admin' : roleSelect.value,
  609 |         permissions: perms
  610 |     };
  611 |     const newPass = document.getElementById('edit-password').value;
  612 |     const avatarFile = document.getElementById('edit-avatar-input').files[0];
  613 | 
  614 |     try {
  615 |         const res = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`, {
  616 |             method: 'PUT',
  617 |             headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  618 |             body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  619 |         });
  620 |         const data = await res.json();
  621 | 
  622 |         // Si se seleccionó una nueva foto de avatar
  623 |         if (avatarFile) {
  624 |             const avatarFormData = new FormData();
  625 |             avatarFormData.append('avatar', avatarFile);
  626 |             await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}/avatar`, {
  627 |                 method: 'POST',
  628 |                 body: avatarFormData
  629 |             });
  630 |         }
  631 | 
  632 |         if (newPass && newPass.length >= 4) {
  633 |             await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}/reset_password`, {
  634 |                 method: 'POST',
  635 |                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  636 |                 body: JSON.stringify({ password: newPass })
  637 |             });
  638 |         }
  639 | 
  640 |         if (data.status === 'success') {
  641 |             if (window.showToast) {
  642 |                 window.showToast({
  643 |                     type: 'success',
  644 |                     title: 'Usuario Actualizado',
  645 |                     message: 'Los datos, foto de perfil y permisos han sido actualizados con éxito.'
  646 |                 });
  647 |             } else {
  648 |                 alert('Usuario actualizado con éxito.');
  649 |             }

  651 |         } else {
  652 |             alert('Error: ' + data.message);
  653 |         }
  654 |     } catch (err) {
  655 |         alert('Error al actualizar usuario.');
  656 |     }
  657 | }

   34 | class CameraCalibrationApp(tk.Tk):
   35 |     """
   36 |     Herramienta Independiente de Calibración y Enfoque en Vivo para Cámaras Arducam (MIPI CSI).
   37 |     - Monocámara activa: Solo activa UNA cámara a la vez (Cenital 0 o Lateral 1).
   38 |     - Rotación física en tiempo real:
   39 |       * Cenital (CAM 0): Rotada 180° + Detección de ROI Circular de Canastilla Azul.
   40 |       * Lateral (CAM 1): Rotada 90° a la derecha (sentido horario) para orientación vertical del tallo.
   41 |     - Corrección de Color BGR/RGB: Elimina tonos azules no deseados en la piel y muestra colores botánicos reales.
   42 |     - Medidor de Nitidez / Enfoque en Tiempo Real (Laplacian Variance).
   43 |     - Grilla de alineación vertical de dosel y tallo.

  255 |     def _run_camera_loop(self, cam_idx):
  256 |         use_picam2 = False
  257 | 
  258 |         if HAS_PICAMERA2:
  259 |             try:
  260 |                 self.picam2_instance = Picamera2(cam_idx)
  261 |                 preview_cfg = self.picam2_instance.create_preview_configuration(main={"size": (640, 480)})
  262 |                 self.picam2_instance.configure(preview_cfg)
  263 |                 self.picam2_instance.start()
  264 |                 use_picam2 = True
  265 |                 print(f"[CALIBRACIÓN] Picamera2 iniciada en Puerto #{cam_idx}")
  266 |             except Exception as e:
  267 |                 print(f"[CALIBRACIÓN] No se pudo abrir Picamera2 en puerto {cam_idx}: {e}")
  268 |                 if self.picam2_instance is not None:
  269 |                     try: self.picam2_instance.close()
  270 |                     except Exception: pass
  271 |                 self.picam2_instance = None
  272 | 
  273 |         if not use_picam2 and HAS_OPENCV:
  274 |             try:
  275 |                 if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
  276 |                     self.cap_cv = cv2.VideoCapture(cam_idx, cv2.CAP_V4L2)
  277 |                 else:
  278 |                     self.cap_cv = cv2.VideoCapture(cam_idx)
  279 |                     
  280 |                 if self.cap_cv.isOpened():
  281 |                     self.cap_cv.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH, 640)
  282 |                     self.cap_cv.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT, 480)
  283 |                     print(f"[CALIBRACIÓN] OpenCV VideoCapture abierto en Puerto #{cam_idx}")
  284 |             except Exception as e:
  285 |                 print(f"[CALIBRACIÓN] Error en OpenCV: {e}")
  286 | 
  287 |         if not use_picam2 and (self.cap_cv is None or not self.cap_cv.isOpened()):
  288 |             cam_name = "CENITAL (CAM 0)" if cam_idx == 0 else "LATERAL (CAM 1)"
  289 |             self.after(0, self._show_camera_error, cam_name, cam_idx)
  290 |             return
  291 | 
  292 |         frame_count = 0
  293 |         last_time = time.time()
  294 |         fps = 0.0
  295 | 
  296 |         while self.is_streaming:
  297 |             raw_frame = None
  298 | 
  299 |             if use_picam2 and self.picam2_instance is not None:
  300 |                 try:
  301 |                     raw_frame = self.picam2_instance.capture_array()
  302 |                 except Exception:
  303 |                     break
  304 |             elif self.cap_cv is not None and self.cap_cv.isOpened():
  305 |                 ret, frame_bgr = self.cap_cv.read()
  306 |                 if ret and frame_bgr is not None:
  307 |                     raw_frame = frame_bgr
  308 |                 else:
  309 |                     time.sleep(0.05)
  310 |                     continue
  311 | 
  312 |             if raw_frame is None:
  313 |                 time.sleep(0.05)
  314 |                 continue
  315 | 
  316 |             if len(raw_frame.shape) == 3 and raw_frame.shape[2] == 4:
  317 |                 raw_frame = raw_frame[:, :, :3]
  318 | 
  319 |             # Inversión de color BGR a RGB para corregir tonos azules
  320 |             if self.swap_rb_channels:
  321 |                 if len(raw_frame.shape) == 3 and raw_frame.shape[2] >= 3:
  322 |                     frame_oriented = raw_frame[:, :, ::-1].copy()
  323 |                 else:
  324 |                     frame_oriented = raw_frame
  325 |             else:
  326 |                 frame_oriented = raw_frame.copy()
  327 | 
  328 |             # APLICAR ROTACIÓN FÍSICA SEGÚN CÁMARA
  329 |             if cam_idx == 0:
  330 |                 # Cámara 0 Cenital: Rotar 180°
  331 |                 frame_oriented = cv2.rotate(frame_oriented, cv2.ROTATE_180)
  332 |             else:
  333 |                 # Cámara 1 Lateral: Rotar 90° en sentido horario
  334 |                 frame_oriented = cv2.rotate(frame_oriented, cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE)
  335 | 
  336 |             h, w, _ = frame_oriented.shape
  337 |             display_frame = frame_oriented.copy()
  338 | 
  339 |             # Calcular Nitidez sobre el área central
  340 |             gray = cv2.cvtColor(display_frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
  341 |             lap_var = cv2.Laplacian(gray, cv2.CV_64F).var()
  342 | 
  343 |             # DIBUJAR GUÍAS DE CALIBRACIÓN
  344 |             if self.show_grid:
  345 |                 if cam_idx == 0:
  346 |                     # Guía Cenital: ROI Circular Automático de la Canastilla Azul donde está la planta
  347 |                     # 1. Segmentación previa de vegetación (planta/dosel)
  348 |                     hsv = cv2.cvtColor(frame_oriented, cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV) if self.swap_rb_channels else cv2.cvtColor(frame_oriented, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
  349 |                     lower_green = np.array([25, 30, 30])
  350 |                     upper_green = np.array([88, 255, 255])
  351 |                     mask_green = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_green, upper_green)
  352 |                     
  353 |                     if self.swap_rb_channels:
  354 |                         # frame_oriented is RGB -> split R, G, B
  355 |                         r_ch, g_ch, b_ch = cv2.split(frame_oriented.astype(np.float32))
  356 |                     else:
  357 |                         b_ch, g_ch, r_ch = cv2.split(frame_oriented.astype(np.float32))
  358 |                     exg = 2.0 * g_ch - r_ch - b_ch
  359 |                     exg_mask = np.uint8((exg > 15) & (g_ch > r_ch) & (g_ch > b_ch)) * 255
  360 |                     plant_mask = cv2.bitwise_or(mask_green, exg_mask)
  361 |                     
  362 |                     # 2. Segmentación de la canastilla azul
  363 |                     lower_blue = np.array([90, 45, 35])
  364 |                     upper_blue = np.array([140, 255, 255])
  365 |                     mask_blue = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower_blue, upper_blue)
  366 |                     kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (7, 7))
  367 |                     mask_blue_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_blue, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, kernel)
  368 |                     mask_blue_clean = cv2.morphologyEx(mask_blue_clean, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel)
  369 |                     
  370 |                     b_contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask_blue_clean, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
  371 |                     
  372 |                     found_basket = False
  373 |                     if b_contours:
  374 |                         min_r = int(min(w, h) * 0.05)
  375 |                         max_r = int(min(w, h) * 0.45)
  376 |                         candidates = []
  377 |                         
  378 |                         for c in b_contours:
  379 |                             area = cv2.contourArea(c)
  380 |                             if area < 400:
  381 |                                 continue
  382 |                             (bcx, bcy), brad = cv2.minEnclosingCircle(c)
  383 |                             brad = int(brad)
  384 |                             if brad < min_r or brad > max_r:
  385 |                                 continue
  386 |                                 
  387 |                             peri = cv2.arcLength(c, True)
  388 |                             circ = (4 * np.pi * area) / (peri * peri) if peri > 0 else 0
  389 |                             bx, by, bw, bh = cv2.boundingRect(c)
  390 |                             aspect = float(bw) / float(bh) if bh > 0 else 0
  391 |                             
  392 |                             c_mask = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.uint8)
  393 |                             cv2.circle(c_mask, (int(bcx), int(bcy)), brad, 255, -1)
  394 |                             green_in = cv2.countNonZero(cv2.bitwise_and(plant_mask, c_mask))
  395 |                             
  396 |                             aspect_diff = abs(1.0 - aspect)
  397 |                             score = (green_in * 5.0) + (circ * 300.0) - (aspect_diff * 150.0)
  398 |                             if bcy > h * 0.30:
  399 |                                 score += 200.0
  400 |                             if by < h * 0.08:
  401 |                                 score -= 500.0
  402 |                                 
  403 |                             candidates.append({'cx': int(bcx), 'cy': int(bcy), 'r': brad, 'score': score})
  404 |                             
  405 |                         if candidates:
  406 |                             best = max(candidates, key=lambda k: k['score'])
  407 |                             bcx, bcy, brad = best['cx'], best['cy'], int(best['r'] * 1.03)
  408 |                             cv2.circle(display_frame, (bcx, bcy), brad, (255, 180, 0), 2)
  409 |                             cv2.putText(display_frame, "CANASTILLA AZUL (ROI)", (max(10, bcx - 90), max(25, bcy - brad - 8)),
  410 |                                         cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5, (255, 180, 0), 2)
  411 |                             found_basket = True
  412 |                             
  413 |                     if not found_basket:
  414 |                         # Guía circular por defecto en la zona de la planta
  415 |                         cx, cy = w // 2, int(h * 0.60)
  416 |                         r = int(min(w, h) * 0.22)
  417 |                         cv2.circle(display_frame, (cx, cy), r, (0, 255, 255), 2)
  418 |                         cv2.putText(display_frame, "ZONA OBJETIVO CANASTILLA", (cx - 100, cy - r - 8),
  419 |                                     cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5, (0, 255, 255), 1)
  420 | 
  421 |                     # Cruz central suave
  422 |                     cv2.line(display_frame, (w // 2 - 25, h // 2), (w // 2 + 25, h // 2), (0, 255, 0), 1)
  423 |                     cv2.line(display_frame, (w // 2, h // 2 - 25), (w // 2, h // 2 + 25), (0, 255, 0), 1)
  424 | 
  425 |                 else:
  426 |                     # Guía Lateral: Eje vertical del tallo y nivel de sustrato basal
  427 |                     cx = w // 2
  428 |                     # Línea de medición vertical
  429 |                     cv2.line(display_frame, (cx, int(h * 0.15)), (cx, int(h * 0.85)), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  430 |                     cv2.line(display_frame, (cx - 25, int(h * 0.15)), (cx + 25, int(h * 0.15)), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  431 |                     cv2.line(display_frame, (cx - 25, int(h * 0.85)), (cx + 25, int(h * 0.85)), (0, 255, 255), 2)
  432 |                     
  433 |                     # Línea de base del sustrato (abajo)
  434 |                     cv2.line(display_frame, (int(w * 0.2), int(h * 0.85)), (int(w * 0.8), int(h * 0.85)), (0, 0, 255), 2)
  435 |                     cv2.putText(display_frame, "BASE SUSTRATO / CANASTILLA", (int(w * 0.2), int(h * 0.85) + 20),
  436 |                                 cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5, (0, 0, 255), 1)
  437 |                     cv2.putText(display_frame, "CRECIMIENTO VERTICAL ->", (cx + 10, int(h * 0.5)),
  438 |                                 cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5, (0, 255, 255), 1)
  439 | 
  440 |             # Cálculo de FPS
  441 |             frame_count += 1
  442 |             if time.time() - last_time >= 1.0:
  443 |                 fps = frame_count / (time.time() - last_time)
  444 |                 frame_count = 0
  445 |                 last_time = time.time()
  446 | 
  447 |             # Convertir a imagen Tkinter
  448 |             if HAS_PIL:
  449 |                 pil_img = Image.fromarray(display_frame)
  450 |                 vw = self.video_container.winfo_width()
  451 |                 vh = self.video_container.winfo_height()
  452 |                 if vw > 100 and vh > 100:
  453 |                     pil_img.thumbnail((vw - 10, vh - 10))
  454 |                 tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(pil_img)
  455 |                 self.after(0, self._update_frame_ui, tk_img, lap_var, fps, cam_idx)
  456 | 
  457 |             time.sleep(0.03)
  458 | 
  459 |         if self.picam2_instance is not None:
  460 |             try:
  461 |                 self.picam2_instance.stop()
  462 |                 self.picam2_instance.close()
  463 |             except Exception:
  464 |                 pass
  465 |             self.picam2_instance = None
  466 | 
  467 |         if self.cap_cv is not None:
  468 |             try:
  469 |                 self.cap_cv.release()
  470 |             except Exception:
  471 |                 pass
  472 |             self.cap_cv = None
  473 | 
  474 |     def _show_camera_error(self, cam_name, cam_idx):
  475 |         self.lbl_video.configure(
  476 |             text=f"No se pudo conectar a {cam_name} en el puerto flex CAM/DISP {cam_idx}.\n\n"
  477 |                  "Causas comunes:\n"
  478 |                  "1. Cable flexor mal encajado o invertido en CAM/DISP 1.\n"
  479 |                  "2. Falta agregar el overlay de la cámara en /boot/firmware/config.txt.\n"
  480 |                  "   Ejemplo: dtoverlay=imx477,cam1\n\n"
  481 |                  "Ejecute 'rpicam-hello --list-cameras' en la terminal para diagnosticar.",
  482 |             image="",
  483 |             fg="#ef4444"
  484 |         )

  487 |     def _update_frame_ui(self, tk_img, lap_var, fps, cam_idx):
  488 |         if not self.is_streaming:
  489 |             return
  490 |             
  491 |         self.lbl_video.img_ref = tk_img
  492 |         self.lbl_video.configure(image=tk_img, text="")
  493 | 
  494 |         if lap_var < 50:
  495 |             quality = "DESENFOCADO (Girar lente)"
  496 |             color = "#ef4444"
  497 |         elif lap_var < 150:
  498 |             quality = "ENFOQUE MEDIO"
  499 |             color = "#f59e0b"
  500 |         else:
  501 |             quality = "EXCELENTE ENFOQUE (Optimo)"
  502 |             color = "#10b981"
  503 | 
  504 |         cam_name = "Cenital 180° (Cam 0)" if cam_idx == 0 else "Lateral 90° (Cam 1)"
  505 |         self.lbl_fps.configure(text=f"{cam_name} | FPS: {fps:.1f} | Nitidez: {lap_var:.1f}")
  506 |         self.lbl_focus_text.configure(text=f"Índice de Nitidez: {lap_var:.1f} -> {quality}", fg=color)
  507 | 
  508 |         self.focus_meter.delete("all")
  509 |         bar_w = self.focus_meter.winfo_width()
  510 |         meter_fill = min(bar_w, int((lap_var / 350.0) * bar_w))
  511 |         self.focus_meter.create_rectangle(0, 0, meter_fill, 12, fill=color, width=0)
  512 | 
  513 |     def on_close(self):
  514 |         self.stop_current_stream()
  515 |         self.destroy()

  518 |     app = CameraCalibrationApp()
  519 |     app.mainloop()

   26 | echo "3) IMX708 (Camara V3 de 12MP / Autofocus)"
   27 | echo "4) IMX477 (Camara de Alta Calidad HQ de 12.3MP)"
   28 | echo "5) Arducam 64MP / 16MP Autofocus"
   29 | echo ""
   30 | read -p "Opcion [1-5] (Por defecto 1 - OV5647): " opt
   31 | opt=${opt:-1}
   32 | 
   33 | OVERLAY_NAME="ov5647"
   34 | case $opt in
   35 |     1) OVERLAY_NAME="ov5647";;
   36 |     2) OVERLAY_NAME="imx219";;
   37 |     3) OVERLAY_NAME="imx708";;
   38 |     4) OVERLAY_NAME="imx477";;

   17 | def install_package(package_name: str) -> bool:
   18 |     """Instala un paquete pip detectando automáticamente flags de compatibilidad para Raspberry Pi OS / Linux."""
   19 |     print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Instalando paquete ausente: '{package_name}'...")
   20 |     base_cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", package_name]
   21 |     
   22 |     try:
   23 |         res = subprocess.run(base_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
   24 |         if res.returncode == 0:
   25 |             print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] '{package_name}' instalado exitosamente.")
   26 |             return True
   27 |         
   28 |         # En Raspberry Pi OS (Debian Bookworm con PEP 668), se requiere flag especial
   29 |         if "externally-managed-environment" in res.stderr.lower() or sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
   30 |             print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Reintentando instalacion con --break-system-packages para Raspberry Pi OS...")
   31 |             res_break = subprocess.run(base_cmd + ["--break-system-packages"], capture_output=True, text=True)
   32 |             if res_break.returncode == 0:
   33 |                 print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] '{package_name}' instalado exitosamente con --break-system-packages.")
   34 |                 return True
   35 |             else:
   36 |                 print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR AVISO] Error al instalar '{package_name}': {res_break.stderr}")
   37 |                 return False
   38 |         else:
   39 |             print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR AVISO] Error al instalar '{package_name}': {res.stderr}")
   40 |             return False
   41 |     except Exception as e:
   42 |         print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR ERROR] Excepcion al ejecutar pip: {e}")
   43 |         return False
   44 | 
   45 | def ensure_dependencies():
   46 |     """Verifica todas las dependencias requeridas y las instala automáticamente si alguna falta."""
   47 |     missing = []
   48 |     for module_name, pip_name in RASPI_REQUIRED_PACKAGES:
   49 |         try:
   50 |             importlib.import_module(module_name)
   51 |         except ImportError:
   52 |             missing.append((module_name, pip_name))
   53 | 
   54 |     if missing:
   55 |         print("\n=======================================================")
   56 |         print(f"[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Se detectaron {len(missing)} librerias faltantes.")
   57 |         print("Instalando dependencias necesarias de forma automatica...")
   58 |         print("=======================================================\n")
   59 |         
   60 |         for module_name, pip_name in missing:
   61 |             ok = install_package(pip_name)
   62 |             if ok:
   63 |                 try:
   64 |                     importlib.invalidate_caches()
   65 |                     importlib.import_module(module_name)
   66 |                 except Exception:
   67 |                     pass
   68 |         print("\n[AUTO-INSTALADOR SIFMA] Verificacion de dependencias completada.\n")
   69 | 
   70 | if __name__ == "__main__":
   71 |     ensure_dependencies()

   79 | def determine_period_by_time(dt=None):
   80 |     """
   81 |     Determina el nombre canónico del período según la hora:
   82 |     - 06:00 a 10:59 -> manana
   83 |     - 11:00 a 14:59 -> medio_dia
   84 |     - 15:00 en adelante -> tarde
   85 |     Incluye la hora exacta en el sufijo si son tomas horarias continuas para no sobreescribir lotes.
   86 |     """
   87 |     if dt is None:
   88 |         dt = datetime.now()
   89 |     hour = dt.hour
   90 |     time_tag = dt.strftime("%H%M")
   91 |     
   92 |     if hour < 11:
   93 |         base = "manana"
   94 |     elif hour < 15:
   95 |         base = "medio_dia"
   96 |     else:
   97 |         base = "tarde"
   98 |         
   99 |     return f"{base}_{time_tag}"

  216 | def run_continuous_daemon():
  217 |     """
  218 |     Demonio autónomo de captura continua para Raspberry Pi 5.
  219 |     Lee dinámicamente config.json y admite:
  220 |     - Modo Intervalo (por ejemplo: cada 60 minutos / 1 hora para exhibición).
  221 |     - Modo Horas Fijas (por ejemplo: 07:05, 12:05, 17:05).
  222 |     - Captura inmediata tras el encendido si capture_on_boot es True.
  223 |     """
  224 |     cfg = load_node_config()
  225 |     boot_delay = cfg.get("boot_delay_sec", 10)
  226 |     capture_on_boot = cfg.get("capture_on_boot", True)
  227 |     
  228 |     print("\n=======================================================")
  229 |     print("SIFMA DEMONIO AUTONOMO - Raspberry Pi 5")
  230 |     print(f"Modo de operacion: {cfg.get('capture_mode', 'interval').upper()}")
  231 |     if cfg.get("capture_mode") == "interval":
  232 |         print(f"Frecuencia configurada: Cada {cfg.get('interval_minutes', 60)} minutos (1 hora)")
  233 |     else:
  234 |         print(f"Horarios configurados: {cfg.get('scheduled_times', [])}")
  235 |     print(f"Fotos por sesion: {cfg.get('photos_per_session', 3)} tomas")
  236 |     print("=======================================================\n")
  237 | 
  238 |     if boot_delay > 0:
  239 |         print(f"[ARRANQUE] Esperando retardo inicial de {boot_delay}s para estabilizacion de hardware...")
  240 |         save_daemon_status(status_text=f"Iniciando: esperando retardo de {boot_delay}s...")
  241 |         time.sleep(boot_delay)
  242 | 
  243 |     # Si está configurado para disparar al encender:
  244 |     if capture_on_boot:
  245 |         print("\n[ARRANQUE] Ejecutando primera sesion automatica tras encendido...")
  246 |         try:
  247 |             execute_capture_sequence()
  248 |         except Exception as e:
  249 |             print(f"[ERROR EN CAPTURA INICIAL]: {e}")
  250 | 
  251 |     last_trigger_time = datetime.now()
  252 |     last_scheduled_hour = None
  253 | 
  254 |     while True:
  255 |         try:
  256 |             # Recargar configuración fresca en cada iteración
  257 |             cfg = load_node_config()
  258 |             mode = cfg.get("capture_mode", "interval")
  259 |             now = datetime.now()
  260 | 
  261 |             if mode == "interval":
  262 |                 interval_min = max(1, int(cfg.get("interval_minutes", 60)))
  263 |                 interval_sec = interval_min * 60
  264 |                 elapsed = (now - last_trigger_time).total_seconds()
  265 |                 next_trigger = last_trigger_time + timedelta(seconds=interval_sec)
  266 |                 
  267 |                 remaining_sec = max(0, int(interval_sec - elapsed))
  268 |                 rem_min = remaining_sec // 60
  269 |                 rem_s = remaining_sec % 60
  270 |                 
  271 |                 save_daemon_status(
  272 |                     status_text=f"Modo Intervalo ({interval_min} min): Próxima toma en {rem_min}m {rem_s}s",
  273 |                     next_capture_dt=next_trigger
  274 |                 )
  275 | 
  276 |                 if elapsed >= interval_sec:
  277 |                     print(f"\n[CRON INTERVALO] Tiempo cumplido ({interval_min} min). Iniciando nueva sesion de captura...")
  278 |                     execute_capture_sequence()
  279 |                     last_trigger_time = datetime.now()
  280 | 
  281 |             elif mode == "scheduled":

  299 |                 if current_hm in sched_times and (now.date(), current_hm) != last_scheduled_hour:

  304 |             time.sleep(5)

   92 | def get_storage_status():

  299 |     def toggle_hour(self, hour):
  300 |         sched = list(self.cfg.get("scheduled_times", ["07:05", "12:05", "17:05"]))

  386 |     def refresh_timer(self):
  387 |         self.lbl_clock.configure(text=datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"))
  388 | 
  389 |         try:
  390 |             target_dir = OfflineStorageService._find_target_storage_directory_once()
  391 |             is_usb = "SIFMA_OFFLINE_STORAGE" not in target_dir
  392 |             if is_usb:
  393 |                 self.lbl_usb.configure(text="USB: Conectada", fg="#60a5fa")
  394 |             else:
  395 |                 self.lbl_usb.configure(text="Almacenamiento Local", fg="#f59e0b")
  396 | 
  397 |             status_text = "En espera..."
  398 |             next_cap = "--"
  399 |             last_cap_str = "Ninguno"
  400 |             if os.path.exists(STATUS_FILE):
  401 |                 with open(STATUS_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
  402 |                     st = json.load(f)
  403 |                     status_text = st.get("status", "En espera")
  404 |                     next_cap = st.get("next_capture_human", "--")
  405 |                     if "last_capture" in st and st["last_capture"]:
  406 |                         last_cap_str = f"{st['last_capture'].get('timestamp', '')} ({st['last_capture'].get('period', '')})"
  407 | 
  408 |             self.status_text_box.configure(
  409 |                 text=f"Estado: {status_text}\n"
  410 |                      f"Proxima toma: {next_cap}\n"
  411 |                      f"Ultimo lote: {last_cap_str}\n"
  412 |                      f"Destino: {target_dir}"
  413 |             )
  414 |         except Exception:
  415 |             pass
  416 | 
  417 |         self.after(2000, self.refresh_timer)
