   24 | class CameraCaptureService:
   25 |     """
   26 |     Servicio de captura física para Raspberry Pi 5 con cámaras ARDUCAM / MIPI CSI
   27 |     conectadas mediante cables flexores a los puertos CAM/DISP 0 (Cenital) y CAM/DISP 1 (Lateral).
   28 |     
   29 |     Aplica rotación de producción:
   30 |     - Cámara 0 (Cenital): Rotación 180° para orientación derecha del dosel.
   31 |     - Cámara 1 (Lateral): Rotación 90° a la derecha (sentido horario) para orientación vertical del tallo.
   32 |     """
   33 |     
   34 |     @staticmethod
   35 |     def _apply_orientation(output_path, camera_index=0):
   36 |         """Aplica la rotación correspondiente según la posición física de la cámara."""
   37 |         if not os.path.exists(output_path):
   38 |             return
   39 |             
   40 |         try:
   41 |             if HAS_OPENCV:
   42 |                 img = cv2.imread(output_path)
   43 |                 if img is not None:
   44 |                     if camera_index == 0:
   45 |                         # Cenital: Rotar 180 grados
   46 |                         rotated = cv2.rotate(img, cv2.ROTATE_180)
   47 |                     else:
   48 |                         # Lateral: Rotar 90 grados en sentido horario
   49 |                         rotated = cv2.rotate(img, cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE)
   50 |                     cv2.imwrite(output_path, rotated)
   51 |             else:
   52 |                 from PIL import Image
   53 |                 img = Image.open(output_path)
   54 |                 if camera_index == 0:
   55 |                     rotated = img.rotate(180, expand=True)
   56 |                 else:
   57 |                     rotated = img.rotate(270, expand=True) # 270 deg counter-clockwise = 90 deg clockwise
   58 |                 rotated.save(output_path)
   59 |         except Exception as e:
   60 |             print(f"[CAMARA AVISO] Error al rotar imagen: {e}")
   61 | 
   62 |     @staticmethod
   63 |     def list_detected_cameras():
   64 |         """Consulta el hardware MIPI CSI para detectar las cámaras Arducam conectadas."""
   65 |         detected = []
   66 |         cmd_tool = shutil.which("rpicam-hello") or shutil.which("libcamera-hello")
   67 |         if cmd_tool:
   68 |             try:
   69 |                 res = subprocess.run([cmd_tool, "--list-cameras"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
   70 |                 output = res.stdout + "\n" + res.stderr
   71 |                 lines = [l.strip() for l in output.splitlines() if l.strip()]
   72 |                 for line in lines:
   73 |                     if "available" in line.lower() or ":" in line:
   74 |                         detected.append(line)
   75 |             except Exception:
   76 |                 pass
   77 | 
   78 |         if not detected and HAS_PICAMERA2:
   79 |             try:
   80 |                 from picamera2 import Picamera2
   81 |                 for idx in [0, 1]:
   82 |                     try:
   83 |                         p = Picamera2(idx)
   84 |                         detected.append(f"CSI Puerto {idx}: Camara Arducam detectada")
   85 |                         p.close()
   86 |                     except Exception:
   87 |                         pass
   88 |             except Exception:
   89 |                 pass
   90 | 
   91 |         return detected
   92 | 
   93 |     @staticmethod
   94 |     def capture_photo(output_path, camera_index=0, max_retries=2):
   95 |         """
   96 |         Captura una imagen de alta calidad desde la cámara Arducam conectada al puerto flexor
   97 |         CAM/DISP correspondiente (0 = Cenital, 1 = Lateral).
   98 |         """
   99 |         os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
  100 |         
  101 |         for attempt in range(1, max_retries + 1):
  102 |             # 1. Estrategia Principal: Picamera2 (Controlador oficial CSI de Raspberry Pi 5)
  103 |             if HAS_PICAMERA2:
  104 |                 picam2 = None
  105 |                 try:
  106 |                     picam2 = Picamera2(camera_index)
  107 |                     still_config = picam2.create_still_configuration(main={"format": "RGB888"})
  108 |                     picam2.configure(still_config)
  109 |                     picam2.start()
  110 |                     time.sleep(0.8)  # Tiempo para calibración automática de fotometría del sensor Arducam
  111 |                     picam2.capture_file(output_path)
  112 |                     picam2.stop()
  113 |                     picam2.close()
  114 |                     picam2 = None
  115 |                     
  116 |                     if os.path.exists(output_path) and os.path.getsize(output_path) > 1000:
  117 |                         CameraCaptureService._apply_orientation(output_path, camera_index=camera_index)
  118 |                         print(f"[CAMARA CSI] Foto capturada y orientada en Puerto Flex #{camera_index}: {os.path.basename(output_path)}")
  119 |                         return True
  120 |                 except Exception as e:
  121 |                     print(f"[CAMARA CSI] Intento {attempt} con Picamera2 (Puerto Flex {camera_index}): {e}")
  122 |                 finally:
  123 |                     if picam2 is not None:
  124 |                         try:
  125 |                             picam2.close()
  126 |                         except Exception:
  127 |                             pass
  128 | 
  129 |             # 2. Estrategia Secundaria: Binario Nativo rpicam-still / libcamera-still
  130 |             rpicam_bin = shutil.which("rpicam-still") or shutil.which("libcamera-still")
  131 |             if rpicam_bin:
  132 |                 try:
  133 |                     cmd = [
  134 |                         rpicam_bin,
  135 |                         "--camera", str(camera_index),
  136 |                         "-o", output_path,
  137 |                         "-t", "800",       # 800ms para autoexposición
  138 |                         "--nopreview",
  139 |                         "-n",              # Sin vista previa en ventana de servidor X
  140 |                         "--encoding", "png" if output_path.lower().endswith(".png") else "jpg"
  141 |                     ]
  142 |                     res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=8)
  143 |                     if res.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(output_path) and os.path.getsize(output_path) > 1000:
  144 |                         CameraCaptureService._apply_orientation(output_path, camera_index=camera_index)
  145 |                         print(f"[CAMARA CSI] Foto capturada con {os.path.basename(rpicam_bin)} (Puerto Flex {camera_index}): {os.path.basename(output_path)}")
  146 |                         return True
  147 |                     else:
  148 |                         print(f"[CAMARA CSI] {os.path.basename(rpicam_bin)} fallo en puerto {camera_index}: {res.stderr}")
  149 |                 except Exception as e:
  150 |                     print(f"[CAMARA CSI] Intento con {rpicam_bin} en puerto {camera_index}: {e}")
  151 | 
  152 |             # 3. Estrategia Terciaria: OpenCV VideoCapture (V4L2 CSI Backend)
  153 |             if HAS_OPENCV:
  154 |                 cap = None
  155 |                 try:
  156 |                     if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
  157 |                         cap = cv2.VideoCapture(camera_index, cv2.CAP_V4L2)
  158 |                     else:
  159 |                         cap = cv2.VideoCapture(camera_index)
  160 |                         
  161 |                     if cap.isOpened():
  162 |                         for _ in range(4):
  163 |                             cap.read()
  164 |                             time.sleep(0.04)
  165 |                         ret, frame = cap.read()
  166 |                         cap.release()
  167 |                         if ret and frame is not None:
  168 |                             cv2.imwrite(output_path, frame)
  169 |                             if os.path.exists(output_path) and os.path.getsize(output_path) > 1000:
  170 |                                 CameraCaptureService._apply_orientation(output_path, camera_index=camera_index)
  171 |                                 print(f"[CAMARA CSI] Foto capturada con OpenCV (Puerto {camera_index}): {os.path.basename(output_path)}")
  172 |                                 return True
  173 |                     else:
  174 |                         if cap is not None:
  175 |                             cap.release()
  176 |                 except Exception as e:
  177 |                     print(f"[CAMARA CSI] Intento con OpenCV (Puerto {camera_index}): {e}")
  178 |                 finally:
  179 |                     if cap is not None and cap.isOpened():
  180 |                         cap.release()
  181 | 
  182 |             time.sleep(0.5)
  183 | 
  184 |         print(f"[CAMARA AVISO] No se pudo capturar foto en el Puerto Flex CAM/DISP #{camera_index} ({os.path.basename(output_path)})")
  185 |         return False

    1 | # SIFMA — Sistema Integral de Fenotipado y Monitoreo Ambiental
    2 | # Autores: Andrés Felipe Luna Camargo, Cristian David Peña Martínez
    3 | # Año: 2026.

    5 | import os
    6 | import json
    7 | import time
    8 | import platform
    9 | from datetime import datetime
   10 | 
   11 | class OfflineStorageService:
   12 |     """
   13 |     Servicio encargado de detectar automáticamente memorias USB conectadas a la Raspberry Pi
   14 |     y estructurar el almacenamiento por fecha y período con metadatos de alta resolución temporal:
   15 |     Estructura en USB: SIFMA_CAPTURES/YYYY-MM-DD/periodo/
   16 |     """
   17 |     
   18 |     @staticmethod
   19 |     def wait_and_find_storage_directory(timeout_sec=15):
   20 |         """
   21 |         Espera a que el sistema operativo monte la memoria USB al encender.
   22 |         Si tras el tiempo límite no se detecta USB, utiliza almacenamiento local de respaldo.
   23 |         """
   24 |         initial_check = OfflineStorageService._find_target_storage_directory_once()
   25 |         if initial_check and "SIFMA_OFFLINE_STORAGE" not in initial_check:
   26 |             print(f"[ALMACENAMIENTO] Memoria USB detectada en: {initial_check}")
   27 |             return initial_check
   28 | 
   29 |         start_time = time.time()
   30 |         print(f"[ALMACENAMIENTO] Esperando deteccion de memoria USB (maximo {timeout_sec}s)...")
   31 |         
   32 |         while time.time() - start_time < timeout_sec:
   33 |             target_path = OfflineStorageService._find_target_storage_directory_once()
   34 |             if target_path and "SIFMA_OFFLINE_STORAGE" not in target_path:
   35 |                 print(f"[ALMACENAMIENTO] Memoria USB detectada y montada en: {target_path}")
   36 |                 return target_path
   37 |             time.sleep(1.5)
   38 |             
   39 |         print("[ALMACENAMIENTO AVISO] No se detecto memoria USB externa. Usando almacenamiento local de respaldo.")
   40 |         return OfflineStorageService._find_target_storage_directory_once()
   41 | 
   42 |     @staticmethod
   43 |     def _find_target_storage_directory_once():
   44 |         system = platform.system()
   45 |         possible_usb_roots = []
   46 |         
   47 |         if system == "Windows":
   48 |             import string
   49 |             for letter in string.ascii_uppercase:
   50 |                 if letter not in ['C']:
   51 |                     drive = f"{letter}:\\"
   52 |                     if os.path.exists(drive):
   53 |                         possible_usb_roots.append(drive)
   54 |         else: # Linux / Raspberry Pi OS
   55 |             possible_usb_roots = [
   56 |                 "/media/nodo1",
   57 |                 "/media/computo1",
   58 |                 "/media/pi",
   59 |                 "/media",
   60 |                 "/mnt/usb",
   61 |                 "/mnt"
   62 |             ]
   63 |             
   64 |         target_usb_path = None
   65 |         for root in possible_usb_roots:
   66 |             if os.path.exists(root):
   67 |                 if os.access(root, os.W_OK):
   68 |                     target_usb_path = os.path.join(root, "SIFMA_CAPTURES")
   69 |                     break
   70 |                 else:
   71 |                     try:
   72 |                         subdirs = [os.path.join(root, d) for d in os.listdir(root) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root, d))]
   73 |                         for sd in subdirs:
   74 |                             if os.access(sd, os.W_OK):
   75 |                                 target_usb_path = os.path.join(sd, "SIFMA_CAPTURES")
   76 |                                 break
   77 |                     except Exception:
   78 |                         pass
   79 |                 if target_usb_path:
   80 |                     break
   81 |                     
   82 |         if not target_usb_path:
   83 |             local_fallback = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)), "SIFMA_OFFLINE_STORAGE")
   84 |             target_usb_path = local_fallback
   85 |             
   86 |         return target_usb_path
   87 | 
   88 |     @staticmethod
   89 |     def create_batch_directory(period="manana", wait_for_usb=True):
   90 |         """
   91 |         Crea una carpeta de lote en la USB con la jerarquía:
   92 |         SIFMA_CAPTURES/YYYY-MM-DD/periodo/
   93 |         """
   94 |         if wait_for_usb:
   95 |             base_dir = OfflineStorageService.wait_and_find_storage_directory(timeout_sec=15)
   96 |         else:
   97 |             base_dir = OfflineStorageService._find_target_storage_directory_once()
   98 |             
   99 |         date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  100 |         period_clean = period.lower().replace("ñ", "n").replace("í", "i").replace(" ", "_")
  101 |         
  102 |         batch_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, date_str, period_clean)
  103 |         os.makedirs(batch_dir, exist_ok=True)
  104 |         return batch_dir
  105 | 
  106 |     @staticmethod
  107 |     def save_batch_metadata(
  108 |         batch_dir, 
  109 |         period, 
  110 |         crop_type="cebollin", 
  111 |         image_files_count=10, 
  112 |         plant_id=1,
  113 |         session_start=None,
  114 |         session_end=None,
  115 |         photos_info=None
  116 |     ):
  117 |         """
  118 |         Guarda el archivo metadata.json en el lote de la USB con el desglose de cada una de las 5 tomas
  119 |         y sus marcas de tiempo individuales para el cruce cronológico preciso.
  120 |         """
  121 |         now = datetime.now()
  122 |         meta_path = os.path.join(batch_dir, "metadata.json")
  123 |         payload = {
  124 |             "timestamp": session_start or now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  125 |             "date": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
  126 |             "exact_time": now.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
  127 |             "period": period,
  128 |             "crop_type": crop_type,
  129 |             "plant_id": plant_id,
  130 |             "images_count": image_files_count,
  131 |             "session_start": session_start or now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  132 |             "session_end": session_end or now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  133 |             "photos": photos_info or []
  134 |         }
  135 |         with open(meta_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
  136 |             json.dump(payload, f, indent=2)
  137 |             
  138 |         # Forzar sincronización física en la memoria USB
  139 |         try:
  140 |             if hasattr(os, 'sync'):
  141 |                 os.sync()
  142 |         except Exception:
  143 |             pass
  144 |             
  145 |         print(f"[ALMACENAMIENTO] Metadatos guardados y sincronizados en USB: {meta_path}")
  146 |         return meta_path

  702 |     <script>
  703 |         let currentConfig = {};
  704 |         let activePreviewCam = 0;
  705 | 
  706 |         const defaultHours = [
  707 |             "06:00", "07:05", "08:00", "09:00", "10:00",
  708 |             "11:00", "12:05", "13:00", "14:00", "15:00",
  709 |             "16:00", "17:05", "18:00", "19:00", "20:00"
  710 |         ];
  711 | 
  712 |         function showToast(msg) {
  713 |             const t = document.getElementById("toastBanner");
  714 |             t.textContent = msg;
  715 |             t.style.display = "block";
  716 |             setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = "none"; }, 2500);
  717 |         }
  718 | 
  719 |         async function fetchStatus() {
  720 |             try {
  721 |                 const res = await fetch("/api/status");
  722 |                 const data = await res.json();
  723 |                 if (data.status === "ok") {
  724 |                     currentConfig = data.config;
  725 |                     updateUIFromConfig(data.config);
  726 |                     updateDaemonAndStorageUI(data);
  727 |                 }
  728 |             } catch (e) {
  729 |                 console.error("Error consultando estado:", e);
  730 |             }
  731 |         }
  732 | 
  733 |         function updateUIFromConfig(cfg) {
  734 |             // Modo
  735 |             const isInterval = cfg.capture_mode === "interval";
  736 |             document.getElementById("modeInterval").classList.toggle("active", isInterval);
  737 |             document.getElementById("modeScheduled").classList.toggle("active", !isInterval);
  738 |             document.getElementById("intervalContainer").style.display = isInterval ? "flex" : "none";
  739 |             document.getElementById("scheduledContainer").style.display = !isInterval ? "flex" : "none";
  740 | 
  741 |             // Intervalo
  742 |             const min = cfg.interval_minutes || 60;
  743 |             document.getElementById("intervalDisplay").textContent = `${min} min (${(min/60).toFixed(1)}h)`;
  744 |             document.getElementById("stepperIntervalVal").textContent = `${min} min`;
  745 | 
  746 |             // Fotos por sesión
  747 |             const photos = cfg.photos_per_session || 3;
  748 |             document.getElementById("photosCountDisplay").textContent = `${photos} fotos`;
  749 |             document.getElementById("stepperPhotosVal").textContent = `${photos} fotos`;
  750 | 
  751 |             // Espaciado
  752 |             const spacing = cfg.interval_between_photos_sec || 5;
  753 |             document.getElementById("spacingDisplay").textContent = spacing >= 60 ? `${spacing/60} min` : `${spacing} segundos`;
  754 | 
  755 |             // Canastilla
  756 |             const pid = cfg.plant_id || 1;
  757 |             [1, 2, 3, 4].forEach(id => {
  758 |                 const el = document.getElementById(`plant${id}`);
  759 |                 if (el) el.classList.toggle("active", id === pid);
  760 |             });
  761 | 
  762 |             // Captura al encender
  763 |             const bootCap = cfg.capture_on_boot !== false;
  764 |             document.getElementById("bootCaptureOn").classList.toggle("active", bootCap);
  765 |             document.getElementById("bootCaptureOff").classList.toggle("active", !bootCap);
  766 | 
  767 |             // Horas programadas
  768 |             renderHoursGrid(cfg.scheduled_times || ["07:05", "12:05", "17:05"]);
  769 |         }
  770 | 
  771 |         function renderHoursGrid(activeTimes) {
  772 |             const grid = document.getElementById("hoursGrid");
  773 |             grid.innerHTML = "";
  774 |             defaultHours.forEach(h => {
  775 |                 const chip = document.createElement("div");
  776 |                 chip.className = "hour-chip" + (activeTimes.includes(h) ? " active" : "");
  777 |                 chip.textContent = h;
  778 |                 chip.onclick = () => toggleScheduledHour(h);
  779 |                 grid.appendChild(chip);
  780 |             });
  781 |         }
  782 | 
  783 |         function updateDaemonAndStorageUI(data) {
  784 |             // Reloj
  785 |             document.getElementById("liveClock").textContent = data.server_time || "--:--:--";
  786 | 
  787 |             // Demonio
  788 |             const daemon = data.daemon || {};
  789 |             const isRunning = daemon.is_running;
  790 |             const badge = document.getElementById("daemonBadge");
  791 |             const badgeText = document.getElementById("daemonBadgeText");
  792 |             
  793 |             badge.className = "badge" + (isRunning ? " active" : "");
  794 |             badgeText.textContent = isRunning ? "Demonio Activo" : "Demonio Detenido";
  795 | 
  796 |             document.getElementById("daemonStatusText").textContent = daemon.status || "En espera";
  797 |             document.getElementById("daemonNextCapture").textContent = daemon.next_capture_human || daemon.next_capture || "--";
  798 | 
  799 |             if (daemon.last_capture) {
  800 |                 document.getElementById("daemonLastCapture").textContent = 
  801 |                     `${daemon.last_capture.timestamp} (${daemon.last_capture.photos_count} fotos en ${daemon.last_capture.period})`;
  802 |             }
  803 | 
  804 |             // USB
  805 |             const storage = data.storage || {};
  806 |             const usbBadge = document.getElementById("usbBadge");
  807 |             const usbText = document.getElementById("usbBadgeText");
  808 |             if (storage.is_usb_mounted) {
  809 |                 usbBadge.className = "badge usb-active";
  810 |                 usbText.textContent = `USB: ${storage.free_gb}GB libres`;
  811 |             } else {
  812 |                 usbBadge.className = "badge";
  813 |                 usbText.textContent = "Almacenamiento Local";
  814 |             }
  815 |             document.getElementById("storagePathText").textContent = `${storage.label} (${storage.target_path})`;
  816 |         }

  818 |         async function saveConfig(updates) {
  819 |             try {
  820 |                 const res = await fetch("/api/config", {
  821 |                     method: "POST",
  822 |                     headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  823 |                     body: JSON.stringify(updates)
  824 |                 });
  825 |                 const data = await res.json();
  826 |                 if (data.status === "ok") {
  827 |                     showToast("Configuración actualizada y sincronizada");
  828 |                     fetchStatus();
  829 |                 } else {
  830 |                     alert("Error guardando configuracion: " + data.message);
  831 |                 }
  832 |             } catch (e) {
  833 |                 console.error(e);
  834 |             }
  835 |         }

  846 |             let cur = currentConfig.interval_minutes || 60;
  847 |             cur = Math.max(1, cur + delta);
  848 |             saveConfig({ interval_minutes: cur });
  849 |         }

  853 |         }
  854 | 
  855 |         function stepPhotosCount(delta) {
  856 |             let cur = currentConfig.photos_per_session || 3;
  857 |             cur = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, cur + delta));
  858 |             saveConfig({ photos_per_session: cur });
  859 |         }

  867 |         }

  873 |         function toggleScheduledHour(hour) {
  874 |             let times = currentConfig.scheduled_times || ["07:05", "12:05", "17:05"];
  875 |             if (times.includes(hour)) {
  876 |                 times = times.filter(t => t !== hour);
  877 |             } else {
  878 |                 times.push(hour);
  879 |             }
  880 |             saveConfig({ scheduled_times: times });
  881 |         }

  883 |         async function applyPreset(presetName) {
  884 |             try {
  885 |                 const res = await fetch("/api/preset", {
  886 |                     method: "POST",
  887 |                     headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  888 |                     body: JSON.stringify({ preset: presetName })
  889 |                 });
  890 |                 const data = await res.json();
  891 |                 if (data.status === "ok") {
  892 |                     showToast(`Preset '${presetName}' aplicado`);
  893 |                     fetchStatus();
  894 |                 }
  895 |             } catch (e) {
  896 |                 console.error(e);
  897 |             }
  898 |         }

  900 |         async function triggerImmediateCapture() {
  901 |             if (!confirm("¿Desea iniciar una secuencia de captura fotográfica ahora mismo?")) return;
  902 |             try {
  903 |                 const res = await fetch("/api/trigger_capture", { method: "POST" });
  904 |                 const data = await res.json();
  905 |                 showToast(data.message);
  906 |                 fetchStatus();
  907 |             } catch (e) {
  908 |                 alert("Error al disparar captura: " + e);
  909 |             }
  910 |         }

  912 |         async function openCameraPreview(camIdx) {
  913 |             activePreviewCam = camIdx;
  914 |             document.getElementById("modalCamTitle").textContent = `Vista Previa - Cámara ${camIdx === 0 ? 'Cenital' : 'Lateral'} (ID ${camIdx})`;
  915 |             document.getElementById("previewModal").style.display = "flex";
  916 |             document.getElementById("previewLoadingText").style.display = "block";
  917 |             document.getElementById("previewImg").style.display = "none";
  918 |             document.getElementById("previewTimestamp").textContent = "Tomando frame...";
  919 | 
  920 |             try {
  921 |                 const res = await fetch(`/api/preview_camera/${camIdx}`);
  922 |                 const data = await res.json();
  923 |                 if (data.status === "ok") {
  924 |                     document.getElementById("previewLoadingText").style.display = "none";
  925 |                     const img = document.getElementById("previewImg");
  926 |                     img.src = data.image_b64;
  927 |                     img.style.display = "block";
  928 |                     document.getElementById("previewTimestamp").textContent = `Capturado a las: ${data.timestamp}`;
  929 |                 } else {
  930 |                     document.getElementById("previewLoadingText").textContent = data.message || "Error al capturar.";
  931 |                 }
  932 |             } catch (e) {
  933 |                 document.getElementById("previewLoadingText").textContent = "Error de conexión con la cámara.";
  934 |             }
  935 |         }
  936 | 
  937 |         function refreshCurrentPreview() {
  938 |             openCameraPreview(activePreviewCam);
  939 |         }

  941 |         function closePreviewModal() {
  942 |             document.getElementById("previewModal").style.display = "none";

  946 |             try {
  947 |                 const res = await fetch(`/api/daemon/${action}`, { method: "POST" });

  949 |                 showToast(data.message);
  950 |                 setTimeout(fetchStatus, 1500);
  951 |             } catch (e) {
  952 |                 alert("Error controlando demonio: " + e);
  953 |             }
  954 |         }

  958 |         setInterval(fetchStatus, 3000);
